66493.recognize_zh: 兩顆相鄰的嗜中性球周圍都黏附一圈血小板，呈衛星狀環繞 (platelet satellitism)，背景可見紅血球排列成錢串狀，屬於 EDTA 相關的假性血小板低下。
features: Two adjacent mature neutrophils encircled by adherent platelets
Platelets attached along the cell membrane, some partly overlying the cytoplasmic margin
Neutrophils with segmented nuclei and unremarkable cytoplasm
Very few free-lying platelets in the background
Red cells arranged in rouleaux-like chains in this area of the smear
66493.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two mature neutrophils with platelets adhering circumferentially to their surfaces, forming satellites. Free platelets are scarce in the background. Red cells show rouleaux-like stacking in this thick area of the smear, without other significant morphologic abnormality. Findings are consistent with platelet satellitism causing pseudothrombocytopenia; the platelet count should be verified in a citrate-anticoagulated sample.

ddx.vs: Aggregation forms free platelet clumps, often at the feathered edge, rather than rings around leukocytes.
Macrothrombocytopenia shows large single platelets that are under-counted by analyzers, not normal-sized platelets clustered around neutrophils.
In true thrombocytopenia platelets are sparse everywhere without rosettes and the count remains low in alternative anticoagulants.

exam.answer_en: Platelet satellitism — platelets adhering around two neutrophils; spurious thrombocytopenia (pseudothrombocytopenia)
pearls_zh: 考法：給一個「無出血症狀但 PLT 很低」的病例配這張圖，問下一步；答檢視抹片並以 citrate 抗凝管重新計數。
此現象與 EDTA 抗凝劑有關，抽血溫度與放置時間會影響；不代表 ITP 或骨髓疾病。
黏附的血小板可能被計數器算入白血球或完全不計，偶爾造成 WBC 讀值輕微偏差。
Satellitism 多見於中性球，少數報告可黏附單核球；檢查時應掃片尾（feathered edge）找聚集。
exam.pitfall_zh: 厚區紅血球重疊（本圖有 rouleaux 樣排列）易讓人忽略衛星現象或誤判 rouleaux 為主要發現；重點是中性球周邊貼附的血小板與背景游離血小板稀少。

quiz.q: 這張抹片的病人自動計數 PLT 為 40×10⁹/L，最適當的下一步為何？
quiz.a: 以 citrate（或 heparin）管重抽計數並抹片估計，確認為 EDTA 相關假性血小板低下。

66429.recognize_zh: 低倍網狀纖維染色下，骨小樑之間的骨髓腔完全被深色、呈束狀流線排列的纖維取代，看不到造血細胞與脂肪，骨小樑變粗，符合 MF-3 等級的骨髓纖維化 (myelofibrosis)。
features: Intertrabecular marrow spaces entirely replaced by a dense, diffuse network of dark-staining fibers
Fibers form coarse bundles with a streaming, swirling pattern
Thickened, irregular bony trabeculae suggesting osteosclerosis
Scattered dilated, empty sinusoidal spaces within the fibrotic stroma
Hematopoietic cells and adipocytes are essentially absent at this magnification
66429.describe_en: Reticulin-stained bone marrow trephine at low power shows complete replacement of the intertrabecular spaces by a diffuse and dense network of coarse, intersecting reticulin fibers arranged in streaming bundles. The trabeculae appear thickened and irregular, and dilated sinusoids are present within the fibrotic stroma. Residual hematopoiesis and fat are not appreciable in this field. Findings correspond to WHO reticulin grade MF-3, consistent with the overt fibrotic stage of a myeloproliferative neoplasm such as primary myelofibrosis; a trichrome stain is recommended to grade collagen fibrosis.

ddx.vs: MF-2 shows diffuse dense fibers with extensive intersections but only focal coarse bundles, whereas MF-3 shows coarse bundles throughout often with collagen and osteosclerosis.
Metastatic tumor produces desmoplastic fibrosis containing cohesive epithelial clusters that are highlighted by cytokeratin on H&E/IHC.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia or mast cell disease
ddx.vs: These cause reticulin fibrosis around a detectable infiltrate of CD20/annexin A1-positive hairy cells or CD117/tryptase-positive spindled mast cells.
Metabolic fibrosis is predominantly paratrabecular with prominent osteoclastic resorption and preserved central hematopoiesis.

exam.answer_en: Myelofibrosis, reticulin grade MF-3 — diffuse dense coarse reticulin bundles with osteosclerotic trabeculae (overt fibrotic PMF)
pearls_zh: 考法：給 reticulin 染色低倍圖問「WHO fibrosis grade」；MF-3 = 瀰漫密集纖維、廣泛交叉、粗纖維束，常伴 collagen 與 osteosclerosis。
WHO 分級 MF-0 至 MF-3；overt PMF 需 MF-2 或 MF-3，prefibrotic PMF 為 MF-0 或 MF-1，這是兩者的關鍵分界之一。
Driver mutation：JAK2 V617F、CALR、MPL；三者皆陰性稱 triple-negative，預後較差，需找 clonal marker 並排除反應性纖維化。
評分時只看有造血組織的區域，避開血管周圍與骨小樑邊緣；collagen 另以 trichrome 分級。
臨床連結：aspirate 常 dry tap、周邊血 leukoerythroblastosis 與 teardrop cells、脾腫大；JAK inhibitor 緩解症狀，allo-HSCT 是唯一可能治癒方式。
exam.pitfall_zh: 骨小樑旁或血管周圍本來就有 reticulin，易高估分級；另外 MF-3 並非 PMF 專屬，需排除轉移癌、hairy cell leukemia、mastocytosis 等造成的次發性纖維化。

quiz.q: 這張 reticulin 染色依 WHO 應評為第幾級？此級可否診斷 prefibrotic PMF？
quiz.a: MF-3；不可，prefibrotic PMF 為 MF-0/1，MF-2/3 屬 overt PMF。

66365.recognize_zh: 骨小樑邊緣可見一排活化的骨表面細胞（箭頭）與骨小樑周圍纖維化，右下方纖維組織中有呈放射狀玫瑰花形的透明結晶聚集並有組織球包圍；骨重塑加上結晶沉積，指向草酸鹽沉積症。
features: Radiating, rosette-shaped aggregate of pale needle-like crystals within fibrous stroma (right lower field) with surrounding histiocytic reaction
Peritrabecular fibrous tissue with spindle cells interposed between marrow and bone
Row of plump bone-lining cells on the trabecular surface (arrow), consistent with active remodeling (osteoblasts/osteoclasts)
Irregular trabecular contours suggestive of resorption
Residual hematopoietic marrow with admixed adipocytes
66365.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow trephine section shows bony trabeculae with irregular contours bordered by peritrabecular fibrous tissue. At the arrow, the trabecular surface is lined by plump bone cells, indicating active remodeling. In the right lower field, the fibrous stroma contains a rosette-shaped aggregate of pale, radiating needle-like crystals surrounded by histiocytes, consistent with a foreign-body-type reaction. Intervening marrow spaces retain trilineage hematopoiesis with admixed fat. Findings are consistent with bone and marrow involvement by oxalate crystal deposition (hyperoxalosis).

ddx.vs: Shares peritrabecular fibrosis and osteoclastic resorption but lacks radiating crystal aggregates with histiocytic reaction.

Urate deposits are usually dissolved in formalin-processed tissue leaving amorphous material with palisading histiocytes, whereas oxalate rosettes persist and are strongly birefringent under polarized light.
Shows mosaic cement lines and bizarre osteoclasts with marrow fibrosis but no crystal deposits.

66237.recognize_zh: 這是頭部非顯影電腦斷層（CT）的軸切面照片，綠色箭頭指向腦實質後內側一小塊高密度（亮白）病灶，代表急性顱內出血；本身不是形態學影像，需搭配臨床的遺傳性血小板功能異常背景解讀。
features: Axial non-contrast CT image of the head photographed from a monitor
Small, well-defined hyperdense focus in the posterior medial brain parenchyma adjacent to the midline (green arrow)
Hyperdense density is consistent with acute blood
No large mass effect or midline shift is appreciable at this image quality
66237.describe_en: Axial non-contrast CT of the head, photographed from a display screen, demonstrates a small hyperdense focus in the posterior medial parenchyma near the midline, indicated by the arrow, consistent with acute intracranial hemorrhage. No substantial midline shift is appreciated, although image quality and a single slice limit assessment of extent, ventricular extension and edema. This is a radiologic complication rather than a diagnostic morphologic finding; in the stated context it represents a bleeding manifestation of an inherited platelet function disorder, which requires platelet aggregation studies, flow cytometry for glycoproteins or genetic testing for diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Physiologic calcifications are denser (bone-like attenuation), occur at typical anatomic sites and remain unchanged on follow-up, whereas acute blood measures about 50-80 HU.
Tumors show surrounding edema, mass effect and enhancement on contrast imaging, which is not evident on this single non-contrast slice.

ddx.dx: Hemorrhage from coagulation factor deficiency or anticoagulation
ddx.vs: Imaging cannot separate causes; PT/aPTT, factor assays and platelet function testing distinguish a coagulopathy from a platelet function disorder.

65917.recognize_zh: A/B 圖的母細胞中等大小、細胞質少至中量淡藍色、無顆粒，染色質呈塊狀粗糙（blocky），核仁不明顯，外觀像成熟淋巴球而非典型母細胞；C 圖部分核型顯示 der(4) 與 der(12)，D 圖 ETV6 分離探針出現分開的紅綠訊號，提示 ETV6 重排。
features: Medium-sized blasts with moderate N:C ratio and pale blue agranular cytoplasm (A, B)
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with coarse, blocky clumped chromatin mimicking mature lymphocytes; nucleoli inconspicuous
Occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles; no Auer rods seen
Partial G-banded karyotype showing der(4) and der(12) of t(4;12)(q12;p13) (C)
ETV6 break-apart FISH with separated 5' and 3' signals in interphase and metaphase cells (D)
65917.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows medium-sized blasts with pale blue agranular cytoplasm and round to slightly irregular nuclei with unusually coarse, blocky chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, imparting a pseudo-lymphoid appearance. No Auer rods are identified. Partial karyotype demonstrates der(4) and der(12) consistent with t(4;12)(q12;p13), and ETV6 break-apart FISH shows split signals indicating ETV6 rearrangement. Because morphology alone mimics a mature lymphoid neoplasm, immunophenotyping is essential; with the reported CD34+/CD13+/CD33+/CD117+ blasts, findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with ETV6 rearrangement (ETV6::CHIC2 by RNA sequencing).

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia or other mature B-cell leukemia
ddx.vs: CLL cells are small with scant cytoplasm and soccer-ball chromatin and are CD19+/CD5+/CD23+, whereas these blasts are CD34+/CD117+ myeloid by flow.
Morphology overlaps, but the blasts lack CD19/CD79a/cCD3 and express CD13, CD33 and CD117, establishing myeloid lineage.
t(4;12) with ETV6 FISH split suggested ETV6::PDGFRA, but RNA sequencing showed ETV6::CHIC2 and there is no eosinophilia.

65789.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀圖，不是形態學影像：先圈 CD7 強陽性、低側散射的 T 細胞，再依 CD8 分成 F（CD8 陰/弱）與 H（CD8 強）兩群；兩群的 TRBC1 都分成陽性與陰性兩個群落，屬多株（polytypic）αβ T 細胞模式。TRBC1 只標記 αβ T 細胞，γδ T 細胞應完全陰性。
features: Top left: CD7-bright, low side scatter lymphocyte gate (7vsSSC) separated from CD7-negative granulocytes
Top right: CD7 versus CD8 with gate F (CD8 negative to dim) and gate H (CD8 bright)
Bottom left (gate F): TRBC1 shows two discrete clusters, TRBC1-negative and TRBC1-positive, of comparable size
Bottom right (gate H): TRBC1 likewise bimodal with both negative and positive clusters
A bimodal TRBC1 distribution indicates polytypic alpha-beta T cells; a monotypic population would be uniformly positive or uniformly negative
65789.describe_en: This figure shows flow cytometry plots rather than a morphologic image. After gating CD7-bright, low side scatter T cells, the CD8-negative/dim (F) and CD8-bright (H) subsets were each assessed for TRBC1. Both subsets show two well-separated TRBC1-negative and TRBC1-positive clusters of roughly similar proportion, a pattern consistent with polytypic alpha-beta T cells without evidence of TRBC1 restriction in these gates. Because TRBC1 is expressed only on alpha-beta T cells, a gamma-delta neoplasm such as hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma would be TRBC1 negative and should be evaluated with TCR gamma-delta staining on the abnormal population.

ddx.dx: Clonal alpha-beta T-cell population (e.g. T-LGL leukemia, PTCL)
ddx.vs: A clonal alpha-beta population shows a single uniformly TRBC1-positive or uniformly TRBC1-negative cluster, or a skewed ratio outside the normal range.
Gamma-delta T cells lack TRBC1 entirely, so they are identified by TCR gamma-delta positivity rather than by a TRBC1 ratio.
Reactive expansions retain a bimodal TRBC1 distribution with a positive-to-negative ratio within the reference range, as seen here.

65021.recognize_zh: 膝部 X 光片可見遠端股骨骨幹/幹骺端有數個邊界清楚的卵圓形透亮溶骨病灶，周圍有細薄硬化邊緣，股骨髁附近亦有類似透亮區；多發、邊界清楚的溶骨性病灶配合皮疹與骨髓發現，符合蘭格漢斯細胞組織球增生症。
features: Radiograph of the knee (distal femur, patella region and proximal tibia) displayed horizontally
Multiple well-defined oval lytic lesions in the distal femoral diaphysis and metaphysis
Thin sclerotic rims around the lesions (geographic, non-aggressive pattern)
Additional lucent lesion near the distal femoral condyle/epiphyseal region
No visible pathologic fracture or aggressive periosteal reaction; image photographed from a screen
65021.describe_en: Plain radiograph of the knee shows multiple well-circumscribed oval lytic lesions in the distal femoral diaphysis and metaphysis with thin sclerotic margins, and an additional lucency near the distal femoral condyle. The lesions have a geographic, non-aggressive appearance without obvious pathologic fracture or periosteal reaction. Image quality is limited because the film was photographed from a display. In a patient with skin rash and Langerhans cells in the bone marrow, these multifocal lytic lesions are consistent with multisystem Langerhans cell histiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Myeloma lesions are punched-out without sclerotic rims and occur in older adults, with plasma cells rather than Langerhans cells on biopsy.
Infection is usually solitary with thick reactive sclerosis and clinical signs of infection.
Metastases tend to be permeative or ill-defined, and biopsy shows carcinoma or small round blue cells rather than Langerhans cells.
Fibrous dysplasia shows ground-glass matrix and bone expansion rather than punched-out lucencies.

65725.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片幾乎被寬大、形狀不規則的骨小樑占據，骨小樑間的髓腔被紡錘狀纖維母細胞呈流水狀（streaming）排列的疏鬆纖維組織取代，造血細胞僅剩少量小群，提示小樑旁纖維化。
features: Broad, irregular and anastomosing bony trabeculae occupying most of the core
Intertrabecular spaces filled by loose fibrous stroma with spindle cells arranged in a streaming pattern
Fibrosis concentrated along trabecular surfaces (paratrabecular)
Markedly reduced hematopoietic elements, present only as small scattered clusters
No infiltrating tumor cells or granulomas identified at this magnification
65725.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows markedly thickened, irregular bony trabeculae that occupy much of the specimen. The narrowed intertrabecular spaces are largely replaced by loose fibrous tissue composed of spindle cells in a streaming arrangement, accentuated along trabecular surfaces, with only small residual clusters of hematopoietic cells. No metastatic tumor or granulomas are seen. In an infant with radiographically dense bones, these findings of osteosclerosis with paratrabecular fibrosis and reduced hematopoiesis are supportive of osteopetrosis.

ddx.vs: PMF shows clustered atypical megakaryocytes and dilated sinusoids with intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis, and occurs in adults rather than infants.
Hyperparathyroid bone shows dissecting (tunneling) osteoclastic resorption with peritrabecular fibrosis and abundant osteoid, with abnormal calcium/PTH.
Desmoplastic metastases contain cohesive atypical epithelial or tumor cells within the fibrosis, which keratin stains highlight.
Paget bone shows a mosaic pattern of irregular cement lines and focal disease in older adults rather than diffuse sclerosis in an infant.

65661.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 H&E 看似正常三系造血，但 TCR-delta 免疫染色顯示陽性小 T 細胞呈線狀排列於血竇內（sinusoidal pattern），流式可見 TCRγδ 陽性族群，TRG PCR 出現單株峰；這種組合易誤判為肝脾 T 細胞淋巴瘤，本例實為 Babesia 感染引起的反應性增生。
features: H&E bone marrow biopsy: normocellular to mildly hypercellular trilineage hematopoiesis without an obvious atypical infiltrate
TCR-delta IHC: small positive lymphocytes arranged in linear chains within marrow sinusoids
Flow cytometry: distinct CD3+ TCRgammadelta+ population (yellow) that is CD5-dim/partially decreased relative to alpha-beta T cells
Capillary electrophoresis of TRG PCR: two discrete clonal peaks (~174 and ~202 bp)
65661.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows trilineage hematopoiesis without a morphologically conspicuous lymphoid infiltrate on H&E. Immunohistochemistry for TCR-delta highlights an increased population of small gamma-delta T cells with a predominantly intrasinusoidal distribution. Flow cytometry confirms an expanded CD3+ gamma-delta T-cell population, and PCR fragment analysis demonstrates clonal TRG rearrangement peaks. Although the sinusoidal pattern and clonality raise concern for hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma, the absence of cytologic atypia, i(7q) and immunophenotypic aberrancy, together with PCR-proven babesiosis and resolution after treatment, support a reactive clonal gamma-delta T-cell proliferation secondary to infection.

ddx.vs: Shows cytologically atypical medium-sized sinusoidal gamma-delta T cells, often CD5-negative/CD56+, with isochromosome 7q or trisomy 8, and does not regress with treating an infection.

ddx.dx: T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia (gamma-delta type)
ddx.vs: Persistent circulating LGLs with cytoplasmic azurophilic granules, CD57/CD16 expression and frequent STAT3 mutation, with interstitial rather than predominantly sinusoidal marrow infiltration.
Would show a cyclin D1+/SOX11+ CD5+ B-cell infiltrate rather than CD3+ TCR-delta+ T cells.

65661.stain: H&E; IHC: TCR-delta; flow; TRG PCR

65533.recognize_zh: 中央這顆細胞比旁邊的中性球大三倍以上，細胞質深藍、邊緣可見小突起，核大而圓，染色質開放，核內可見淡色圓形包涵體樣區域（intranuclear inclusion）。背景以顆粒球為主、紅血球前驅細胞少，符合 parvovirus B19 的巨大原紅血球。
features: Isolated giant cell about three times the diameter of neighboring neutrophils
Large round nucleus with open, finely granular chromatin and pale rounded intranuclear inclusion-like areas
Rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a small peripheral cytoplasmic bleb
Surrounding aspirate rich in maturing neutrophils and myelocytes with few normoblasts
Background red cells show focal rouleaux/overlap artifact
65533.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle-adjacent field composed mainly of maturing granulocytic precursors and neutrophils, with few recognizable maturing erythroid precursors. A giant proerythroblast is seen centrally, with a large round nucleus, open chromatin containing pale intranuclear inclusion-like areas, and a rim of intensely basophilic cytoplasm with a small peripheral bleb. Findings are consistent with a parvovirus B19-associated giant proerythroblast in the setting of pure red cell aplasia.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic marrows are erythroid-hyperplastic with abundant maturing megaloblasts and giant metamyelocytes, rather than erythroid aplasia with isolated giant pronormoblasts.
Erythroid leukemia shows a dominant population of neoplastic pronormoblasts rather than rare giant cells among normal granulocytic maturation.
Plasmablasts have eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and a prominent single nucleolus, not a central round nucleus with glassy inclusion-like areas.
MDS shows multinuclearity, nuclear budding and ring sideroblasts across maturing erythroid stages, rather than selective loss of erythroid maturation with giant proerythroblasts.

exam.answer_en: Parvovirus B19-associated giant proerythroblast — large cell with open chromatin, pale intranuclear inclusion and basophilic cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：核內淡色圓形區域為考點，考官問是核仁還是病毒包涵體；B19 的核內包涵體形似核仁，是辨識巨大原紅血球的關鍵。
骨髓 M:E 比例因紅系缺乏而明顯升高；巨大原紅血球數量通常少，需掃全片尋找。
PRCA 其他原因要一併考慮：thymoma、large granular lymphocytic leukemia、藥物、ABO-incompatible 移植。
確診工具：血清或骨髓 parvovirus B19 PCR，骨髓切片 IHC/ISH。
exam.pitfall_zh: 巨大細胞配核內淡色區易被當成含明顯核仁的 blast（AML/淋巴瘤）；B19 細胞周緣有細胞質突起、深藍細胞質，且背景是紅系缺乏而非母細胞增加。

quiz.q: 此細胞核內淡色圓形區域代表什麼？背景細胞組成有何特點？
quiz.a: Parvovirus B19 intranuclear inclusion；以顆粒球為主，成熟中的紅系前驅細胞稀少。

65341.recognize_zh: 淋巴結低倍下呈被纖維組織包圍的結節狀結構，類似結節硬化型何杰金淋巴瘤；高倍可見散在大型、核不規則且帶透亮空暈的大細胞，CD30 強陽性並集中於結節內，ALK 呈細胞質與細胞核染色，支持 ALK 陽性間變性大細胞淋巴瘤的 Hodgkin-like pattern。
features: Panel A: CT shows mildly enlarged submandibular lymph nodes (arrowheads)
Panel B: nodal architecture replaced by vague lymphoid nodules separated by fibrotic bands, mimicking nodular sclerosis
Panel C: scattered large cells with irregular vesicular nuclei and retraction halos among small lymphocytes
Panel D: CD30 highlights large cells clustering within nodules
Panel E: ALK staining with cytoplasmic and nuclear positivity in large cells
65341.describe_en: Composite figure. CT imaging shows mild submandibular lymphadenopathy. The lymph node biopsy shows effacement by lymphoid nodules separated by fibrous bands, reminiscent of nodular sclerosis classic Hodgkin lymphoma. At high power, scattered large cells with irregular nuclei, vesicular chromatin and lacunar-like retraction halos are present within a background of small lymphocytes. The large cells are strongly CD30-positive, clustered within the nodules, and express ALK with nuclear and cytoplasmic staining. Findings are consistent with ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma with a Hodgkin-like pattern.

ddx.vs: HRS cells are CD30+CD15+ with weak PAX5 and ALK-negative, whereas these large cells are ALK+, PAX5-negative and express EMA and cytotoxic markers.
Morphology overlaps, but ALK immunostaining and ALK FISH rearrangement define the ALK-positive entity.

ddx.dx: EBV-positive or T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Large B cells express CD20 and PAX5 and are ALK-negative, unlike the T/null phenotype here.

65277.recognize_zh: 視野中央有一顆大型多核細胞，含四個大小相近、染色質細緻的圓形核，細胞質深藍色並有小泡狀突起，這是多核的前紅血球母細胞（multinucleated pronormoblast），屬於紅血球系發育異常（dyserythropoiesis）。
features: Large multinucleated cell with four round nuclei of similar size
Finely granular chromatin with faint nucleoli
Deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm with small surface blebs, typical of early erythroid precursors
Separate basophilic erythroblast/pronormoblast with cytoplasmic blebs and a small orthochromatic normoblast nearby
Occasional granulocytic cells in a thin area with dispersed red cells
65277.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large multinucleated cell containing four round nuclei with finely granular chromatin and deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm with small surface blebs, consistent with a multinucleated pronormoblast. A separate mononuclear basophilic erythroid precursor and a small orthochromatic normoblast are also present. Although labeled as H&E, the staining pattern is Romanowsky-type. In the context of a complex karyotype with TP53 loss, findings are consistent with erythroid dysplasia in a myelodysplastic neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single lobulated nucleus and granular pink-lilac cytoplasm, not multiple separate round nuclei with deep blue cytoplasm.
Osteoclasts are much larger with many separated uniform nuclei and abundant granular pink-blue cytoplasm.
Giant pronormoblasts are usually mononuclear with large glassy intranuclear inclusions and occur with red cell aplasia rather than multinuclearity with a complex karyotype.
CDA II shows mostly binucleate late normoblasts in a young patient with a normal karyotype, rather than a multinucleated early precursor with clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.

65085.recognize_zh: 這是胸部顯影 CT 軸切面，箭頭指向左側胸椎旁一個約 1.1 公分、邊界清楚、低密度的橢圓形病灶，可能為壞死淋巴結；影像本身不具診斷特異性，Castleman 病需靠淋巴結切片確診。
features: Axial contrast-enhanced chest CT at the level of the aortic arch/tracheal carina region
1.1 cm oval, well-circumscribed, low-attenuation lesion in the left paraspinal (posterior mediastinal) region (arrow)
No bulky mediastinal or axillary lymphadenopathy evident on this single slice
Lungs clear on the displayed window; bones without obvious destructive lesion
65085.describe_en: Axial contrast-enhanced CT image of the chest demonstrates a 1.1 cm oval, well-circumscribed, low-density lesion in the left thoracic paraspinal region adjacent to the descending aorta and vertebral body, which may represent a necrotic or low-attenuation lymph node. No bulky lymphadenopathy is seen on this single slice. The imaging appearance is nonspecific; in idiopathic multicentric Castleman disease, CT typically shows multistation, mildly enlarged enhancing lymph nodes, and the diagnosis requires excisional lymph node biopsy with exclusion of infectious, autoimmune and neoplastic mimics.

ddx.vs: Imaging cannot separate them; lymphoma usually shows larger, confluent nodal masses with higher FDG avidity, and biopsy with immunophenotyping is required.
Necrotic low-density nodes with rim enhancement favor TB, confirmed by granulomatous necrosis and mycobacterial studies on biopsy.
Paraspinal schwannomas are low-density, well-circumscribed masses related to the neural foramen, distinguished by MRI and S100-positive spindle cells histologically.
Necrotic nodal metastases usually occur with a known primary and are confirmed by keratin-positive tumor on biopsy.

64957.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片幾乎全是漿細胞：細胞核偏心、細胞質嗜鹼性並有核旁淡染區（hof），但許多細胞體積較大、核質比高、染色質較細緻，偶見雙核與形狀不規則的核，屬於不典型（未成熟／漿母細胞樣）漿細胞，符合多發性骨髓瘤。
features: Sheets of plasma cells replacing normal hematopoietic elements
Medium to large cells with eccentric round nuclei and moderate basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof
Atypical features: increased N:C ratio, finer dispersed chromatin, nuclear size variation and occasional irregular or indented nuclei
Scattered binucleate forms and a few cells with scant cytoplasm (plasmablastic-appearing)
Background of red cells with rouleaux-like stacking and scant other marrow elements
64957.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is dominated by plasma cells, with near-total replacement of normal hematopoiesis in this field. The plasma cells have eccentric nuclei, basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hofs, but many are enlarged with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, finer chromatin, nuclear pleomorphism, occasional binucleation and irregular nuclear contours. Red cells in the background show rouleaux-like stacking. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with atypical (immature) plasma cell morphology; clonality should be confirmed by flow cytometry or light chain studies, and cytogenetic/FISH risk stratification is warranted.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are small, mature and usually <10-20% of marrow cells, without nuclear atypia or sheets, and are polytypic for kappa and lambda.

Plasmablastic lymphoma cells are larger immunoblastic cells with prominent central nucleoli, high Ki-67 and frequent EBER positivity, typically in immunocompromised hosts, without the serum M-protein and lytic bone disease of myeloma.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with CD20-positive B cells and MYD88 L265P, usually with an IgM paraprotein rather than IgG kappa.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell myeloma — sheets of atypical immature/plasmablastic-appearing plasma cells replacing the marrow
pearls_zh: 考法：整片幾乎都是漿細胞時，考官會問比例意義；clonal BM plasma cells ≥60% 本身即為 SLiM 的 myeloma-defining event，不需等 CRAB。
不典型型態（核仁明顯、染色質細、N:C 比高、雙核）與較高增殖及較差預後相關；plasmablastic morphology 在舊分級中屬高危型態。
高腫瘤負荷時需注意腎功能（light chain cast nephropathy）、高血鈣、高黏稠症候群（IgA/IgG 高濃度時）及腫瘤溶解風險。
Rouleaux 樣堆疊在骨髓抹片出現時支持高 M-protein；須以 SPEP、immunofixation 與 serum FLC 量化，並以 FISH 做風險分層。
exam.pitfall_zh: 未成熟漿細胞易被誤認為 blasts（AML）或大細胞淋巴瘤；靠偏心核、深藍細胞質與 perinuclear hof，並以 CD138、cytoplasmic light chain 限制確認。

quiz.q: 骨髓 clonal plasma cells 佔 92%，即使沒有 CRAB 症狀是否可診斷 multiple myeloma？依據為何？
quiz.a: 可以；clonal BMPC ≥60% 屬 SLiM myeloma-defining event。

64701.recognize_zh: 中央是一個細胞質淡灰、帶小空泡的巨噬細胞（nurse cell），周圍環繞一圈大小逐漸變小、細胞質由深藍（basophilic）到灰藍（polychromatic）的有核紅血球，排列成島狀，即紅血球生成島。
features: Central macrophage with pale, ill-defined gray cytoplasm and a clear vacuole; its nucleus is not clearly resolved
Surrounding rosette of erythroid precursors at different stages of maturation
Basophilic erythroblasts: larger cells with deeply blue cytoplasm and coarse, checkered chromatin
Polychromatic erythroblasts: smaller cells with gray-blue cytoplasm and more condensed round nuclei
Two pink granular cytoplasmic fragments within the island (likely macrophage cytoplasm/platelet material) and a small platelet clump at right
64701.describe_en: The bone marrow aspirate smear shows an erythroblastic island composed of a central macrophage with pale, vacuolated cytoplasm surrounded by a ring of nucleated erythroid precursors. The erythroid cells show orderly maturation from larger basophilic erythroblasts with deeply blue cytoplasm to smaller polychromatic erythroblasts with gray-blue cytoplasm and condensed round nuclei. No megaloblastic change, nuclear budding, or multinucleation is evident. Findings are consistent with a normal erythroblastic island (nurse cell), the functional unit supporting erythroid maturation and nuclear extrusion.

ddx.vs: Tumor clusters are cohesive with nuclear molding, pleomorphism, and prominent nucleoli, whereas this island shows a stepwise erythroid maturation sequence around a histiocyte.
Hemophagocytosis shows intact cells engulfed within the macrophage cytoplasm, whereas here erythroblasts are arranged around the macrophage rather than inside it.
Lymphocytes have scant pale blue cytoplasm and lack the deep basophilia and progressive hemoglobinization of erythroid precursors.
Megaloblastic precursors are larger with open, finely stippled chromatin and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, unlike the normally condensed nuclei here.

exam.answer_en: Normal erythroblastic island — central macrophage (nurse cell) surrounded by erythroblasts showing orderly basophilic-to-polychromatic maturation
pearls_zh: 考法：指中央淡灰色、帶空泡的大細胞問「這是什麼？功能？」——答 central macrophage（nurse cell），周圍為成熟階段依序排列的有核紅血球。
功能重點：中央巨噬細胞提供鐵與生長訊號給紅系前驅細胞，並吞噬紅血球脫核後排出的核（pyrenocyte）。
判讀意義：島內紅系細胞「成熟順序正常、無 megaloblastic change 或多核/核出芽」代表紅系造血正常；抹片上成島多見於紅系增生（如溶血、出血後）。
鐵染色時中央巨噬細胞可見含鐵血黃素，是評估骨髓儲存鐵的觀察位置之一。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易被誤認為轉移腫瘤細胞團或噬血現象；紅血球生成島的紅系細胞排列在巨噬細胞「周圍」且呈階梯式成熟，噬血現象則是完整細胞被吞進巨噬細胞「內部」。

quiz.q: 圖中被一圈有核紅血球包圍的中央大細胞是什麼細胞？它與周圍細胞構成的結構叫什麼？
quiz.a: Central macrophage (nurse cell)；erythroblastic island

64637.recognize_zh: 密集紅血球背景中有一條遠大於血球、蜿蜒捲曲的紫紅色長條蟲體，體內核柱深染，尾端可見一段較淡的粉紅色延伸（可能為鞘膜），即周邊血液中的微絲蚴（microfilaria）；此倍率無法看清尾端細胞核分布以分辨種別。
features: Single elongated, serpiginous worm-like organism many times longer than a red cell diameter
Body stains deep magenta-purple with a dense column of nuclei not individually resolvable at this magnification
One end shows a paler pink segmented/striated extension, possibly the sheath, with a frayed opposite end
Body shows several kinks and tight curves
Background of densely packed red cells with scattered neutrophils and platelets
64637.describe_en: Giemsa-stained peripheral blood smear shows, against a dense background of red cells, a single elongated, serpiginous microfilaria with a deeply stained magenta-purple body containing a dense column of nuclei. A paler pink, faintly segmented extension is seen at one end, possibly representing a stained sheath, and the body has several kinks. Scattered neutrophils and platelets are present. Findings are consistent with microfilaremia; species identification (e.g., Wuchereria bancrofti, Brugia malayi, Loa loa) requires higher-magnification assessment of the sheath, cephalic space and tail nuclei, or antigen/PCR testing.

ddx.vs: W. bancrofti is sheathed with a sheath that stains poorly with Giemsa, has gentle smooth curves and a tapered tail free of nuclei.
B. malayi has a sheath that stains pink with Giemsa, a kinky body, and two separate terminal nuclei in the tail.
Loa loa is sheathed with an unstained sheath on Giemsa, shows diurnal periodicity, and has nuclei extending continuously to the tail tip.
Fibers are refractile, uniformly structured and lack an internal column of nuclei, whereas the organism shows a nucleated body with tapered ends.

exam.answer_en: Microfilaremia — sheathed-appearing microfilaria with a nucleated body column in a Giemsa-stained blood smear (species not determinable at this power)
pearls_zh: 考法：指這條蟲體問「是什麼？怎麼分種？」——答 microfilaria；分種看有無鞘膜、頭端空間、尾端細胞核是否延伸到尾尖。
分種重點：W. bancrofti 有鞘、Giemsa 鞘不易著色、尾端無核；B. malayi 鞘染粉紅、尾端有兩顆分離核；Loa loa 有鞘、核延伸至尾尖；Mansonella 無鞘。
採血時間：W. bancrofti 與 B. malayi 多為夜間週期性，應於夜間採血；Loa loa 為白天週期性。低蟲量可用 thick smear 或 Knott 濃縮法、抗原或 PCR 檢測。
治療注意：diethylcarbamazine（DEC）在高 Loa loa 蟲量時可誘發腦病變，在合併 onchocerciasis 時禁用；治療前須確認蟲種與蟲量。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把纖維、棉絮或 fibrin 條誤認為微絲蚴；異物無內部細胞核柱、會反光且結構一致，微絲蚴則有排列成柱的深染細胞核與漸細的兩端。

quiz.q: 血片中這條長形生物是什麼？區分 Wuchereria bancrofti 與 Brugia malayi 最常看哪個部位？
quiz.a: Microfilaria；尾端細胞核分布（B. malayi 尾端有兩顆分離核，W. bancrofti 尾端無核）與鞘膜染色

64573.recognize_zh: 一大團嗜中性球（加上一個單核球）被密密麻麻的血小板黏附覆蓋，形成白血球–血小板聚集團，背景游離血小板很少，符合血小板衛星現象合併聚集。
features: Large aggregate of about a dozen segmented neutrophils and one monocyte-like cell
Innumerable platelets adherent to and interspersed among the leukocytes
Leukocyte nuclei show normal segmentation; cytoplasm without toxic change
Few free platelets elsewhere in the field
Red cells normochromic, arranged loosely in the background
64573.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large leukocyte-platelet aggregate composed of numerous segmented neutrophils and a monocyte-like cell, extensively coated by adherent platelets. A smaller satellitism cluster is present to the right. Free platelets in the background are scant, and red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with platelet satellitism with leukocyte-platelet aggregation, which can produce spurious thrombocytopenia and occasionally spurious leukopenia on automated counts.

ddx.vs: Clumps consist of platelets alone rather than platelets rosetting around leukocytes, though both are anticoagulant-induced artifacts.
Leukoagglutination forms neutrophil clumps without the dense coating of platelets seen here.

ddx.dx: Thick smear edge or feathered-edge accumulation
ddx.vs: Cells pushed to the feathered edge are not bound together by platelets and are accompanied by distorted, crowded red cells.

64509.recognize_zh: 鼻腔分泌物抹片中布滿大量顆粒性白血球，多數為雙葉或偏位核、細胞質帶粉橘色顆粒的嗜酸性球，背景是淡紫色黏液絲，大量嗜酸性球符合過敏性鼻炎。
features: Numerous granulocytes, many with bilobed or eccentric dense nuclei
Cytoplasm with pink-orange granular staining consistent with eosinophils
Cells scattered singly and in small clusters
Mucoid, fibrillary pale purple background with a few epithelial/degenerated cells
Image is at low magnification with limited focus, so individual granules are not crisply resolved
64509.describe_en: Smear of nasal secretions shows numerous granulocytes dispersed singly and in small clusters within a mucoid fibrillary background. Most cells have bilobed or eccentric nuclei and cytoplasm with pink-orange granular staining consistent with eosinophils; granule detail is limited at this magnification. Few epithelial cells are present. Findings are consistent with nasal eosinophilia, supporting allergic rhinitis in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: Neutrophils have multilobed nuclei and pale lilac cytoplasm without orange granules and are often accompanied by bacteria.
NARES shows the same nasal eosinophilia, so separation requires negative skin-prick or specific IgE testing rather than morphology.
Basophils and mast cells have dark blue-purple metachromatic granules rather than orange-pink eosinophilic granules.

64381.recognize_zh: 三張圖中的分葉核中性球外圍都被一圈緊貼細胞膜的血小板環繞（platelet rosetting），這種血小板衛星現象是 EDTA 引起的體外假象，也是假性血小板低下的原因之一。
features: Segmented neutrophils encircled by a complete or near-complete rim of adherent platelets
Platelets are normal in size and granularity, individually discernible around the cell membrane
Neutrophil nuclei and cytoplasmic granulation otherwise unremarkable
Occasional small platelet aggregates in the background
Red cells normocytic, normochromic
64381.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several segmented neutrophils surrounded by rosettes of adherent, normal-appearing platelets. Neutrophil morphology is otherwise unremarkable, and small platelet clumps are present in the background. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic. Findings are consistent with platelet satellitism, an in vitro EDTA-dependent phenomenon that can cause spurious thrombocytopenia; a repeat count in citrate or heparin, or a fingerstick smear, is recommended.

ddx.vs: Platelet clumping forms free-lying aggregates in the smear and feathered edge rather than rosettes adhering around neutrophils, though both may coexist.
Platelet phagocytosis shows platelets inside the neutrophil cytoplasm, sometimes within vacuoles, rather than attached to the outer membrane.
Toxic granules lie within the cytoplasm and are finer and uniformly distributed, rather than discrete platelet-sized bodies around the cell border.
Bacteria or yeast are uniform in shape and lack the granular purple centers of platelets.

exam.answer_en: Platelet satellitism — rosettes of normal platelets adherent around neutrophils, an EDTA-dependent in vitro artifact causing pseudothrombocytopenia
pearls_zh: 考法：儀器報告血小板低但病人無出血，抹片中性球周圍一圈血小板；問現象名稱與處置。
機轉：EDTA 存在下，自體抗體使血小板 GPIIb/IIIa 與中性球 FcγRIII（CD16）結合形成 rosette，屬體外現象、無臨床意義。
處置：改用 citrate 或 heparin 抗凝管重新計數、或指尖血直接抹片；避免誤診血小板低下而做不必要的檢查或輸注血小板。
常與 EDTA 引起的血小板凝集並存；報告時應註明 platelet satellitism，提醒血小板計數可能偽低。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易被判為真性血小板低下或中性球吞噬血小板；衛星血小板在細胞膜外環繞且形態正常，改用 citrate 管重算血小板數通常正常。

quiz.q: 發現此現象時，應改用哪種抗凝劑重新採血計數血小板？
quiz.a: Sodium citrate（或 heparin），不用 EDTA。

64317.recognize_zh: 四格嗜中性球中，核為不分葉的圓形/腎形或僅有凹陷（類似骨髓球或後骨髓球），但染色質卻高度凝集成熟，是假性 Pelger-Huët 異常；細胞質內另有一至數顆脫離核的圓形深紫色小顆粒，即 Howell-Jolly 樣包涵體。
features: Neutrophils with hyposegmented nuclei: indented/kidney-shaped (A, D) or non-lobated oval (B, C)
Coarsely clumped, mature chromatin discordant with the immature nuclear shape
One to three small, round, dense basophilic nuclear fragments detached in the cytoplasm (Howell-Jolly-like inclusions)
Cytoplasm with normal fine neutrophilic granulation; no toxic granulation or vacuoles
Background red cells normochromic with a few target cells and crenated forms
64317.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, shown in four high-power panels, demonstrates neutrophils with hyposegmented nuclei that are either non-lobated or only indented, but with coarsely condensed mature chromatin, consistent with pseudo-Pelger-Huet change. Several of these cells, and an otherwise lobated neutrophil, contain one or more small round dense basophilic nuclear fragments in the cytoplasm resembling Howell-Jolly bodies. Cytoplasmic granulation is preserved, and the red cells show only mild nonspecific poikilocytosis. Findings are consistent with acquired pseudo-Pelger-Huet anomaly with Howell-Jolly-like inclusions, which in a transplant recipient on mycophenolate and tacrolimus supports a drug-induced dysplastic change, although a myelodysplastic neoplasm should be excluded if cytopenias persist after drug modification.

ddx.vs: MDS may show identical neutrophil dysplasia, so separation requires the clinical context, resolution after withdrawal of the offending drug, marrow examination and cytogenetic/molecular studies.
Congenital Pelger-Huet affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly with bilobed spectacle nuclei, is familial (LBR mutation), and lacks Howell-Jolly-like inclusions or cytopenias.
True myelocytes and metamyelocytes have finer, less condensed chromatin and more basophilic cytoplasm, whereas these cells have mature clumped chromatin.
Ingested debris is irregular and sits within vacuoles, whereas Howell-Jolly-like bodies are smooth, round, dense chromatin fragments without a surrounding vacuole.

exam.answer_en: Acquired pseudo-Pelger-Huët neutrophils with Howell-Jolly-like inclusions — dysgranulopoiesis, favored drug-induced (mycophenolate/tacrolimus) vs MDS
pearls_zh: 考法：指中性球細胞質內脫離的深紫色小圓點問名稱：Howell-Jolly-like inclusions，屬 dysgranulopoiesis 表現。
中性球 Howell-Jolly-like bodies 可見於器官移植後免疫抑制（如 mycophenolate）、HIV 感染、化療，也可見於 MDS。
藥物誘發者停藥或減量後可恢復；若血球低下持續，應做骨髓檢查、核型與基因檢測以排除 MDS。
判讀 dysplasia 應用新鮮 EDTA 血儘快抹片，檢體放置過久會產生核形態假象。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易直接診斷 MDS 或誤為吞噬碎片；應先查用藥史，HJ-like 包涵體是平滑圓形緻密染色質、無周圍空泡，吞噬物則不規則且位於空泡內。

quiz.q: 這位移植病人中性球異常最可能的非腫瘤性原因是什麼？
quiz.a: 免疫抑制藥物（mycophenolate mofetil、tacrolimus）引起。

64189.recognize_zh: 單核球大小的細胞，核呈腎形／摺疊，細胞質淡藍灰色，其中有一顆明顯的紅紫色大顆粒狀包涵體（giant azurophilic granule），提示 Chediak-Higashi 症候群的溶小體融合顆粒。
features: Mononuclear cell slightly larger than a red cell with a folded, kidney-shaped nucleus
Moderately condensed, lacy-to-clumped chromatin without visible nucleoli
Pale blue-gray cytoplasm with a single discrete, round, red-purple azurophilic inclusion
Absence of the fine dust-like granules of a typical monocyte in most of the cytoplasm
Background normochromic red cells with occasional crenated forms and normal platelets
64189.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mononuclear cell with a folded, kidney-shaped nucleus and pale blue-gray cytoplasm containing a single large, discrete azurophilic inclusion. The cell is relatively small for a monocyte, and a lymphoid cell with an indented nucleus cannot be fully excluded on this single image. Background red cells and platelets are unremarkable apart from occasional crenated forms. In the context of other leukocytes with giant granules, this finding is consistent with the abnormal fused lysosomal granules of Chediak-Higashi syndrome.

ddx.vs: LGLs contain several fine to coarse azurophilic granules in abundant pale cytoplasm with a round nucleus, rather than a single oversized inclusion.
Alder-Reilly shows numerous dense dark granules diffusely filling the cytoplasm of all leukocyte types, not a single giant granule.
Pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules occur in dysplastic or leukemic myeloid cells with accompanying blasts or dysplasia, in an adult with an acquired neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Phagocytosed material (e.g., ingested red cell fragment or debris)
ddx.vs: Phagocytosed material usually sits within a vacuole and has variable size and color, whereas CHS granules are uniform, azurophilic, and present in multiple lineages.

exam.answer_en: Chediak-Higashi syndrome — monocyte with a giant, discrete azurophilic (fused lysosomal) granule
pearls_zh: 考法：指單核球內的大紅紫色顆粒問意義；答 giant azurophilic granule，多系白血球都出現時指向 Chediak-Higashi syndrome。
遺傳：LYST 基因突變，autosomal recessive，造成溶小體／分泌顆粒融合與運輸異常。
臨床三聯：partial oculocutaneous albinism（銀灰髮）、反覆化膿性感染、出血傾向（血小板 dense granule 缺乏）；後期周邊神經病變。
Accelerated phase 為 HLH 樣表現，是主要死因；allogeneic HSCT 可矯正血液與免疫異常，但不能阻止神經退化。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為 AML/MDS 的 pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granule 或被吞噬的碎屑：CHS 為先天、多系成熟白血球皆有巨大顆粒；pseudo-CH 見於腫瘤性 blast/顆粒球，吞噬物則形狀不規則。

quiz.q: 此單核球內巨大嗜天青顆粒所代表的症候群是哪個基因突變？
quiz.a: LYST（Chediak-Higashi syndrome，AR）。

64125.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，骨小樑顯著增厚、互相融合連接，骨質佔據大部分切片，並可見不規則的膠合線（cement lines）；殘存骨髓腔狹窄，只剩纖維血管性基質而幾乎沒有造血細胞，符合骨硬化（osteosclerosis），可解釋慢性腎病病人的全血球減少。
features: Markedly thickened, irregular, anastomosing bony trabeculae occupying most of the core
Irregular cement lines and woven-to-lamellar remodeling pattern
Narrow residual marrow spaces filled with fibrovascular stroma
Near absence of hematopoietic cells and fat
Scattered osteocytes within lacunae
64125.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of the bone marrow core biopsy shows marked osteosclerosis with thickened, irregular, and anastomosing bony trabeculae containing irregular cement lines that occupy the majority of the specimen. The residual intertrabecular spaces are narrow and filled with loose fibrovascular stroma, with near-complete absence of hematopoietic elements. Findings are consistent with osteosclerosis with marrow fibrosis and hematopoietic depletion, which in a patient with chronic kidney disease is attributable to renal osteodystrophy and explains the pancytopenia.

ddx.vs: PMF shows clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with dilated sinusoids and intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis, and JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation.
Metastatic carcinoma shows keratin-positive tumor nests within the fibrotic intertrabecular spaces.
Paget disease shows a mosaic cement-line pattern with bizarre osteoclasts and is usually focal rather than diffuse with a CKD context.
Osteopetrosis has persistent calcified cartilage cores within trabeculae in a young patient with a genetic osteoclast defect.

64061.recognize_zh: 脾臟切面佈滿無數大小一致、約 1–3 mm 的淡褐白色小結節，均勻散佈在暗紅褐色紅髓背景中，呈粟粒狀（miliary）多結節外觀，代表白髓擴大，符合脾邊緣區淋巴瘤。
features: Gross cut section of an enlarged spleen with intact smooth capsule
Innumerable uniform, small (about 1–3 mm) tan-white nodules distributed evenly throughout the parenchyma
Dark red-brown intervening red pulp background
No large confluent tumor masses, infarcts or hemorrhagic foci evident
Hilar vessel notch visible centrally
64061.describe_en: Gross photograph shows a cut section of spleen with a smooth intact capsule. The parenchyma is diffusely studded with innumerable uniform, small tan-white nodules on a dark red-brown background, imparting a miliary, micronodular appearance that reflects expansion of the white pulp. No discrete large masses, infarcts or areas of necrosis are seen. Findings are consistent with a white pulp-based small B-cell lymphoma and, in the given context, with splenic marginal zone lymphoma; histology and immunophenotyping are required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: HCL diffusely infiltrates the red pulp, producing a homogeneous beefy-red cut surface without discrete white pulp nodules.
HSTCL involves red pulp sinusoids and cords, giving a uniform dark red surface without miliary nodules.

ddx.dx: Other small B-cell lymphomas (CLL/SLL, mantle cell, follicular)
ddx.vs: These can also produce a micronodular white pulp pattern grossly and are separated by immunophenotype (CD5, CD23, cyclin D1, CD10/BCL6).

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma or large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These usually form fewer, larger, irregular fleshy masses rather than innumerable uniform small nodules.

exam.answer_en: Splenic marginal zone lymphoma (gross) — splenomegaly with diffuse miliary white-pulp micronodules on cut section
pearls_zh: 考法：脾臟切面大體照，問病變分布位於 white pulp 或 red pulp；答均勻小結節（miliary）代表 white pulp 擴張，提示小 B 細胞淋巴瘤如 SMZL。
SMZL 周邊血可見 villous lymphocytes（絨毛集中在細胞一端，polar villi）；flow 常 CD5−、CD10−、CD103−，無 BRAF V600E。
遺傳：del(7q) 為常見異常，常見 NOTCH2 與 KLF2 突變；骨髓切片典型為 intrasinusoidal 浸潤。
與 hepatitis C 相關的 SMZL 可在抗病毒治療後緩解，故診斷時應檢驗 HCV；其他治療選擇包括 rituximab 或 splenectomy。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 hairy cell leukemia 混淆：HCL 侵犯 red pulp，脾切面呈均勻暗紅（beefy red）而無白色小結節；CLL/SLL、MCL、FL 也可呈 white pulp 小結節，需組織學與免疫表型區分。

quiz.q: 此脾臟切面的白色小結節代表哪一個構造的擴張？與 hairy cell leukemia 的大體表現有何不同？
quiz.a: White pulp 擴張；HCL 主要侵犯 red pulp，切面瀰漫暗紅、無明顯白色結節。

63997.recognize_zh: 視野中央一個橢圓形紅血球內有一條紫色、細線狀並扭成環形或 8 字形的 Cabot 環，背景紅血球大小不一且有大型卵圓紅血球（macro-ovalocytes）、淚滴細胞與破碎紅血球，符合嚴重維生素 B12 缺乏。
features: Central red cell containing a thin purple loop/figure-of-eight Cabot ring
Marked anisocytosis with macro-ovalocytes admixed with microcytes
Poikilocytosis including teardrop cells, elongated/elliptical cells, and occasional fragmented cells
Numerous crenated red cells (echinocytes), likely partly a drying artifact
Small platelets; no nucleated cells or neutrophils in this field for hypersegmentation assessment
63997.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with macro-ovalocytes, microcytes, teardrop cells, elongated cells, and occasional fragmented red cells. One red cell contains a thin, purple, looped figure-of-eight Cabot ring. Numerous crenated red cells are present and likely reflect a preparation artifact. Neutrophils are not present in this field, so hypersegmentation cannot be assessed. Findings are consistent with severe megaloblastic anemia due to cobalamin deficiency with ineffective erythropoiesis.

ddx.vs: Malaria rings are small, with a distinct red chromatin dot and blue cytoplasmic ring occupying a fraction of the cell, whereas Cabot rings are thin loops spanning the cell periphery without a chromatin dot.
MDS can show macrocytosis and poikilocytes but has normal B12/folate and often shows pseudo-Pelger neutrophils or ring sideroblasts; nutritional deficiency resolves with replacement.
TMA also shows schistocytes and high LDH, but lacks macro-ovalocytes and Cabot rings and has more numerous schistocytes with marked thrombocytopenia.
These produce basophilic stippling in microcytic cells rather than macro-ovalocytes with Cabot rings.

exam.answer_en: Severe cobalamin (B12) deficiency megaloblastic anemia — Cabot ring (figure-of-eight) with macro-ovalocytes and marked poikilocytosis
pearls_zh: 考法：指著紅血球內紫色環狀細線，問構造名稱；答 Cabot ring，一般認為是有絲分裂紡錘體殘留，代表嚴重的無效紅血球生成。
Cabot ring 可見於嚴重巨母紅血球性貧血、鉛中毒、MDS、嚴重溶血等；同片其他線索為 macro-ovalocytes 與嗜中性球核過度分葉。
B12 與葉酸缺乏鑑別：兩者 homocysteine 都上升，methylmalonic acid 上升只見於 B12 缺乏；pernicious anemia 查 anti-intrinsic factor 抗體。
治療重點：B12 缺乏若只補葉酸可改善貧血但神經學症狀可能惡化；嚴重無效造血常伴 LDH 明顯上升、間接膽紅素上升，易被誤判為 TMA。
exam.pitfall_zh: Cabot ring 易被誤認為瘧原蟲環狀體；瘧原蟲環狀體有深紫色染色質點與藍色胞質，Cabot ring 則是無染色質點的細線，常扭成 8 字形。

quiz.q: 圖中紅血球內的 8 字形紫色細環稱為什麼？可用哪一項代謝物檢查區分 B12 與葉酸缺乏？
quiz.a: Cabot ring；methylmalonic acid（B12 缺乏時上升，葉酸缺乏時正常）

63805.recognize_zh: 許多大型非典型細胞呈強弱不一的細胞質 CD79a 陽性，另有較小的深染陽性細胞（可能是反應性 B 細胞或漿細胞），背景小淋巴球大多陰性；大細胞保留 B 細胞標記是灰區淋巴瘤的線索。
features: Large atypical cells with variable, moderate-to-strong cytoplasmic and membranous CD79a staining
Heterogeneous staining intensity among the large cells, some with granular cytoplasmic pattern
Small, intensely positive round cells consistent with reactive B cells or plasma cells
Numerous small background lymphocytes negative
Large positive cells scattered and in loose aggregates
63805.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD79a shows variable, moderate-to-strong cytoplasmic and membranous staining in many large atypical cells, along with small intensely positive cells likely representing reactive B cells or plasma cells. The numerous small background lymphocytes are negative. Retention of CD79a in the large neoplastic cells, together with their CD30 and CD15 positivity, supports B-cell lymphoma with features intermediate between DLBCL and classic Hodgkin lymphoma (mediastinal gray zone lymphoma).

ddx.vs: Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are usually CD79a negative or only rarely weakly positive, with loss of the B-cell program.
Sheets of large cells show uniform strong CD79a and CD20, with weak or absent CD30 and no CD15.
Large cells are CD79a and CD138/MUM1 positive but CD20 and CD30/CD15 patterns differ, often with EBER positivity and loss of CD45.
LP cells are CD79a and CD20 strongly positive but CD30 and CD15 negative, within nodular meshworks.

63677.recognize_zh: 低倍血片中血小板數量充足甚至偏多，箭頭所指是接近紅血球大小的巨大血小板（giant platelets），紅血球大小一致、未見明顯碎片，符合 del(5q) MDS 常見的「巨球性貧血但血小板不低」表現。
features: Platelets numerous and evenly distributed, without thrombocytopenia
Large to giant platelets approaching red cell size (arrows)
Red cells relatively uniform and normochromic; macrocytosis is difficult to gauge at this low magnification
Occasional segmented neutrophil and a small lymphocyte in the field
No schistocytes, nucleated red cells or circulating blasts identified
63677.describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows adequate to increased platelets with scattered large to giant platelet forms (arrows). Red cells appear relatively uniform and normochromic; the reported macrocytosis cannot be reliably judged at this magnification but may be estimated against the small lymphocyte in the field. A segmented neutrophil is present, and no schistocytes, nucleated red cells or blasts are seen. In a patient with macrocytic anemia, preserved or increased platelet counts with atypical large platelets are characteristic of myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q).

ddx.vs: ET shows marked thrombocytosis with large platelets but normocytic red cells and no anemia, with JAK2/CALR/MPL mutations rather than del(5q).
Megaloblastic anemia shows oval macrocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils, usually with mild thrombocytopenia rather than preserved counts with giant platelets.
Bernard-Soulier or MYH9-related disorders have giant platelets with low platelet counts and, in MYH9 disease, Döhle-like neutrophil inclusions.

63613.recognize_zh: 兩顆分葉核嗜中性球聚在一起，細胞膜外緣附著一圈排列緊密的血小板（platelet satellitism，箭頭），中間夾著一顆被擠壓變形、深藍色的細胞；這種血小板環繞白血球的現象見於 EDTA 抗凝血。
features: Aggregate of two segmented neutrophils with fine lilac granules
Numerous platelets adherent in a ring (rosette) around the neutrophil membranes
Adherent platelets normal in size with granular purple centers
Compressed, deeply basophilic cell wedged between the neutrophils, nature indeterminate (possibly a lymphocyte)
Few free platelets and normal-appearing red cells in the background
63613.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small leukocyte aggregate composed of two segmented neutrophils with an intervening compressed, deeply basophilic cell. Numerous normal-sized platelets adhere in a rosette around the neutrophil membranes, with only a few free platelets in the background. The neutrophils show no toxic changes and red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with platelet satellitism with neutrophil aggregation, an EDTA-dependent in vitro phenomenon that can cause spurious thrombocytopenia and leukopenia; a repeat count on citrate- or heparin-anticoagulated blood is recommended.

ddx.vs: In platelet clumping platelets aggregate with each other in free clumps rather than rimming leukocyte membranes, although both cause pseudothrombocytopenia.
Phagocytosed platelets or organisms lie within the neutrophil cytoplasm rather than attached to its outer surface.
Leukoagglutination forms neutrophil clumps that lack the surrounding platelet rim.

exam.answer_en: Platelet satellitism with neutrophil aggregation — EDTA-dependent in vitro artifact causing pseudothrombocytopenia
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指嗜中性球外緣黏著一圈血小板問意義；答 platelet satellitism，EDTA 依賴的體外現象，儀器血小板數假性降低，不是真的血小板低下。
機轉：EDTA 環境下自體抗體橋接血小板 GPIIb/IIIa 與嗜中性球 FcγRIII（CD16）；嗜中性球聚集還可造成假性白血球低下。
處理：以 citrate 或 heparin 抗凝管重抽（citrate 需校正稀釋），或指尖血抹片直接評估；避免誤判而不必要地輸血小板或做骨髓檢查。
原則：儀器報血小板低下時，都應看血片排除血小板團塊與衛星現象。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 EDTA 誘發血小板凝集混淆：凝集為游離成團的血小板、常在片尾；衛星現象為血小板花環狀貼附白血球膜。也要與吞噬血小板（在細胞內）區分。

quiz.q: 圖中血小板環繞嗜中性球的現象稱為什麼？會造成什麼假性檢驗結果，要如何處理？
quiz.a: Platelet satellitism；假性血小板低下（與假性白血球低下），改用 citrate/heparin 管重抽或看指尖血抹片

63549.recognize_zh: a 圖是一顆染色質濃密、細胞核呈多葉花瓣狀的淋巴球（flower cell）；流式圖顯示這群異常 T 細胞（綠色）CD7 缺失、CD3/CD5 保留、CD4 與 CD8 共同表現且 CD25 陰性，配合 HTLV-1 陽性即為 CD25 陰性的 ATLL。
features: Panel a: medium-sized lymphoid cell with dense chromatin and a multilobated, clover/flower-shaped nucleus with scant basophilic cytoplasm
Panel b: CD45 bright, low side scatter lymphocyte population (green) distinct from granulocytes
Panel c: gated atypical T cells (26.12%) are CD2 positive and CD7 negative
Panel d: atypical cells co-express CD3 and CD5
Panel e: atypical cells co-express CD4 and CD8 (double positive)
Panel f: atypical cells are negative for CD25 and CD56
63549.describe_en: Composite figure of a peripheral blood smear (a) and flow cytometric dot plots (b-f). The smear shows a medium-sized lymphoid cell with condensed chromatin and a deeply convoluted, multilobated nucleus resembling a flower, with scant cytoplasm. Flow cytometry identifies a CD45-bright lymphoid population in which 26% of lymphocytes are aberrant T cells that are CD2+, CD3+, CD5+ and CD7-negative, co-express CD4 and CD8, and lack CD25 and CD56. Loss of CD7 with abnormal CD4/CD8 co-expression supports a clonal mature T-cell population; CD25 negativity is atypical for this entity. In the setting of HTLV-1 seropositivity and hypercalcemia, findings are consistent with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma, CD25-negative, CD4/CD8 double-positive variant.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells have cerebriform grooved rather than petal-like lobated nuclei, are typically CD4+ CD7- CD26- and HTLV-1 negative; serology and clinical skin findings separate them.
T-PLL cells have a visible nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs, frequently retain CD7 and may be CD4/CD8 double positive, with TCL1 rearrangement and negative HTLV-1.
Reactive lymphocytes are polyclonal with preserved CD7 and a normal CD4:CD8 distribution, without the uniform aberrant population.

exam.answer_en: Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma, CD25-negative variant — flower cell; flow shows CD7-negative, CD4/CD8 double-positive, CD25-negative T cells
pearls_zh: 流式判讀：先用 CD45/SSC 圈出淋巴球，再找失去 CD7 的 T 細胞群；成熟 T 細胞腫瘤常見泛 T 抗原（如 CD7）缺失。
典型 ATLL 為 CD4+/CD8−、CD25+；本例 CD4/CD8 雙陽且 CD25−，屬少見表型，不能因 CD25 陰性就排除 ATLL。
確診關鍵是 HTLV-1 抗體陽性，必要時證明 HTLV-1 provirus 單株整合；臨床常伴高血鈣、皮膚病灶或淋巴結腫大。
CD4/CD8 雙陽也見於部分 T-PLL，需以 TCL1 表現與 TCL1A/MTCP1 重排鑑別。
exam.pitfall_zh: CD4/CD8 雙陽易誤判為 T-PLL；T-PLL 常 CD7 陽性、TCL1 陽性、核較規則且有核仁，本例為 CD7 陰性的花瓣狀核且需 HTLV-1 陽性支持。

quiz.q: 從流式圖看，這群異常 T 細胞缺失哪個泛 T 抗原？CD25 結果為何？
quiz.a: CD7 缺失；CD25 陰性

63485.recognize_zh: 腹部皮膚照片中，毛髮呈捲曲螺旋狀（corkscrew hairs），許多毛囊周圍有細小紅色出血點（perifollicular hemorrhages），部分毛囊角化凸起，這是壞血病（維生素 C 缺乏）的典型皮膚表現。
features: Coiled, corkscrew-shaped body hairs across the abdominal skin
Small red perifollicular hemorrhages centered on hair follicles
Follicular hyperkeratotic papules with dark keratin plugs
Distribution is diffuse and follicle-based rather than random petechiae
No large ecchymoses or palpable purpura in this field
63485.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the abdominal skin shows numerous coiled, corkscrew-like hairs with small red hemorrhages centered on hair follicles and follicular hyperkeratotic plugs. The hemorrhages are perifollicular rather than randomly distributed, and there is no palpable purpura. This is a clinical image without microscopic morphology; the combination of corkscrew hairs and perifollicular hemorrhage is characteristic of scurvy (vitamin C deficiency), typically with normal platelet count and coagulation studies.

ddx.vs: Petechiae are not centered on follicles, hairs are normal, and the platelet count is low.
Produces palpable purpura, usually on dependent lower extremities, without corkscrew hairs or follicular keratotic plugs.
Shows follicular papules or pustules without hemorrhage and without corkscrew hair shafts.

exam.answer_en: Scurvy (vitamin C deficiency) — perifollicular hemorrhages with corkscrew hairs and follicular hyperkeratosis
pearls_zh: 考法：臨床照片題，考官問「出血型態＋捲曲毛髮」指向何種缺乏；答維生素 C 缺乏（scurvy），並強調出血以毛囊為中心。
機轉：維生素 C 為 prolyl/lysyl hydroxylase 輔因子，缺乏導致膠原蛋白結構異常、微血管脆弱；血小板數、PT、aPTT 通常正常。
高風險族群：酗酒、偏食或極端飲食、自閉症兒童、獨居長者、吸收不良與透析病人；另可見牙齦腫脹出血、傷口癒合不良。
診斷可測血漿 ascorbic acid，治療補充維生素 C 後出血與皮膚症狀改善迅速。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易被誤認為血小板低下的 petechiae 或 IgA vasculitis；scurvy 出血點集中於毛囊周圍並伴螺旋狀毛髮，凝血檢查與血小板多正常。

quiz.q: 病人出血傾向但血小板與 PT/aPTT 正常，照片見毛囊周圍出血與螺旋狀毛髮，最可能缺乏什麼？
quiz.a: 維生素 C（scurvy）

63357.recognize_zh: PAS 染色下，一群淋巴球呈藍紫色，細胞邊緣的球形包涵體仍是蒼白、沒有洋紅色陽性反應，表示包涵體不含肝醣或醣蛋白。
features: Cluster of small round lymphocytes with blue-purple counterstained nuclei
Pale, clear globular cytoplasmic inclusions at the periphery of several lymphocytes (arrow region)
No magenta PAS-positive material in the inclusions or as cytoplasmic granules/blocks
Scattered larger cells with irregular cytoplasm at the edges of the field
Red cells appear as faint unstained ghosts
63357.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear stained with periodic acid-Schiff shows a cluster of small lymphocytes, several of which contain pale globular cytoplasmic inclusions. The inclusions show no magenta PAS positivity, and no block-like cytoplasmic PAS positivity is seen. Red cells are visible only as faint outlines. Findings indicate that the lymphocyte inclusions are PAS-negative, similar to previously reported CLL inclusions.

ddx.vs: Immunoglobulin inclusions are typically PAS-positive magenta globules, unlike the unstained inclusions here.
Glycogen-storage vacuoles in lymphocytes stain PAS-positive and are diastase-sensitive.
Lipid vacuoles are PAS-negative as well but stain with Oil Red O on fresh air-dried smears.

63293.recognize_zh: NPM1 免疫染色（紅色呈色）中，絕大多數細胞的陽性訊號侷限在細胞核內，未見大量細胞質異位表現（cytoplasmic NPM1），提示為 NPM1 野生型，支持非 NPM1 突變的 AML-MRC 分類。
features: Majority of hematopoietic cells show strong, homogeneous nuclear-restricted red NPM1 staining
Cytoplasm of most positive cells is unstained, indicating no aberrant cytoplasmic NPM1 localization
Rare cells show smudged or granular cytoplasmic red staining, likely nonspecific or crushed cells
Interspersed NPM1-weak cells with blue hematoxylin counterstained nuclei
Background adipocytes and yellow-tinged erythrocytes
63293.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy immunostained for nucleophosmin (NPM1) with a red chromogen shows strong staining restricted to the nuclei of the majority of hematopoietic cells, with no significant aberrant cytoplasmic localization. Occasional cells show smudged cytoplasmic staining that is not convincing for a mutant pattern. Some cells with blue counterstained nuclei show weaker staining. Findings indicate a nuclear-restricted (wild-type) NPM1 pattern, which argues against AML with NPM1 mutation and supports classification as acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes; molecular confirmation is recommended.

ddx.vs: NPM1-mutated AML shows aberrant cytoplasmic plus nuclear NPM1 staining in the blasts, rather than the nuclear-restricted pattern seen here.
Artifactual staining is weak, patchy and seen in crushed or degenerated cells, whereas true mutant pattern is diffuse cytoplasmic staining in a large proportion of blasts.
Nuclear-restricted NPM1 does not distinguish among AML subtypes, which require cytogenetic and molecular classification.

63229.recognize_zh: A 為頭顱側面 X 光，顱骨佈滿大小相近、邊界清楚、無硬化邊緣的圓形透亮小洞（punched-out lesions，俗稱雨滴狀／胡椒罐頭顱）；B 為骨盆正面 X 光，髂骨與雙側股骨近端呈瀰漫性骨質減少與斑駁溶骨；多發打孔狀溶骨病灶是多發性骨髓瘤的典型影像。
features: Panel A (lateral skull radiograph): innumerable small, round, well-defined lucent lesions throughout the calvarium
Skull lesions are 'punched-out' without sclerotic rims or periosteal reaction ('raindrop' / pepper-pot skull)
Panel B (AP pelvis radiograph): diffuse osteopenia with mottled, moth-eaten lucencies in the iliac bones
Lytic foci and cortical thinning in the proximal femora
No obvious pathologic fracture or blastic lesion identified on these views
63229.describe_en: Lateral skull radiograph (A) demonstrates innumerable small, round, well-circumscribed lytic lesions scattered throughout the calvarium, without sclerotic margins, producing a 'raindrop' or pepper-pot appearance. AP radiograph of the pelvis (B) shows diffuse osteopenia with mottled lytic lesions involving the iliac bones and proximal femora, with no definite pathologic fracture or sclerotic lesions. Multiple punched-out lytic lesions of the axial skeleton are characteristic of multiple myeloma and satisfy the bone-disease CRAB criterion when correlated with a clonal plasma cell neoplasm; cross-sectional imaging (low-dose whole-body CT or PET-CT) is more sensitive than plain films.

ddx.vs: Metastases are usually fewer, more variable in size, with ill-defined margins and preferential pedicle involvement, whereas myeloma shows numerous uniform punched-out lesions and a clonal plasma cell population.
Hyperparathyroidism produces a fine granular salt-and-pepper texture with subperiosteal resorption and brown tumors, plus elevated PTH and calcium without a monoclonal protein.
LCH skull lesions are larger, geographic with beveled edges, typically in children, and biopsy shows CD1a/langerin-positive cells.
Osteoporosis causes diffuse demineralization with preserved cortical outlines but no discrete punched-out lucencies.

exam.answer_en: Multiple myeloma — innumerable punched-out lytic skull lesions (raindrop/pepper-pot skull) and lytic pelvic and proximal femoral lesions
pearls_zh: 讀片考法：頭顱側面 X 光指多發、邊界清楚、無硬化邊緣的圓形透亮洞，問「punched-out lytic lesions」，並問為何沒有硬化邊。
機轉：骨髓瘤細胞使 RANKL 增加、OPG 減少而活化 osteoclast，並經 DKK1 抑制 Wnt 使 osteoblast 失能；因此 Tc-99m bone scan 常假陰性，ALP 多正常。
影像選擇：IMWG 建議 whole-body low-dose CT，PET-CT 或 whole-body MRI 更敏感；CT/PET-CT 上 ≥1 個 ≥5 mm 溶骨病灶即符合 CRAB 的骨病變。
臨床處置：bisphosphonate（zoledronic acid）或 denosumab 預防骨骼事件；病理性骨折與脊髓壓迫為急症。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與溶骨性骨轉移或副甲狀腺亢進的 salt-and-pepper skull 混淆：骨髓瘤病灶數多、大小一致、邊界清楚；副甲狀腺亢進為細顆粒狀並有骨膜下吸收。

quiz.q: 為什麼多發性骨髓瘤的溶骨病灶在 Tc-99m bone scan 上常呈陰性？
quiz.a: 病灶為純溶骨性，osteoblast 活性受抑制，缺乏成骨反應

63165.recognize_zh: 拼圖呈現骨髓瘤的少見形態：4A–C 為充滿纖維狀結晶的組織球與結晶儲存組織球增生，5A–C 為類似異常巨核細胞的多葉多形性漿細胞且 MUM1 核陽性，6A–B 漿細胞含大量粗大藍紫色嗜天青樣顆粒，7 為多葉「爆米花」狀核的漿細胞。
features: 4A-B (aspirate): histiocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm packed with fibrillary/needle-like crystalline material, with adjacent plasma cells, one containing cytoplasmic inclusions
4C (trephine, H&E): sheets of pale eosinophilic histiocytes with interspersed plasma cells, consistent with crystal-storing histiocytosis
5A-B: large atypical plasma cells with multilobated, hyperchromatic pleomorphic nuclei resembling dysplastic megakaryocytes; sheets of pleomorphic cells in the biopsy
5C (IHC): nuclear MUM1 positivity in the atypical cells
6A-B: plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and numerous coarse dark azurophilic cytoplasmic granules
7: numerous plasma cells with multilobated, cloverleaf/popcorn-like nuclei including immature forms
63165.describe_en: Composite figure of four plasma cell myeloma cases with unusual morphology. Case 4 shows histiocytes filled with fibrillary crystalline material on aspirate and sheets of crystal-storing histiocytes admixed with plasma cells on trephine biopsy. Case 5 shows large pleomorphic plasma cells with multilobated hyperchromatic nuclei mimicking dysplastic megakaryocytes, forming sheets on biopsy and confirmed by nuclear MUM1 positivity. Case 6 shows plasma cells with numerous coarse azurophilic cytoplasmic granules, and case 7 shows a marrow largely replaced by plasma cells with multilobated popcorn-like nuclei. Findings are consistent with morphologic variants of plasma cell myeloma, which require CD138/MUM1 and light chain studies to avoid misclassification.

ddx.dx: Adult Gaucher disease or mycobacterial infection (for crystal-storing histiocytes)
ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm that is glucocerebrosidase-deficient, whereas crystal-storing histiocytes contain monotypic immunoglobulin crystals with an associated clonal plasma cell population.

ddx.dx: Megakaryocytic dysplasia / metastatic tumor (for pleomorphic case 5)
ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes are CD61/CD42b positive and MUM1/CD138 negative, and carcinoma is cytokeratin positive, while these cells are MUM1 positive.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid or promyelocytic leukemia (for granular case 6)
ddx.vs: Myeloid blasts have fine chromatin, lack an eccentric nucleus with hof, and are MPO positive, whereas granular plasma cells are CD138 positive and MPO negative.
ATLL flower cells are CD4+ T cells with HTLV-1 infection, while multilobated plasma cells express CD138 with light chain restriction.

63101.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中見大小不一的母細胞，核質比高、染色質細緻、細胞質少而嗜鹼性，其中兩個細胞有單側細胞質尾巴呈手鏡狀（hand-mirror，箭頭），並伴隨淡紫色的破碎細胞（smudge cells）；需靠流式確認 T 系與 ETP 表型。
features: Pleomorphic blasts of small to medium-large size with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine to moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Scant to moderate basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Two blasts with a unipolar cytoplasmic tail (hand-mirror cells, arrows)
Scattered smudge cells with pale, spread-out nuclear material
No Auer rods identified
63101.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an increase in pleomorphic blasts of variable size with high N:C ratios, fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm. Two blasts display a hand-mirror configuration with a unipolar cytoplasmic tail, and smudge cells are present. Auer rods are not seen. The morphology is that of acute leukemia with lymphoblast-like features; with flow cytometry showing CD34+, CD7 bright, CD33+, TdT+ and cytoplasmic CD3+ blasts, findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia, with an early T-cell precursor immunophenotype to be confirmed by the absence of CD1a and CD8 and weak or absent CD5.

ddx.vs: Morphologically indistinguishable; B-ALL expresses CD19, CD79a and PAX5 without cytoplasmic CD3.
Blasts may look identical and express CD33/CD34, but they lack cytoplasmic CD3 and TdT is often negative or weak, with MPO in some blasts.
MPAL T/myeloid requires MPO positivity or monocytic differentiation in addition to cCD3, whereas ETP-ALL shows myeloid/stem markers (CD33, CD34) without MPO.
Reactive lymphocytes have mature condensed chromatin and abundant cytoplasm rather than blast chromatin and high N:C ratio.

63037.recognize_zh: 紅血球內可見小型、中央空泡的環狀體（ring form），邊緣有細小藍紫色染色質點，沒有瘧色素；另見少數小圓形寄生體。背景紅血球表面與間隙散布大量細小深色點狀物，屬染料沉澱，不應誤認為寄生蟲。
features: Small intraerythrocytic ring forms with a central clear vacuole and thin cytoplasmic rim with a chromatin dot
Occasional small round/pleomorphic intraerythrocytic forms
No hemozoin pigment, schizonts or gametocytes; tetrad (Maltese cross) not seen in this field
Low apparent parasitemia with infected red cells not enlarged
Abundant fine dark stain precipitate overlying red cells and background (artifact)
63037.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic red cells, a few of which contain small intraerythrocytic ring forms with central vacuoles and delicate chromatin dots, along with occasional small round forms. Infected cells are not enlarged, and no hemozoin pigment, schizonts or gametocytes are identified; a tetrad form is not seen in this field. Fine dark stain precipitate is scattered over red cells and background and should not be mistaken for parasites. Findings are consistent with Babesia infection; parasitemia should be quantified and PCR or species identification performed.

ddx.vs: P. falciparum rings are often double-chromatin, appliqué forms with banana-shaped gametocytes and pigment, whereas Babesia shows pleomorphic rings, extracellular forms and tetrads without pigment, schizonts or gametocytes.

ddx.dx: Stain precipitate or platelets overlying red cells
ddx.vs: Precipitate is refractile, dark and present between cells in a different focal plane, while parasites are within the red cell with a cytoplasmic ring and vacuole.
Red cell inclusions are solid dense dots without a ring of cytoplasm or central vacuole.

exam.answer_en: Babesiosis — small pleomorphic intraerythrocytic ring forms without hemozoin pigment, schizonts or gametocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：指紅血球內小環狀體，問 Babesia 還是 Plasmodium；關鍵在無瘧色素、無 schizont/gametocyte，若見四聯體（Maltese cross）更支持 Babesia。
美國主要為 Babesia microti，經 Ixodes 蜱傳播，也可經輸血傳染。
高危險族群：無脾、老年、免疫低下者，可發生嚴重溶血、ARDS、DIC，甚至續發 HLH。
治療：atovaquone + azithromycin；重症用 clindamycin + quinine，高寄生率可考慮 exchange transfusion。
需計算 parasitemia 並以 PCR 確認種別；也要確認無旅遊史相關的瘧疾可能。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 P. falciparum：兩者都是小環狀體，但 Babesia 無 hemozoin、無 schizont 與 banana-shaped gametocyte，並可見 tetrad 與紅血球外蟲體；背景染料沉澱也不可誤認為寄生蟲。

quiz.q: 紅血球內小環狀體，缺乏哪一種色素可幫助區分 Babesia 與瘧疾？
quiz.a: Hemozoin（malarial pigment）

62973.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片幾乎全是嗜伊紅性球，僅見少數核質比高、染色質細的淋巴母細胞（箭頭），容易被當成嗜伊紅性球增多症而漏診；流式確認 CD19+CD10+ B 淋巴母細胞，核型顯示多條額外染色體（+4、+9、+14、+21、+X，箭頭）的高度超二倍體，組織中為母細胞片狀浸潤伴嗜伊紅性球。
features: Peripheral blood dominated by mature eosinophils with coarse orange-red granules; a rare lymphoblast with high N:C ratio and fine chromatin (A, arrow)
Flow cytometry: CD19+ CD10 bright B-lymphoblast population (B, arrow)
Smear with sheets of small-medium lymphoblasts with scant cytoplasm admixed with eosinophils (C)
G-banded karyotype with gains of chromosomes 4, 9, 14, 21 and X, consistent with high hyperdiploidy (D)
Tissue H&E with diffuse blastic infiltrate and scattered eosinophils; nuclear IHC positivity in nearly all blasts (E, F; marker not labeled, likely TdT)
62973.describe_en: Composite figure. The peripheral blood smear shows marked eosinophilia with only rare circulating lymphoblasts, which have high N:C ratios, fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm (A). Flow cytometry identifies a CD19-positive, CD10-bright B-lymphoblast population (B), and a marrow smear shows sheets of lymphoblasts admixed with eosinophils (C). The karyotype shows multiple whole-chromosome gains including 4, 9, 14, 21 and X (D), and tissue sections show a diffuse blast infiltrate with interspersed eosinophils and strong nuclear immunostaining of the blasts (E, F). Findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with high hyperdiploidy presenting with reactive hypereosinophilia and very few circulating blasts.

ddx.vs: This entity also presents with eosinophilia and few circulating blasts, but is defined by the IL3 rearrangement rather than a hyperdiploid karyotype.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and tyrosine kinase fusion (PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2)
ddx.vs: These neoplasms can present as lymphoblastic leukemia with eosinophilia but carry the specific tyrosine kinase gene fusion, and the eosinophils are part of the clone.
Reactive eosinophilia lacks a clonal CD19+CD10+ blast population and abnormal karyotype.
CEL shows clonal eosinophils with dysplasia and possibly increased myeloblasts, not B-lymphoblasts.

62973.stain: Wright-Giemsa; flow cytometry; G-banded karyotype; H&E; IHC

62909.recognize_zh: 視野中央一個帶狀至分葉核的嗜中性球，細胞質呈淡粉紅並散布細顆粒，但在核附近聚集一團粗大的深紫黑色顆粒；這種不均勻的黑色團塊與病史（碘造影劑注射後採血）提示嗜中性球吞噬的色素。
features: Single neutrophil with a curved band-to-segmented nucleus
Focal cluster of coarse dark purple-black granules near the nucleus
Remaining cytoplasm pale pink with finer granules extending to the cell margin
Background red cells with numerous echinocytes and occasional target-like cells
Scattered small platelets
62909.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with a curved band-to-segmented nucleus and pale pink granular cytoplasm containing a focal cluster of coarse dark purple-black granules adjacent to the nucleus. The surrounding red cells include numerous echinocytes and a few target-like cells, with scattered platelets. No organisms or blasts are identified. In the context of blood sampled after iodinated contrast injection in a septic patient, findings are consistent with pigment inclusion in a neutrophil with accompanying toxic change.

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are dispersed throughout the cytoplasm rather than aggregated into a discrete black cluster.
Döhle bodies are pale blue-grey peripheral cytoplasmic patches, not dark granular clumps.
Features large blue spindle-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions with giant platelets and thrombocytopenia.

62845.recognize_zh: CD61 染色下可見 4 個大型、胞質淡棕色陽性的巨核細胞，核分葉、大小與形狀正常，散在分布而非成群，顯示巨核細胞系形態保留，不支持骨髓增生性腫瘤。
features: IHC for CD61 (glycoprotein IIIa) on a cellular marrow core
Four large megakaryocytes with finely granular cytoplasmic CD61 staining
Megakaryocytes show normal size and lobulated nuclei; no hypolobated, micro- or bizarre forms
Megakaryocytes dispersed singly, without tight clustering or paratrabecular location
Background of CD61-negative hematopoietic cells and two fat spaces
62845.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD61 on the bone marrow trephine highlights scattered megakaryocytes with finely granular cytoplasmic staining. The megakaryocytes are of normal size with appropriately lobulated nuclei and are dispersed singly without clustering or micromegakaryocytes. The surrounding hematopoietic and infiltrating cells are negative. Megakaryopoiesis is morphologically unremarkable, arguing against a concurrent myeloproliferative or myelodysplastic process in this myeloma marrow.

ddx.vs: MPNs show increased, clustered megakaryocytes with hyperlobated or bulbous, hyperchromatic nuclei rather than evenly dispersed normal forms.
MDS often shows CD61-positive micromegakaryocytes and hypolobated or separated nuclear lobes, which are not seen here.
CML characteristically has small hypolobated 'dwarf' megakaryocytes, unlike the normal-sized lobulated forms here.

62781.recognize_zh: 周邊血的中性球體積大、胞質豐富，充滿粗大深紫色的毒性顆粒（toxic granulation），並可見淡藍色的 Döhle 小體（箭頭），外觀完全像感染反應；但在找不到反應原因時，必須考慮慢性嗜中性球白血病（CNL）並檢測 CSF3R。
features: Mature segmented and band neutrophils, many enlarged with abundant cytoplasm
Coarse dark azurophilic cytoplasmic granules resembling toxic granulation
Pale blue peripheral cytoplasmic inclusions consistent with Döhle bodies (arrows)
Nuclei with normal lobation and clumped chromatin; no pseudo-Pelger-Huet change or hypogranularity
No blasts or immature myeloid precursors in these fields
62781.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mature segmented and band neutrophils with normal nuclear lobation and abundant cytoplasm containing coarse, dark azurophilic granules resembling toxic granulation. Several neutrophils contain pale blue peripheral cytoplasmic inclusions consistent with Döhle bodies (arrows). No dysplastic features, blasts, or circulating immature myeloid precursors are seen in these fields. Although the morphology mimics a reactive neutrophilia, in the absence of infection or other secondary cause these findings are suggestive of chronic neutrophilic leukemia; CSF3R mutation testing and exclusion of BCR::ABL1 are recommended.

ddx.vs: Toxic granulation and Döhle bodies are identical, so separation requires excluding a secondary cause and demonstrating clonality such as a CSF3R T618I mutation.
CML shows a left-shifted spectrum with myelocyte peak and basophilia and carries BCR::ABL1, whereas CNL shows predominantly mature neutrophils without basophilia.
aCML shows prominent dysgranulopoiesis with hypogranular and pseudo-Pelger neutrophils and 10% or more immature granulocytes, unlike these well-granulated mature cells.
MYH9-related Döhle-like inclusions are larger and spindle-shaped, occur with giant platelets and thrombocytopenia, and lack toxic granulation.

62717.recognize_zh: 這是原始細胞閘門內的 CD123 對 CD19 流式圖：一大群原始細胞 CD19 陽性（藍色，約 2×10³ 以上）代表 B 系，另一群 CD19 陰性（紅色）；兩群 CD123 多為弱到中度表現，只有少數延伸到較亮，顯示原始細胞中同時存在 B 系與非 B 系族群。
features: Gated on blasts; CD123-APC (x-axis) versus CD19-APC700 (y-axis)
Large blast subset (blue) with moderate-to-bright CD19 expression (about 10^3.3 to 10^4.7)
Second blast subset (red) that is CD19 negative to dim
CD123 largely negative to dim on both subsets, with a minor tail of brighter CD123 (10^4 to 10^5)
No discrete CD123-bright/CD19-negative population to suggest plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm
62717.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis gated on blasts displays CD123 versus CD19. A large blast subset (colored blue) shows moderate-to-bright CD19 expression, while a second subset (red) is CD19 negative to dim. CD123 is negative to dim on most blasts, with a small tail of brighter events. Strong CD19 on a subset of blasts supports B-lineage commitment when accompanied by CD79a, cCD22 or CD10, while the CD19-negative subset corresponds to the myeloid component; together with the other plots, these findings are consistent with mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid.

ddx.dx: AML with aberrant CD19 expression (e.g., RUNX1::RUNX1T1)
ddx.vs: CD19 is usually partial and dim without strong co-expression of CD79a/cCD22/CD10, so it does not qualify as B-lineage commitment.
Shows uniform bright CD123 with CD4 and CD56, lacking CD19 and MPO.
Blasts are uniformly CD19 positive without a separate CD19-negative MPO-positive myeloid subset.

62589.recognize_zh: Ki67 染色呈結節狀分布：結節內大量細胞核陽性、結節之間的淋巴細胞多為陰性，且結節內沒有反應性生發中心那種明暗區極性；高增生指數符合高分級濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Nodular distribution of Ki67-positive nuclei outlining neoplastic follicles
High proliferation within nodules, roughly half or more of nuclei positive in the densest areas
Internodular zones with predominantly Ki67-negative small lymphocytes
No polarization (dark/light zone gradient) within nodules
62589.describe_en: Ki67 immunohistochemistry highlights a nodular pattern, with numerous positive nuclei concentrated within closely spaced nodules and relatively few positive cells in the intervening internodular tissue. The proliferation index within the nodules is high, approaching or exceeding half of nuclei in the most active areas, and there is no zonal polarization of staining. A high Ki67 index in neoplastic follicles supports a higher-grade follicular lymphoma, although grade is formally assigned by centroblast counts on H&E.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers have a very high Ki67 index but show polarization toward the dark zone and are BCL2-negative.
Low-grade FL usually has a low Ki67 index (often below 20%) within neoplastic follicles.
DLBCL shows diffuse high Ki67 without a nodular follicular distribution.

62525.recognize_zh: 這是經下頷骨與口咽層級的軸切增強 CT：左頸部有大型分葉狀、中心密度較低的軟組織腫塊（融合的腫大淋巴結）壓迫周邊構造，對側也有較小淋巴結；年輕病人無痛性雙側大量頸部淋巴結腫大是 Rosai-Dorfman 病（SHML）的典型臨床表現，但影像無法確診。
features: Axial contrast-enhanced CT of the neck at the level of the mandible and oropharynx
Large lobulated soft-tissue mass in the left neck with a lower-attenuation central area, consistent with conglomerate enlarged lymph nodes
Additional enlarged left submandibular node and smaller right cervical nodes
Mass effect on adjacent soft tissues with preserved airway lumen
