62525.describe_en: Axial contrast-enhanced CT of the neck at the level of the mandible shows a large, lobulated soft-tissue mass in the left cervical region with a heterogeneous, lower-attenuation central area, consistent with conglomerate enlarged lymph nodes, together with an enlarged left submandibular node and smaller right cervical nodes. The mass displaces adjacent soft tissues while the airway remains patent. Massive painless cervical lymphadenopathy is the classic presentation of sinus histiocytosis with massive lymphadenopathy (Rosai-Dorfman disease), but the imaging appearance is nonspecific and overlaps with lymphoma and infection; diagnosis requires biopsy showing S100-positive histiocytes with emperipolesis.

62461.recognize_zh: 淋巴球 gate 的 CD4 對 CD26 流式圖：大量藍色 CD4 dim 細胞 CD26 為陰性，而綠色正常 CD4 T 細胞 CD26 表現由弱到強連續分布；CD4 T 細胞失去 CD26 是 Sézary 細胞的重要表型之一。
features: Dot plot of CD4-FITC versus CD26-PE gated on lymphocytes (60.35% of total events)
Dominant blue population with dim CD4 and negative CD26 expression (CD4dim CD26-)
Green population with normal-intensity CD4 and a continuous range of CD26 from dim to positive
Minor CD4-negative events with variable CD26 (CD8 T cells, NK and B cells)
Non-morphologic figure; CD26 loss is assessed as a proportion of CD4 T cells
62461.describe_en: Flow cytometric plot of CD4 versus CD26 on gated lymphocytes shows a dominant CD4-dim population lacking CD26 expression. The residual normal CD4-positive T cells (green) show brighter CD4 with a continuous spectrum of CD26 expression, and a minor CD4-negative population is also present. An expanded CD4-positive, CD26-negative population (commonly using thresholds of at least 30% of CD4 T cells, or at least 40% for CD7 loss) is a recognized criterion for blood involvement. Findings are consistent with Sezary cell involvement in mycosis fungoides/Sezary syndrome.

ddx.dx: Reactive or inflammatory dermatoses with CD26-negative T cells
ddx.vs: Benign conditions can show modest CD26-negative CD4 fractions but usually well below 30% and without dim CD4 or clonal TCR rearrangement.
ATLL cells are also CD26 negative but are CD25 bright and HTLV-1 positive.
Normal CD4 cells show a continuous CD26 spectrum as in the green population, rather than a discrete dominant CD26-negative cluster.

exam.answer_en: Sézary cells by flow — CD4-dim T cells with loss of CD26, separate from normal CD4 T cells showing a CD26 continuum
pearls_zh: 判讀：正常 CD4 T 細胞的 CD26 為弱到強的連續分布；腫瘤性 CD4 T 細胞形成 CD26 陰性的獨立族群，且 CD4 強度較弱。
CD26 缺失在 Sézary 細胞偵測上比 CD7 缺失更具特異性，因為反應性 CD4 T 細胞 CD7 陰性亞群較常見。
ISCL/EORTC 早期標準曾以 CD4+CD7− ≥40% 或 CD4+CD26− ≥30% 作為血中高腫瘤負荷參考；最新共識偏重絕對計數與克隆性。
流式報告應同時給百分比與絕對數（需併 CBC），並追蹤治療反應；其他常見異常包括 CD2、CD3、CD5 表現變弱。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 CD4 陰性區的 CD8 T 細胞、NK 或 B 細胞納入 CD26 陰性計數：CD26 缺失應只在 CD4+ T 細胞中計算比例，並排除非 T 細胞事件。

quiz.q: 圖中藍色族群的 CD26 表現為何？比起 CD7 缺失，CD26 缺失的優點是什麼？
quiz.a: CD26 陰性；較具特異性，反應性 T 細胞較少出現 CD26 缺失

62397.recognize_zh: 黏膜下被一片瀰漫、單一形態的中型單核細胞完全佔據，殘存的小圓形腺體/血管結構被包埋在其中，細胞間有散在嗜酸性細胞質的細胞；這種破壞性、非淋巴球樣的浸潤要想到骨髓性肉瘤（myeloid sarcoma），需以 MPO/CD34/CD117 等免疫染色確認。
features: Dense, diffuse sheet-like infiltrate effacing the mucosal stroma
Monotonous intermediate-sized mononuclear cells with high N:C ratio
Round to irregular hyperchromatic nuclei; cells appear discohesive
Scattered cells with more abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm admixed
Small round residual glandular/vascular structures entrapped within the infiltrate
Focal fibrous stroma with streaming of cells at the periphery
62397.describe_en: Sections of sinonasal mucosa show a dense, diffuse infiltrate of mononuclear cells that effaces the lamina propria and entraps small residual round glandular/vascular structures. At higher magnification within this field, the cells are intermediate in size with high N:C ratios, irregular hyperchromatic nuclei and scant to moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm, and they grow in a discohesive pattern. No surface epithelium or granulomas are evident in this field. The appearance of a destructive, monotonous infiltrate is suggestive of a hematolymphoid neoplasm; in the appropriate immunophenotypic context (MPO, CD34, CD117, lysozyme positivity) the findings are consistent with myeloid sarcoma.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, lack admixed eosinophilic myeloid precursors, and are CD20+/MPO-negative.
NK/T-cell lymphoma shows angiocentric growth with zonal necrosis and is CD56+, cytoplasmic CD3+ and EBER-positive rather than MPO-positive.

ddx.dx: Olfactory neuroblastoma / small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Neuroblastoma forms lobules with neurofibrillary matrix and Homer Wright rosettes and is synaptophysin/chromogranin-positive and CD45-negative.
Reactive infiltrates are polymorphous with small lymphocytes, plasma cells and neutrophils and do not form a monotonous destructive sheet of immature cells.

62205.recognize_zh: 抹片中可見成群的中型淋巴細胞，細胞質中等量淡藍、核圓或有凹痕、染色質中度濃縮，部分可見小核仁（前淋巴球）；左下角有破碎的塗抹細胞，符合 CLL 伴前淋巴球增加。
features: Clusters of medium-sized lymphoid cells with moderate pale-blue cytoplasm
Round to indented nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin; occasional small nucleoli
Some cells with irregular or notched nuclear contours
Smudge cell at the lower left
Background of normocytic red cells with few platelets
62205.describe_en: The smear shows clusters of medium-sized lymphoid cells with moderate pale-blue cytoplasm, round to indented nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, and occasional small nucleoli, in keeping with prolymphocytes. Some nuclei show irregular notches, and a smudge cell is present at the edge of the field. Small mature lymphocytes are underrepresented in this particular field. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with increased prolymphocytes in the context of the case immunophenotype (CD5+, CD23+, FMC7-negative).

ddx.vs: The irregular medium cells overlap morphologically, so a CD23-negative, cyclin D1/SOX11-positive phenotype or t(11;14) would be needed to favor mantle cell lymphoma.
B-PLL is defined by >55% prolymphocytes with prominent single nucleoli and a CD23-negative, FMC7-positive phenotype, unlike this CD23-positive CLL.
HCL-variant cells have prominent nucleoli with circumferential hairy cytoplasmic projections and are CD5/CD23-negative, CD11c/CD103-positive.

62077.recognize_zh: HPLC 報告顯示 HbA2 升高至 4.6%（>3.5%）、HbF 僅 1.0%，主峰為 HbA0 且無異常變異血紅素峰，這是 β 型地中海貧血帶因者（β-thalassemia minor）的典型結果。
features: Cation-exchange HPLC report (non-morphologic)
HbA2 elevated at 4.6% (retention time 3.64 min)
HbF 1.0% (retention time 1.09 min), normal to minimally increased
Dominant HbA0 peak (84.1%, 2.47 min) with P2/P3 minor peaks
No abnormal variant peak (e.g., HbS, HbE, HbD) in the variant windows
62077.describe_en: This is a cation-exchange high-performance liquid chromatography report rather than a morphologic image. The chromatogram shows a dominant HbA0 peak with an elevated HbA2 fraction of 4.6% and HbF of 1.0%, with small P2 and P3 peaks and no abnormal variant hemoglobin peak. An HbA2 above 3.5% with a normal HbA pattern is diagnostic of beta-thalassemia trait when correlated with microcytosis (low MCV/MCH) and normal iron studies. Findings are consistent with beta-thalassemia minor.

ddx.vs: Alpha-thalassemia trait shows normal or low HbA2 (<3.5%) despite microcytosis and requires alpha-globin gene deletion testing.
Iron deficiency lowers HbA2 and has low ferritin, so a raised HbA2 argues for beta-thalassemia trait (though coexisting iron deficiency can mask it).

ddx.dx: HbE trait or other variant co-eluting in the A2 window
ddx.vs: HbE and Hb Lepore co-elute with HbA2 but typically give values well above 10%, far higher than the 4.6% seen here.
Delta-beta thalassemia shows normal or low HbA2 with markedly raised HbF (5-20%).

exam.answer_en: Beta-thalassemia trait (minor) — HPLC shows raised HbA2 4.6% with normal HbF and no variant peak
pearls_zh: 考法：給 HPLC 圖要你讀出 HbA2、HbF 的百分比與滯留時間窗；HbA2 >3.5% 合併小球性（MCV/MCH 低）即支持 β-thalassemia trait。
小球性篩檢時若 HbA2 正常，需考慮 α-thalassemia trait（台灣最常見為 SEA deletion），須以 DNA 檢測確認，HPLC 無法診斷。
缺鐵會使 HbA2 下降，合併缺鐵時可能遮蔽 β-thal trait；應先查 ferritin，必要時補鐵後重驗。
遺傳諮詢：夫妻雙方皆為 β-thal 帶因者，每胎有 1/4 機率為重度 β-thalassemia，須安排產前診斷。
exam.pitfall_zh: 常被誤判為 α-thalassemia trait 或缺鐵性貧血；關鍵在 HbA2 >3.5%，α-thal 與缺鐵的 HbA2 正常或偏低。

quiz.q: 此 HPLC 報告中哪一個數值支持 β-thalassemia trait？
quiz.a: HbA2 升高至 4.6%（>3.5%），HbF 正常、無變異峰

62013.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍下細胞密集，可見成群的紅血球系前驅細胞，核圓、染色質細緻偏開放（megaloblastoid），另有散在的顆粒球與紅色嗜酸性顆粒細胞；紅血球系增生且核質成熟不同步，是 MDS 多系發育不良在切片上的表現。
features: Hypercellular marrow with clusters of erythroid precursors
Erythroid precursors with round nuclei, finely dispersed to open chromatin and moderate cytoplasm, suggestive of megaloblastoid change
Scattered mature and band neutrophils and occasional eosinophils
Few larger cells with prominent nucleoli but no sheets of blasts
Interstitial hemorrhage/red cells between hematopoietic cells
62013.describe_en: High-power H&E section of the bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with prominent clusters of erythroid precursors displaying round nuclei with relatively open chromatin, suggestive of megaloblastoid maturation. Granulocytic elements, including segmented neutrophils and occasional eosinophils, are admixed. Sheets of blasts are not seen, and megakaryocytes are not well represented in this field. The findings support erythroid hyperplasia with possible dyserythropoiesis, compatible with a myelodysplastic neoplasm such as MDS with ring sideroblasts and multilineage dysplasia; aspirate morphology and iron stain are required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia shows giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils with correction after vitamin replacement, whereas MDS persists and shows ring sideroblasts/clonal abnormalities.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of immature proerythroblasts (≥80% erythroid, ≥30% proerythroblasts), unlike the maturing clusters here.
Reactive hyperplasia shows orderly maturation without multilineage dysplasia or ring sideroblasts.

61949.recognize_zh: CD20染色下，許多大小不一的B細胞（含大型免疫母細胞）呈強膜狀陽性，散在或成小群，與陰性小T細胞混雜，呈現連續大小譜系而非單一片狀，符合EBV驅動的反應性B免疫母細胞增生。
features: Numerous CD20-positive B cells with strong membranous staining
Positive cells range from intermediate to large, including immunoblast-sized cells with vesicular nuclei
Scattered and loosely clustered distribution among CD20-negative small lymphocytes
No diffuse monotonous sheets of large CD20-positive cells
61949.describe_en: CD20 immunostain highlights many B cells with strong membranous staining, ranging from intermediate cells to large immunoblasts, distributed singly and in loose clusters among CD20-negative small lymphocytes. The positive cells do not form confluent sheets. The pattern supports an expanded, polymorphous activated B-cell population as seen in EBV reactivation; correlation with EBER ISH (positive in a spectrum of cell sizes) is recommended.

ddx.vs: DLBCL shows confluent sheets of large CD20+ cells effacing the tissue, with light-chain restriction or clonal IGH rearrangement.
HRS cells are CD20-negative or only weakly/variably positive, whereas the large immunoblasts here are strongly CD20+.
THRLBCL has rare scattered large CD20+ cells without small B cells, while this field shows abundant CD20+ cells of varied size.

61885.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見數個紡錘形、胞質塞滿深紫色異染顆粒的肥大細胞（spindle-shaped mast cells），旁邊聚集許多核偏心、胞質嗜鹼性且有核旁淡染區的漿細胞樣細胞，提示全身性肥大細胞症合併另一種血液腫瘤（SM-AHN）。
features: Spindle-shaped atypical mast cells with elongated nuclei and cytoplasm packed with dark purple metachromatic granules
Mast cells in small aggregates, with granules extending into tapering cytoplasmic tails
Adjacent clusters of plasmacytoid cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hofs
Occasional larger cells with abundant blue cytoplasm and immature-appearing chromatin
Admixed eosinophils, lymphocytes and maturing myeloid cells in the background
61885.describe_en: Two fields from a bone marrow aspirate smear. Both show aggregates of spindle-shaped atypical mast cells with elongated nuclei and cytoplasm densely filled with coarse metachromatic granules, a morphology associated with systemic mastocytosis. Closely associated with the mast cells are numerous plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin, basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hofs, along with scattered eosinophils, lymphocytes and myeloid precursors. The nature of the associated neoplasm cannot be determined from morphology alone and requires flow cytometry, immunohistochemistry (CD117, tryptase, CD25, CD138, light chains) and molecular studies. Findings are suggestive of systemic mastocytosis with an associated hematologic neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are round to oval, scattered singly and CD25/CD2 negative without KIT D816V, whereas these are spindled mast cells in aggregates.
Basophils have lobulated nuclei and larger, sparser water-soluble granules and are round, not spindled, and lack tryptase/CD117 co-expression typical of mast cells.
Reactive plasma cells are mature, scattered and polytypic, whereas a clonal plasma cell neoplasm shows increased atypical cells with light-chain restriction.

ddx.dx: Myeloid neoplasm with eosinophilia and tyrosine kinase fusion
ddx.vs: Neoplasms with PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1 fusions can show spindled mast cells with eosinophilia, but lack KIT D816V and carry the fusion by FISH/RT-PCR.

61821.recognize_zh: CD34 免疫染色中，陽性母細胞呈清楚的膜狀棕色環形染色，零散單個分布於骨髓間質與脂肪細胞之間，數量不多、未成片；其餘造血細胞為陰性。
features: CD34 IHC with crisp membranous brown staining of scattered round mononuclear cells
Positive cells present singly, without sheets or large aggregates in this field
Positive cells small-to-intermediate with round nuclei and a thin cytoplasmic rim
Faint granular background staining and positive fragments near vessels
Majority of hematopoietic cells negative; adipocytes present
61821.describe_en: CD34 immunohistochemical stain on the bone marrow core biopsy highlights scattered small-to-intermediate mononuclear cells with crisp membranous staining, present singly among negative hematopoietic cells and adipocytes. Sheets or large clusters of CD34-positive cells are not seen in this field. The CD34-positive cells should be estimated as a percentage of marrow cellularity across the entire core, since focal clustering or an increase above baseline would support progression. Findings indicate a modest population of CD34-positive precursors in this GATA2-associated myeloid neoplasm, without evidence of diffuse blast replacement in this field.

ddx.vs: Normal marrow contains fewer than about 2% scattered CD34-positive cells, so distinction rests on quantitation across the whole core.
AML shows diffuse sheets of CD34-positive blasts rather than scattered single cells.
Increased or clustered CD34-positive cells favor hypocellular MDS, whereas aplastic anemia shows markedly reduced CD34-positive cells.

61757.recognize_zh: kappa 原位雜交（ISH）中許多細胞的細胞質呈深藍黑色強陽性訊號，沿纖維血管區成片聚集，而同一病例的 lambda ISH 只有零星陽性；kappa 占絕對多數代表輕鏈限制（kappa restriction），支持脾臟邊緣區淋巴瘤的漿細胞分化為單株。
features: Numerous cells with strong dark blue-black cytoplasmic kappa mRNA signal
Positive cells have eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear rim of signal, consistent with plasma cells/plasmacytoid cells
Positive cells cluster in a band along a fibrovascular or trabecular region and scatter into adjacent tissue
Surrounding small lymphoid cells are negative with pale red counterstain
Interpretation of restriction requires comparison with the paired lambda ISH
61757.describe_en: Kappa light-chain in situ hybridization in splenic tissue shows many cells with strong cytoplasmic signal, morphologically plasma cells, arranged in aggregates along a fibrovascular band and scattered in the surrounding parenchyma. The background small lymphoid cells lack signal. When compared with the paired lambda ISH, which shows only rare positive cells, the plasma cells demonstrate kappa light-chain restriction. Findings are consistent with a monotypic plasmacytic component in splenic marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Shows a mixture of kappa- and lambda-positive plasma cells with a ratio of roughly 2:1 rather than marked kappa predominance.
Also has monotypic plasma cells, but usually shows MYD88 L265P and an IgM paraprotein with less marginal-zone and micronodular white pulp pattern.
Consists of sheets of monotypic CD138+ plasma cells without an accompanying CD20+ small B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Nonspecific ISH background or trapped serum
ddx.vs: Background staining is diffuse and extracellular rather than crisp cytoplasmic signal in individual cells.

61629.recognize_zh: BCL2 染色中大型細胞呈強烈棕色細胞質染色，沿著竇狀血管排成一串串環繞脂肪空泡，而小型造血細胞陰性；BCL2 陽性支持這些血管內大細胞為腫瘤性 B 細胞，但 BCL2 本身不具診斷特異性。
features: Strong cytoplasmic/perinuclear BCL2 staining in large atypical cells
Positive cells arranged in chains and cords within sinusoidal channels around fat spaces
Surrounding small hematopoietic cells largely BCL2 negative
Positive nuclei oval with vesicular chromatin in the counterstain window
61629.describe_en: BCL2 immunostain of the bone marrow biopsy shows strong cytoplasmic staining in large atypical cells arranged in chains and cords within sinusoidal spaces surrounding fat vacuoles. The adjacent small hematopoietic cells are largely negative. The distribution mirrors that of the CD20-positive intrasinusoidal infiltrate. BCL2 expression is common in intravascular large B-cell lymphoma, and the findings support the diagnosis in conjunction with CD20 positivity and the intravascular pattern.

ddx.vs: Normal T cells are small and BCL2 positive, whereas the positive cells here are large and correspond to the CD20-positive intrasinusoidal population.
FL is BCL2 positive but forms paratrabecular aggregates of small centrocytes that are CD10 positive, not large intrasinusoidal cells.
Also sinusoidal, but the cells are medium-sized, CD3 positive and CD20 negative.

61565.recognize_zh: 成群的異常前骨髓球，胞質布滿粗大紫紅色顆粒，中央細胞可見成束交錯的 Auer 小體（faggot cell），部分細胞核呈腎形或雙葉狀，符合高顆粒型 APL。
features: Cluster of large abnormal promyelocytes with dense coarse azurophilic granules
Central cell with bundles of crisscrossing Auer rods (faggot cell); other cells with single rods
Nuclei oval to reniform, some with folded or bilobed contour, partly obscured by granules
Disrupted cells releasing granules into the background
Image slightly out of focus with overlying refractile artifact limiting fine chromatin detail
61565.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of large abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm packed with coarse azurophilic granules that partly obscure oval to reniform nuclei. Several cells contain Auer rods, including a faggot cell with bundled crisscrossing rods. Numerous smudged cells release granules into the background; focus is suboptimal. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia, hypergranular type, and warrant urgent PML::RARA testing and coagulation studies.

ddx.vs: t(8;21) AML shows blasts with a single long slender Auer rod, perinuclear hof and salmon-pink granules with maturing neutrophils, not sheets of hypergranular promyelocytes with rod bundles.
Normal promyelocytes have an eccentric round nucleus with a clear perinuclear Golgi zone, visible nucleoli and no Auer rods.
The microgranular variant has bilobed 'butterfly' nuclei with sparse or dust-like granules and higher WBC, whereas these cells are densely granular.

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia, hypergranular — cluster of abnormal promyelocytes with coarse azurophilic granules and a central faggot cell
pearls_zh: 考法：在失焦與破碎細胞的圖中仍要找出成束交錯的 Auer rods（faggot cell），並說出 APL 的緊急處置。
抹片中大量破碎細胞釋出顆粒是 APL 常見現象，與細胞脆弱有關；顆粒內含促凝物質（tissue factor、annexin II 相關纖溶活化），連結 DIC 與高纖溶。
MPO 細胞化學強陽性且幾乎所有細胞陽性；flow 上 SSC 高、CD34 與 HLA-DR 陰性，是快速支持 APL 的線索。
避免操作：APL 疑似病人應避免不必要的侵入性處置（如中心靜脈導管、腰椎穿刺），以減少出血風險。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 AML with t(8;21) 混淆（也可見 Auer rods）；t(8;21) 的 blast 常為單一細長 Auer rod、有核旁淡染區與顆粒球成熟，APL 則為成束 faggot cell 且 CD34/HLA-DR 陰性。

quiz.q: APL 抹片中常見大量破碎細胞與散落顆粒，這與哪一項立即臨床併發症相關？
quiz.a: DIC 合併高纖溶（出血）

61501.recognize_zh: 這是 G 顯帶核型圖（karyogram）而非形態學影像：2 條 X、無 Y，第 1 對與第 9 對染色體被圈起，其中一條 1 號與一條 9 號長度與帶型與同源染色體不同，代表 t(1;9)(p13;p12) 平衡易位。
features: G-banded karyogram of a female metaphase (two X chromosomes, no Y)
Chromosome 1 pair circled: one homolog shows an altered short arm banding pattern and length
Chromosome 9 pair circled: one homolog shows altered short arm material, indicating the reciprocal partner
Remaining autosomes show 22 normal-appearing pairs; no marker chromosome in the mar slot
Banding resolution is modest, so exact breakpoints cannot be confirmed from the image alone
61501.describe_en: This figure is a G-banded karyogram rather than a morphologic image. It shows a female karyotype with 46 chromosomes in which one chromosome 1 and one chromosome 9 (both circled) display altered short-arm banding consistent with a reciprocal translocation, while the other chromosomes appear structurally normal. Given the modest banding resolution, the breakpoints are best reported with uncertainty, as 46,XX,t(1;9)(p?13;p?12). In the clinical context of CD19+/CD10+ B-lymphoblastic leukemia negative for common recurrent fusions, this is an uncommon sole abnormality; the 9p12 region includes PAX5, which could be evaluated by FISH or molecular testing.

ddx.vs: The recurrent t(1;19) involves 1q23 and 19p13 rather than 1p and 9p, and TCF3::PBX1 was negative by PCR in this case.
The Philadelphia translocation affects 9q34 and produces a shortened chromosome 22, which is not seen here.
9p deletions produce loss of material without a reciprocal partner on chromosome 1, so FISH or genomic studies are needed to distinguish them from a balanced translocation.

61437.recognize_zh: G 帶核型圖中圈起第 6、8、19 號各有三條（三體），第 9 對與第 22 號亦被圈起：22 號共三條、其中含縮短的費城染色體，提示除 t(9;22) 外還多一條 Ph；額外 Ph、+8、+19 皆屬 CML 進展期的主要途徑異常。
features: G-banded male karyogram (XY) with a hyperdiploid chromosome count
Three copies each of chromosomes 6, 8, and 19 (circled)
Chromosome 9 pair circled, consistent with involvement in t(9;22)
Three chromosome 22-sized elements circled, consistent with an additional Philadelphia chromosome (+der(22))
Band resolution limits confident distinction of normal 22 from Ph chromosomes; FISH confirmation advised
61437.describe_en: G-banded karyogram shows a male hyperdiploid complement with trisomies of chromosomes 6, 8, and 19, together with t(9;22)(q34;q11.2) and an additional copy of the Philadelphia chromosome, approximating 50,XY,+6,+8,t(9;22)(q34;q11.2),+19,+der(22)t(9;22). An extra Ph, trisomy 8, and trisomy 19 are major-route additional chromosomal abnormalities associated with progression. At this banding resolution, the identity of each chromosome 22 homolog cannot be fully resolved, and BCR::ABL1 FISH is recommended to confirm the number of fusion signals. In a patient with myeloid blast phase CML, this represents clonal evolution.

ddx.dx: CML chronic phase with Ph only
ddx.vs: Shows an isolated t(9;22) without additional chromosomal abnormalities.
Lacks a preceding chronic phase, basophilia, or splenomegaly and less often shows major-route ACAs like +Ph.
Gains typically involve X, 4, 6, 10, 14, 17, 18, 21 without t(9;22), and blasts are B-lymphoid.

61373.recognize_zh: NPM1 免疫染色（紅色呈色）中，大量細胞的細胞核與細胞質都被染成紅色（灰箭頭，異位於細胞質，代表 NPM1 突變），而少數細胞只有細胞核著色、細胞質淡染（黑箭頭，野生型的核內分布），這是 NPM1 突變 AML 的免疫組化替代指標。
features: Numerous marrow cells with diffuse red nuclear and cytoplasmic NPM1 staining (aberrant cytoplasmic localization, gray arrow)
Scattered cells with nuclear-restricted staining and unstained cytoplasm (wild-type pattern, black arrow)
Cytoplasm-positive cells form cohesive clusters in the interstitium between fat spaces
Some small cells with blue hematoxylin-counterstained nuclei are negative or weak
Hemosiderin-laden macrophages with brown pigment scattered in the stroma
61373.describe_en: Immunohistochemistry for nucleophosmin (NPM1) on the bone marrow biopsy shows numerous cells with combined nuclear and cytoplasmic staining (gray arrow), indicating aberrant cytoplasmic dislocation of NPM1, arranged in interstitial clusters between fat spaces. For comparison, other hematopoietic cells show a nuclear-restricted staining pattern consistent with wild-type NPM1 (black arrow). Scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages are present. In a patient previously treated for NPM1-mutated acute myeloid leukemia, the findings are consistent with residual NPM1-mutated cells, and the extent of disease should be correlated with morphology and NPM1 quantitative PCR for measurable residual disease.

ddx.vs: All cells show nuclear-restricted NPM1 staining without cytoplasmic positivity.
Is weak and diffuse including stroma and fat, whereas true NPM1c shows crisp cytoplasmic staining confined to hematopoietic cells with internal wild-type controls.

ddx.dx: AML with other NPM1 dislocation (e.g. NPM1 rearranged or rare variants)
ddx.vs: Cannot be separated by immunostain, so molecular testing for the NPM1 exon 12 mutation is required.

61245.recognize_zh: A 周邊血抹片白血球極度增多，以核深染、細胞質極少的小淋巴球為主，並有多個破碎的籃狀細胞（smudge cell）；B 紅血球體積分布圖在大體積端有一個額外小峰（箭頭），代表大量白血球被計入紅血球通道；C 為校正後該峰消失。這說明高白血球會假性提高紅血球數與 MCV。
features: Panel A (PB smear): marked leukocytosis composed predominantly of small mature-appearing lymphocytes with dense clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Numerous smudge (basket) cells among the lymphocytes; red cells normochromic without obvious agglutination
Panel B (RBC volume histogram): main normal red cell peak with an additional small peak/shoulder in the high-volume region (arrow)
Panel C (RBC histogram, corrected or after dilution/WBC subtraction): single red cell peak without the high-volume shoulder
Figure is partly non-morphologic, illustrating analyzer interference
61245.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis with a predominance of small lymphocytes with condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm, accompanied by numerous smudge cells. The red cell volume histogram shows an abnormal secondary population in the large-volume region (arrow), which is absent on the corrected histogram. In hyperleukocytosis, leukocytes fall within the impedance red cell counting threshold and are counted as large red cells, falsely increasing the RBC count, hematocrit and MCV and distorting the RDW. Findings illustrate spurious red cell indices due to extreme leukocytosis, here in a lymphoproliferative disorder morphologically suggestive of chronic lymphocytic leukemia; RBC count should be corrected by subtracting the WBC count, and hemoglobin checked for turbidity interference.

ddx.vs: Red cell clumps produce a high-volume histogram tail with falsely low RBC count and high MCV/MCHC, and agglutinates are seen on the smear, rather than increased leukocytes.
These interfere at the low-volume end of the RBC histogram and the platelet channel, not at the high-volume end.
Shifts the entire red cell peak to the right rather than adding a separate high-volume peak, and macrocytes are seen on the smear.
Affects hemoglobin and MCHC via turbidity without adding a high-volume particle population.

61181.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中出現體積大、細胞核圓、細胞質帶空泡的非造血細胞，有時成群（A 格）；C、D 格細胞角蛋白（cytokeratin）免疫染色陽性，證實是周邊血中的癌細胞（carcinocythemia）。
features: Large cells several times the size of red cells, singly and in loose clusters (panel A, 40x)
Round to oval nuclei with fine to moderately condensed chromatin and high N:C ratio (panel B, 60x)
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm with fine peripheral vacuolation and irregular borders
Clustered cells in panel A intermixed with leukocytes along the smear feathered area
Cytokeratin immunocytochemistry shows strong cytoplasmic positivity in the large cells and cell clusters (panels C/D), with negative background leukocytes
61181.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows clusters and single large atypical cells among leukocytes at low power. At high power the cells have round nuclei, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, and basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm, superficially resembling blasts or lymphoma cells. Immunocytochemistry for cytokeratin is strongly positive in these cells while background hematopoietic cells are negative, establishing epithelial lineage. Findings are consistent with carcinocythemia (carcinoma cell leukemia) from a metastatic carcinoma; primary site correlation with site-specific markers is recommended.

ddx.vs: Blasts do not form cohesive clusters and are cytokeratin negative while expressing CD34, MPO or lineage-specific hematopoietic markers.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are discohesive, CD45 and B- or T-cell marker positive and cytokeratin negative.

ddx.dx: Circulating neuroblastoma or small round cell tumor
ddx.vs: Neuroblastoma cells are smaller with scant cytoplasm and are synaptophysin/PHOX2B positive but typically cytokeratin negative.

ddx.dx: Megakaryocyte fragments or circulating endothelial cells
ddx.vs: Megakaryocyte nuclei are lobulated with granular cytoplasm and CD61 positive, and endothelial cells are elongated and CD31 positive, neither expressing cytokeratin.

61117.recognize_zh: 低倍皮膚切片可見真皮全層被密集的結節狀淋巴球浸潤占據，並向下延伸至皮下，表皮本身未受侵犯；這種「由下而上」的結節狀、瀰漫性真皮浸潤是皮膚邊緣區淋巴瘤（MALT lymphoma）的低倍線索，但需高倍與免疫染色確認。
features: Dense, nodular to confluent lymphoid infiltrate occupying the full thickness of the dermis
Infiltrate extends into the deep dermis/subcutis as separate nodules
Epidermis is intact and not involved; a thin superficial dermal band appears relatively spared
Vaguely nodular pattern with paler areas suggestive of follicles or marginal zone expansion (not resolvable at this power)
Interstitial extension between collagen bundles at the periphery of the infiltrate
61117.describe_en: Low-power H&E sections of a skin punch biopsy show a dense, nodular to diffuse lymphoid infiltrate involving the entire thickness of the dermis and extending into the deep dermis and subcutaneous tissue. The overlying epidermis is intact without epidermotropism. Cytologic detail and the composition of the nodules cannot be assessed at this magnification. In the appropriate immunophenotypic context, the architecture is compatible with cutaneous extranodal marginal zone lymphoma (MALT lymphoma).

ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates are usually top-heavy with well-formed germinal centers and polytypic plasma cells, whereas MZL shows bottom-heavy expansion of marginal zone cells and light-chain-restricted plasma cells.

PCFCL shows follicular or diffuse centrocytes/centroblasts that are BCL6-positive, while MZL cells are small marginal zone/plasmacytoid cells that are BCL6- and CD10-negative outside colonized follicles.

CLL/SLL infiltrates are composed of monotonous small round lymphocytes with proliferation centers and a CD5+/CD23+ phenotype, unlike the CD5-negative mixed marginal zone/plasma cell population of MZL.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous CD4+ small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder
ddx.vs: This lesion is a CD4+ T-cell nodule with PD1+ follicular helper cells, whereas MZL is a CD20+ B-cell and clonal plasma cell infiltrate.

61053.recognize_zh: 一顆大型異常前骨髓細胞，胞質內有許多交錯成束的細長桿狀物（成束 Auer rods），像一捆柴（faggot cell），這是急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL, PML::RARA）的特徵。
features: Large cell with abundant cytoplasm containing multiple bundles of slender, crisscrossing Auer rods
Nucleus partially obscured, with fine chromatin
Adjacent smaller cell with round nucleus, fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm with faint granules
Background red cells; photograph has a green-grey color cast that reduces granule contrast
61053.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large leukemic cell whose cytoplasm contains numerous bundles of stacked, crisscrossing Auer rods (a faggot cell). The nucleus is partially obscured by the rods and has fine chromatin. An adjacent immature cell with basophilic cytoplasm is also present. Findings are highly suggestive of acute promyelocytic leukemia with PML::RARA; urgent coagulation studies and confirmatory PML::RARA testing are indicated.

ddx.vs: t(8;21) blasts typically have a single long slender Auer rod with a perinuclear hof and salmon granules, not bundles of multiple rods.
The microgranular variant shows bilobed nuclei with sparse visible granules and rare faggot cells, while this cell shows abundant rod bundles; both require PML::RARA confirmation.
Normal promyelocytes have discrete primary granules and a paranuclear hof but never contain Auer rods.

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia — faggot cell containing bundles of Auer rods
pearls_zh: 考法：指單一細胞問名稱（faggot cell）與疾病；追問必驗基因：t(15;17)(q24.1;q21.2) PML::RARA。
急症：APL 常合併 DIC 與過度纖溶，一旦懷疑應立即開始 ATRA，不需等基因確認，並積極補充血小板、cryoprecipitate/fibrinogen。
治療：低/中危以 ATRA + arsenic trioxide 為標準；注意 differentiation syndrome（發燒、呼吸窘迫、體重增加），以 dexamethasone 處理。
表型：MPO 強陽性；flow 常 CD33+、CD13+，CD34−、HLA-DR−。WBC >10×10⁹/L 為高危。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 t(8;21) AML 中單一細長的 Auer rod；faggot cell 為成束交錯的多根 Auer rods，仍需 PML::RARA 確認。

quiz.q: 圖中胞質含成束 Auer rods 的細胞叫什麼？對應的融合基因為何？
quiz.a: Faggot cell；PML::RARA，t(15;17)

60861.recognize_zh: CD10 染色僅在結節周圍的真皮基質（纖維母細胞／血管周圍）呈條紋狀陽性，結節內的 B 細胞則為陰性；腫瘤細胞 CD10 陰性有助排除皮膚濾泡中心淋巴瘤，支持邊緣區淋巴瘤。
features: Large dermal lymphoid nodule composed of CD10-negative cells
Streaky, reticular CD10 staining of stromal cells and fibroblasts around and between nodules
No CD10-positive germinal center-type cells within the nodule
Epidermis/adnexal epithelium at upper right negative
60861.describe_en: CD10 immunostain of the skin biopsy shows a large dermal lymphoid nodule that is negative for CD10. Staining is restricted to streaky stromal and perivascular cells surrounding and dissecting the nodules. No CD10-positive follicle center cells are identified within the infiltrate. The lack of CD10 expression by the lesional B cells argues against a follicle center cell origin and is consistent with primary cutaneous marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: PCFCL neoplastic cells are BCL6 positive and frequently CD10 positive in follicular areas, whereas the lesional nodule here is CD10 negative.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous lymphoid hyperplasia with germinal centers
ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers contain CD10-positive centroblasts and centrocytes in discrete follicles, which are not seen in this nodule.
MCL is also CD10 negative, so cyclin D1 and SOX11 are needed to exclude it.

60797.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量母細胞樣腫瘤細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、胞質灰藍含細小空泡，部分成小團黏聚（A），易誤認為急性白血病；切片為瀰漫片狀浸潤（B），流式顯示 CD45 陰性族群（C），免疫染色瀰漫陽性（D、E），FISH 顯示基因分離訊號（Fi、Fii），支持橫紋肌肉瘤。
features: Panel A: numerous large blast-like cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli and gray-blue cytoplasm with fine vacuoles
Some tumor cells form small cohesive clusters with molding, a clue to non-hematopoietic origin
Panel B: biopsy with diffuse sheet-like marrow replacement by small round blue cells
Panel C: flow cytometry plot showing a CD45-negative population (red) separate from CD45-positive leukocytes
Panels D-E: diffuse strong immunoreactivity of tumor cells (myogenic markers expected; antibodies not labeled)
Panels Fi-Fii: interphase FISH with split red/green signals suggesting a gene rearrangement (e.g. FOXO1 break-apart)
60797.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate (A) shows extensive infiltration by large blast-like cells with fine chromatin, small nucleoli and vacuolated gray-blue cytoplasm, some arranged in small cohesive clusters. The biopsy (B) shows diffuse replacement of the marrow by small round blue cells. Flow cytometry (C) identifies a CD45-negative tumor population, and immunohistochemistry (D, E) shows diffuse strong staining of the tumor cells. Interphase FISH (Fi, Fii) demonstrates separated signals consistent with a gene rearrangement. Findings are consistent with rhabdomyosarcoma (likely alveolar type) with massive marrow involvement, mimicking acute leukemia.

ddx.vs: Blasts are discohesive and CD45-positive with CD34/TdT/MPO expression, whereas these cells are CD45-negative and form clusters.
Forms Homer Wright rosettes with neuropil and is PHOX2B/synaptophysin positive, myogenin negative.
Small round cells with membranous CD99 and NKX2-2 and EWSR1 rearrangement rather than desmin/myogenin and FOXO1 rearrangement.
Vacuolated basophilic cells can mimic, but they are CD45+, CD20+/CD10+ with MYC rearrangement.

60797.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC; flow cytometry; FISH

60605.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量中等大小、核卵圓或腎形、染色質細緻、細胞質豐富淡灰藍且邊緣毛躁的毛細胞，中間夾一個核偏位、有核旁淡染區的大型漿細胞；雙重免疫染色分別標出兩群細胞，提示毛細胞白血病合併漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Numerous medium-sized lymphoid cells with oval to reniform nuclei, spongy chromatin and abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm with irregular borders (hairy cells)
Large plasma cell with eccentric nucleus, perinuclear hof and deeply basophilic cytoplasm in the center (among the arrows)
Arrows mark the adjacent atypical cells for comparison

Biopsy double immunostain: scattered cells with red membranous/cytoplasmic staining and a separate population with brown nuclear staining among negative blue cells; antibodies not labeled in the figure
60605.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous medium-sized lymphoid cells with oval to bean-shaped nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm with irregular margins, consistent with hairy cells. Admixed is a large atypical plasma cell with an eccentric nucleus, prominent perinuclear hof and basophilic cytoplasm. A dual-color immunohistochemical stain on the core biopsy highlights two distinct populations (red cytoplasmic/membranous and brown nuclear staining); the specific markers are not labeled in this figure. In conjunction with flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and plasma cell clonality studies, findings are consistent with concurrent hairy cell leukemia and plasma cell neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant / splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli
ddx.vs: Shows prominent nucleoli, CD25 and annexin A1 negativity and lacks BRAF V600E.

ddx.dx: Splenic marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: SMZL plasma cells share the same light chain as the B cells and villous lymphocytes are CD103/CD25 negative with polar projections.
LPL shows a continuum of small lymphocytes to plasma cells with MYD88 L265P, rather than hairy cells with abundant cytoplasm plus a separate atypical plasma cell population.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasmacytosis in hairy cell leukemia
ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are polytypic and mature, whereas myeloma shows light-chain restriction, aberrant CD56 or loss of CD19.

60605.stain: Wright-Giemsa; IHC: dual stain (markers not labeled)

60669.recognize_zh: A 圖周邊血紅血球略偏大，部分細胞中央淡染區呈狹長裂縫狀（箭頭，口形紅血球 stomatocyte）；C、D 圖骨髓切片高度增生、以紅血球系增生為主，並有散在巨核細胞（箭頭），這種代償性增生加上輕微異型容易被誤判為 MDS，實為脫水型遺傳性口形紅血球症。
features: PB (A): normochromic, mildly macrocytic red cells, several with slit-like or mouth-shaped central pallor (stomatocytes, arrow)
Occasional target-like and teardrop-like poikilocytes; no significant schistocytes or spherocytes
BM biopsy low power (C): markedly hypercellular marrow with near-complete loss of fat between trabeculae
BM biopsy high power (D): erythroid-predominant hyperplasia with clusters of erythroid precursors and scattered megakaryocytes (arrows)
Panel B: cellular marrow preparation with scattered golden-brown pigment; stain type and details limited by image resolution
60669.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (panel A) shows mildly macrocytic, normochromic red cells, a subset of which have slit-like central pallor consistent with stomatocytes, without schistocytes or agglutination. The bone marrow biopsy (panels C and D) is markedly hypercellular with erythroid hyperplasia and scattered megakaryocytes, which in some cases appear mildly atypical; panel B shows a cellular marrow preparation whose stain and fine detail cannot be confidently assessed at this resolution. There is no clear increase in blasts in these fields. Findings reflect compensatory erythroid hyperplasia in a chronic hemolytic state and are consistent with dehydrated hereditary stomatocytosis (xerocytosis, e.g., PIEZO1 variant), which can be mistaken for a myelodysplastic syndrome.

ddx.vs: MDS shows true multilineage dysplasia (e.g., ring sideroblasts, micromegakaryocytes, pseudo-Pelger neutrophils) and clonal cytogenetic/molecular abnormalities, whereas xerocytosis shows reactive erythroid hyperplasia with elevated MCHC and reticulocytosis.
OHSt shows many more stomatocytes with low MCHC and high red cell cation content, whereas DHSt has few stomatocytes, high MCHC, and a left-shifted osmotic gradient ektacytometry curve.
HS shows round dense spherocytes and positive EMA binding, not slit-like stomatocytes with a dehydrated ektacytometry profile.

ddx.dx: Acquired stomatocytosis (alcohol, liver disease, drying artifact)
ddx.vs: Artifactual stomatocytes occur only in thick smear areas and acquired forms have a clinical cause, whereas DHSt is familial with a PIEZO1/KCNN4 variant.

60733.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見大片無細胞結構、淡紫色的無定形膠狀物質；切片骨髓腔內造血細胞與脂肪減少，被淡藍灰色、細纖維狀的細胞外基質取代，伴隨出血，符合神經性厭食症引起的骨髓膠樣轉化 (gelatinous transformation / serous fat atrophy)。
features: Panel A (aspirate): large sheet of amorphous, pale purple extracellular material with scattered embedded cells and fat droplets
Panel B (biopsy): hypocellular marrow with loss of fat cells, replaced by pale basophilic, finely fibrillar extracellular material and extravasated red cells
Panel C: special stain (unlabeled) highlighting the extracellular material in blue (consistent with Alcian blue-positive mucopolysaccharide)
Panel D: additional stain (unlabeled) with purple-blue staining of the ground substance
Residual hematopoietic elements sparse; no tumor cells, granulomas or fibrosis-type collagen bands identified
60733.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate contains abundant amorphous, pale purple acellular material with few hematopoietic cells. The core biopsy is markedly hypocellular with atrophy of both hematopoietic cells and fat, which are replaced by pale, finely fibrillar extracellular ground substance with interstitial hemorrhage; special stains (not labeled in the figure) highlight this material, consistent with acid mucopolysaccharide. In the clinical setting of anorexia nervosa, findings are consistent with gelatinous transformation (serous atrophy) of the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Edema is pale eosinophilic and Alcian blue negative, without replacement of fat cells by basophilic ground substance.
Amyloid is dense, waxy eosinophilic and Congo red positive with apple-green birefringence, typically perivascular.
Myelofibrosis shows increased reticulin/collagen fibers with streaming atypical megakaryocytes rather than amorphous mucoid material.
Aplastic marrow is replaced by fat cells, not by basophilic gelatinous substance with fat atrophy.

exam.answer_en: Gelatinous transformation (serous atrophy) of marrow in anorexia nervosa — hypocellular marrow with fat and hematopoietic atrophy replaced by pale ground substance
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指切片中取代脂肪與造血細胞的淡粉紅無結構物質，問「這是什麼變化？常見原因？」→ gelatinous transformation，嚴重營養不良。
特殊染色：沉積物為 acid mucopolysaccharide（hyaluronic acid），Alcian blue（pH 2.5）陽性；Congo red 陰性。
常見原因：anorexia nervosa、惡病質、HIV/AIDS、結核等慢性消耗性疾病與酒精；病人常伴全血球低下。
營養恢復後骨髓多可逆轉，不需化療或免疫抑制治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 amyloid 沉積或 aplastic anemia：amyloid 為 Congo red 陽性並偏光呈蘋果綠；aplastic anemia 為脂肪取代，而非脂肪萎縮加膠狀基質。

quiz.q: 圖中取代骨髓脂肪與造血細胞的淡色基質可用哪種特殊染色證實？此變化稱為什麼？
quiz.a: Alcian blue（acid mucopolysaccharide）；gelatinous transformation / serous atrophy

60541.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍下，一片密集的中型單核細胞，細胞核卵圓至不規則或拉長、染色質細緻略成團、核仁不明顯，細胞質中等量淡粉紅；其間散在深染皺縮的凋亡／固縮核，這是漿細胞樣樹突細胞（PDC）聚集與反應性淋巴聚集區分的線索。
features: Dense aggregate of medium-sized mononuclear cells replacing marrow in this field
Oval, indented, to elongated irregular nuclei with fine to finely clumped chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate pale eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm with indistinct borders
Scattered pyknotic and apoptotic nuclei (small dense dark bodies) within the aggregate
Few red cells and eosinophilic proteinaceous material at the lower left; no normal hematopoiesis in the field
60541.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy at high power shows a dense aggregate of medium-sized mononuclear cells with oval to irregular and elongated nuclei, finely clumped chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm. Scattered pyknotic and apoptotic nuclei are present within the aggregate. Normal hematopoietic elements are not seen in this field, and the nodular configuration cannot be appreciated at this magnification. In the context of a myelodysplastic background, the cytologic features and scattered apoptotic bodies are consistent with nodular aggregates of plasmacytoid dendritic cells, which should be confirmed with CD123, TCF4, and CD303 immunostains and distinguished from BPDCN and reactive lymphoid aggregates.

ddx.vs: Benign lymphoid aggregates consist of small round lymphocytes with condensed chromatin, often with small vessels and no apoptotic debris, and are CD123-negative.
BPDCN shows diffuse blastoid cells with finer chromatin and small nucleoli co-expressing CD4, CD56, CD123 and TCF4, usually with skin lesions, rather than mature PDC nodules in a myeloid neoplasm.
Lymphoma infiltrates show a monoclonal B- or T-cell phenotype on IHC and flow cytometry, not CD123+ plasmacytoid dendritic cells.
Mast cell aggregates contain spindled cells with clear to granular cytoplasm, often with eosinophils and fibrosis, and are tryptase/CD117 positive.

60477.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中，單一形態的小至中型細胞瀰漫浸潤，每顆圓或卵圓形核周圍都有一圈清亮或淡染的細胞質，細胞核彼此間隔均勻，呈「荷包蛋（fried egg）」樣，是毛狀細胞白血病的典型骨髓切片型態。
features: Diffuse interstitial infiltrate of monotonous small to medium-sized cells
Round to oval or slightly indented nuclei with bland chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Abundant clear to pale cytoplasm producing evenly spaced nuclei (fried-egg appearance)
Extravasated red cells in the interstitium between tumor cells
Reduced normal hematopoiesis; a megakaryocyte at the edge and residual fat spaces
60477.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a diffuse interstitial infiltrate of monotonous small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval or indented nuclei, bland chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Each cell has abundant clear to pale cytoplasm, so that nuclei appear widely and evenly spaced, imparting a fried-egg appearance; extravasated red cells are present in the interstitium. Normal hematopoietic elements are reduced. Findings are consistent with involvement by hairy cell leukemia, to be confirmed by immunohistochemistry (CD20, annexin A1, cyclin D1, BRAF V600E) and reticulin stain.

ddx.vs: Mast cell infiltrates have spindled or oval cells with granular cytoplasm, paratrabecular/perivascular aggregates with fibrosis and eosinophils, and are tryptase/CD117/CD25 positive, CD20 negative.
SMZL typically forms nodular and intrasinusoidal infiltrates of cells with less abundant cytoplasm and is annexin A1/BRAF V600E negative.
Hypocellular marrows lack a monotonous CD20-positive infiltrate, which may be subtle in HCL and must be sought by immunohistochemistry.
Monocytic infiltrates have folded nuclei, finer chromatin and are CD20 negative while lysozyme/CD163 positive.

exam.answer_en: Hairy cell leukemia, bone marrow — diffuse interstitial infiltrate with widely spaced nuclei and clear cytoplasm (fried-egg appearance)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指「荷包蛋」樣、核間距均勻的浸潤細胞，問診斷與為何抽吸常 dry tap。
骨髓切片 IHC：CD20+、annexin A1+（最特異，但也染骨髓系與 T 細胞）、TRAP+、cyclin D1 弱陽、BRAF V600E（VE1）+、CD72 (DBA.44)+。
HCL 骨髓因 reticulin 纖維增生常抽不出（dry tap），因此骨髓切片與 IHC 是評估浸潤程度的主要依據。
浸潤可很細微（間質性、非結節），低倍易被當作低細胞性骨髓；CD20 染色可凸顯實際浸潤範圍。
exam.pitfall_zh: 低細胞性表現易誤判為 aplastic anemia 或 hypocellular MDS；另 systemic mastocytosis 也有透明細胞質，但為紡錘形、tryptase/CD117 陽性且伴嗜酸球與纖維化。

quiz.q: 骨髓切片中核間距均勻、細胞質透明的「荷包蛋」樣浸潤最符合哪個疾病？為何骨髓抽吸常失敗？
quiz.a: Hairy cell leukemia；reticulin 纖維化造成 dry tap

60349.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片旁有骨小樑，骨髓腔大多是脂肪與疏鬆水腫狀基質，細胞明顯偏少；殘存的細胞多為單一形態的中型單核細胞，核卵圓或凹陷、染色質開放並見小核仁，缺乏成熟造血，符合低細胞性骨髓中以母細胞為主的 AML。
features: Hypocellular marrow with abundant fat and loose, edematous stroma adjacent to a bony trabecula
Residual cellularity dominated by scattered, loosely arranged intermediate-sized mononuclear cells
Round, oval to indented/folded nuclei with open, fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale cytoplasm
Paucity of maturing granulocytic, erythroid and megakaryocytic elements; no megakaryocytes in this field
60349.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypocellular marrow with abundant adipose tissue and loose edematous stroma adjacent to an unremarkable bony trabecula. The residual hematopoietic cells consist predominantly of a monotonous population of intermediate-sized mononuclear cells with round to indented nuclei, fine open chromatin, small nucleoli and scant pale cytoplasm, arranged singly and in loose clusters. Maturing trilineage hematopoiesis, including megakaryocytes, is markedly diminished. In conjunction with aspirate and immunophenotypic findings, this represents hypocellular marrow replaced predominantly by blasts, consistent with acute myeloid leukemia; the t(9;11)(p22;q23) establishes AML with KMT2A-MLLT3.

ddx.vs: Aplastic marrow is hypocellular but residual cells are lymphocytes, plasma cells and mast cells without clusters of blasts; CD34 IHC shows no increase.
Hypocellular MDS shows dysplastic megakaryocytes and fewer than 20% blasts, whereas blasts dominate here (CD34/CD117 IHC to quantify).
Serous atrophy shows extracellular pale mucoid material with fat atrophy and sparse normal hematopoietic cells rather than an atypical immature population.

60285.recognize_zh: G 帶核型圖（XY 男性）中箭頭指出一條 6 號染色體短臂末端與一條 9 號染色體長臂末端的片段交換，即 t(6;9)(p23;q34)，形成 DEK-NUP214 融合，常伴嗜鹼性球增多與多系發育不良。
features: G-banded karyogram with 46 chromosomes; X and a faint Y present
Arrow at the distal short arm of one chromosome 6 showing altered terminal banding (der(6))
Arrow at the distal long arm of one chromosome 9 showing an elongated/altered terminal segment (der(9))
Interpretation: 46,XY,t(6;9)(p23;q34), DEK-NUP214
One chromosome 21 image appears distorted, most likely an imaging artifact rather than a structural change
60285.describe_en: This G-banded karyogram shows a male metaphase with 46 chromosomes and a reciprocal translocation involving the terminal short arm of chromosome 6 and the terminal long arm of chromosome 9, marked by arrows on the derivative chromosomes. The karyotype corresponds to 46,XY,t(6;9)(p23;q34). This rearrangement produces the DEK-NUP214 fusion and defines AML with t(6;9)(p23;q34.1); DEK-NUP214, which is associated with basophilia, multilineage dysplasia, frequent FLT3-ITD and a poor prognosis. Because both breakpoints are near telomeric regions, FISH or RT-PCR confirmation is recommended.

ddx.vs: Both involve 9q34, but t(9;22) produces a shortened chromosome 22 (Philadelphia chromosome) whereas here the partner is chromosome 6p.
Morphology can overlap, but the presence of t(6;9) classifies the case as AML with DEK-NUP214 (with at least 10% blasts in current classifications).

60221.recognize_zh: 四格普魯士藍（Prussian blue）骨髓鐵染色對照圖：標示4+的格子有大片藍黑色團塊，3+、2+依序減少至零星藍色顆粒，標示0的格子完全看不到藍色，示範骨髓鐵儲存量的分級，0級即支持缺鐵。
features: Composite of four bone marrow particle preparations stained with Prussian blue, labeled 4+, 3+, 2+ and 0
4+: large coarse blue-black clumps of hemosiderin throughout the particle
3+: abundant blue granules and small aggregates, less confluent than 4+
2+: scattered small blue granules within particle stroma
0: no blue staining; only red counterstained cells and fat spaces
60221.describe_en: This composite figure shows Prussian blue-stained bone marrow aspirate particles illustrating grading of storage iron. The 4+ panel shows large confluent hemosiderin deposits, the 3+ panel abundant granules and small clumps, and the 2+ panel scattered small granules, while the 0 panel shows no stainable iron within the particle. Grading should be performed on marrow particles rather than on isolated cells. Absent stainable iron (0) is consistent with depleted iron stores as in iron deficiency anemia.

ddx.vs: Marrow storage iron is normal to increased (2+ to 4+) despite low serum iron, whereas iron deficiency shows absent iron.
Absence of iron cannot be interpreted without adequate particles, so a negative result must be verified on a particle-rich smear.
Can produce coarse increased macrophage iron (high grade) with persistent iron-deficient erythropoiesis, so clinical history is required.

exam.answer_en: Bone marrow storage iron grading (Prussian blue) — particles graded 4+, 3+, 2+ and 0; absent stainable iron (0) indicates depleted stores as in iron deficiency
pearls_zh: 判讀：骨髓鐵分級要看 marrow particle 內巨噬細胞的 hemosiderin，而不是散在的單一細胞；沒有足夠 particles 時不能判為 0。
骨髓鐵缺乏是鐵缺乏的傳統金標準，但臨床多已由 ferritin 取代；在發炎使 ferritin 不可靠時，骨髓鐵染色仍有鑑別價值。
鐵染色必看兩部分：巨噬細胞儲存鐵（ACD 為正常或增加、IDA 為缺乏）與紅母細胞內的 sideroblast；ring sideroblast 定義為 ≥5 顆鐵顆粒環繞核周至少 1/3。
MDS 連結：ring sideroblasts ≥15%，或合併 SF3B1 突變時 ≥5%，為 MDS with ring sideroblasts／SF3B1 的診斷依據。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤判的是 aparticulate 抹片被讀成 0 級鐵，或把 anemia of chronic inflammation 當成缺鐵；後者骨髓儲存鐵正常或增加（2+–4+）但血清鐵低，須在含 particle 的片子上判讀。

quiz.q: 病人血清鐵低、ferritin 正常偏高，骨髓鐵染色若呈 3+，最可能的診斷是缺鐵性貧血還是慢性發炎性貧血？
quiz.a: Anemia of chronic inflammation（儲存鐵正常/增加，鐵利用受阻）。

60157.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片可見擴張的竇狀血管，內有巨核細胞位於竇腔內（intrasinusoidal），周圍有多顆細胞核深染、形狀不規則的非典型巨核細胞，右側基質呈梭形細胞平行排列的「流線狀」（streaming），提示真性紅血球增多症後骨髓纖維化。
features: Dilated sinusoid containing an intraluminal megakaryocyte with a hyperchromatic, irregularly lobated nucleus
Increased atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, clumped or bulbous nuclei, some small with high N:C ratio
Streaming architecture: elongated spindled nuclei and hematopoietic cells aligned in parallel within a fibrotic stroma
Residual trilineage hematopoiesis including clusters of erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei and granulocytic cells
Loose fibrillary stroma replacing normal marrow architecture on the right side of the field
60157.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine section shows a hypercellular marrow with distorted architecture. There are dilated sinusoids, one containing an intrasinusoidal megakaryocyte, and hematopoietic elements show a streaming pattern within a fibrillar stroma. Megakaryocytes are increased and atypical, with hyperchromatic, irregular to cloud-like nuclei. Residual trilineage hematopoiesis, including erythroid and granulocytic precursors, is present. Findings are consistent with post-polycythemic myelofibrosis in a patient with a history of polycythemia vera; reticulin/trichrome stains are needed to grade fibrosis.

ddx.vs: Morphology is essentially identical; separation requires a documented prior history of polycythemia vera (or ET) rather than a de novo presentation.
MDS with fibrosis shows small hypolobated or separated-lobe dysplastic megakaryocytes and dyserythropoiesis/dysgranulopoiesis, usually without prior erythrocytosis or intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis.
APMF has an increased CD34+ blast population (≥20%) with small dysplastic megakaryocytes and an acute clinical onset.
Carcinoma forms cohesive epithelial clusters that are keratin-positive, whereas here the large cells are megakaryocytes (CD61/CD42b-positive) scattered among hematopoietic cells.

exam.answer_en: Post-polycythemic myelofibrosis — atypical hyperchromatic megakaryocytes, intrasinusoidal megakaryocyte in dilated sinusoid and streaming fibrotic stroma
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會指著擴張竇狀血管內的巨核細胞問意義——intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis 是骨髓纖維化期的特徵，另可指著流線狀排列的基質問 streaming。
PV 進展為纖維化期時，巨核細胞由多形成熟型轉為核深染、雲朵狀、叢集的非典型型態，與 PMF 纖維化期形態相似，需靠 PV 病史區分。
H&E 只能提示纖維化，分級必須以 reticulin 染色（MF-0 至 MF-3）及 trichrome 評估 collagen；grade 2–3 才符合 post-PV MF 骨髓條件。
突變連結：post-PV MF 帶 JAK2 突變；另檢測高風險附加突變（如 ASXL1、SRSF2、U2AF1、EZH2、IDH1/2）有助預後與移植決策。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 primary myelofibrosis 或 MDS with fibrosis 混淆；PMF 形態可完全相同，靠先前 PV 病史區分，MDS with fibrosis 則以小型、低分葉的發育異常巨核細胞與多系發育不良為主。

quiz.q: 圖中位於擴張竇狀血管腔內的巨核細胞代表什麼現象？要把 H&E 的纖維化印象量化，應加做哪一種染色？
quiz.a: Intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis（骨髓纖維化的特徵）；reticulin stain（加 trichrome 看 collagen）。

60093.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片印片（touch imprint）上成片的芽細胞，核質比高、核形不規則並有凹陷或裂溝、染色質細緻、細胞質淡藍含小空泡，幾乎看不到成熟造血細胞；芽細胞為主，符合 AML。
features: Sheets of blasts with virtually no maturing hematopoietic elements
High N:C ratio with irregular, notched or cleaved nuclear contours
Fine chromatin with occasional small nucleoli
Pale blue cytoplasm with small vacuoles; no definite Auer rods
Background of bubbly lipid/crush artifact typical of an imprint preparation
60093.describe_en: Touch imprint of the bone marrow core biopsy shows sheets of blasts with essentially no residual maturing hematopoietic cells. The blasts have a high N:C ratio, irregular nuclear contours with notches and occasional cleaves, fine chromatin, and pale blue vacuolated cytoplasm. No definite Auer rods are identified, and a bubbly background artifact is present from the imprint technique. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia, in this clinical setting therapy-related.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes have more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with delicate nuclear folds and are nonspecific esterase positive with CD14/CD64 expression.
Lymphoblasts may also have irregular nuclei; MPO negativity and lymphoid markers by flow cytometry separate them.
Tumor cells form cohesive clusters or rosettes and are CD45-negative, whereas these blasts are dyscohesive.

30973.recognize_zh: A 圖是慢性期 CML 樣抹片：各階段顆粒球（骨髓細胞、帶狀核、分葉核）加上深紫色粗顆粒的嗜鹼性球；B 圖則出現大量含粗大深紫嗜鹼性顆粒的未成熟細胞與淡藍細胞質的芽細胞（插圖），提示嗜鹼性芽細胞期。
features: Panel A: full spectrum of granulocytic maturation (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands, segmented neutrophils) with several basophils containing coarse dark granules
Panel B: numerous immature cells with round nuclei, fine to moderately condensed chromatin and coarse purple-black basophilic granules obscuring the nucleus
Panel B: blasts with high N:C ratio and deeply basophilic agranular or sparsely granular cytoplasm (inset)
Scattered extracellular metachromatic granules from degranulated basophils in panel B background
Red cells relatively normocytic with scattered platelets
30973.describe_en: Composite blood/marrow smears (Wright-Giemsa). Panel A shows marked granulocytic proliferation with a full maturation spectrum, including myelocytes and basophils, typical of chronic-phase chronic myeloid leukemia. Panel B shows numerous immature basophilic cells with coarse dark granules together with blasts having high N:C ratio and deeply basophilic cytoplasm (inset), with scattered free basophilic granules in the background. Findings are consistent with basophilic blast phase of CML; blast enumeration, flow cytometry (CD123, CD203c, CD25) and toluidine blue staining help confirm basophilic lineage.

ddx.vs: Basophils are mature with segmented nuclei and blasts remain below the blast-phase threshold (typically <20%).
Morphology is similar but there is no preceding CML history and no BCR-ABL1 fusion.
Mast cells have oval nuclei, abundant cytoplasm with evenly dispersed metachromatic granules, and express CD117 and tryptase strongly without basophil markers such as CD123/CD203c-high with 2D7.
APL promyelocytes have bilobed nuclei with coarse azurophilic (red-purple) granules and Auer rod bundles, and are strongly MPO positive with PML-RARA.

30589.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片呈淡粉紅、細胞稀少的壞死背景，其中散布金黃色至橘褐色、呈針狀或放射狀束狀的結晶沉積，就是血晶質（hematoidin），代表陳舊出血與壞死後的血紅素分解產物。
features: Golden-yellow to orange-brown refractile crystalline deposits with needle-like, radiating (sheaf/rhomboid) configurations
Deposits lie extracellularly within necrotic marrow
Background of pale eosinophilic granular necrotic debris with ghost cells and scattered pyknotic nuclear fragments
Bony trabecula (panel A) surrounded by necrotic marrow without viable hematopoiesis
No iron-laden macrophage clusters with coarse blue-black granules evident on H&E
30589.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy (H&E, low to high power) shows extensive marrow necrosis with pale eosinophilic granular debris, ghost cell outlines and scattered nuclear fragments surrounding a bony trabecula. Scattered extracellular golden-yellow crystalline deposits with needle-like, radiating configurations are present. These are consistent with hematoidin, an iron-free bilirubin-like pigment formed from hemoglobin breakdown in hypoxic, necrotic tissue. Viable tumor cells are not identified in these fields; in the context of marrow necrosis, additional sampling is warranted to exclude an underlying malignancy.

ddx.vs: Hemosiderin forms coarse granular golden-brown intracellular deposits in macrophages and stains with Prussian blue, whereas hematoidin is crystalline, extracellular and Prussian blue negative.
Formalin pigment is a fine dark brown birefringent granular deposit overlying blood-rich areas unrelated to necrosis and is removed by alcoholic picric acid.
Melanin is finely granular brown-black and Fontana-Masson positive, while bile pigment is green-brown and Hall stain positive, neither forming needle-shaped crystals.
Charcot-Leyden crystals are eosinophilic bipyramidal hexagonal crystals associated with eosinophils rather than golden-yellow radiating needles.

28477.recognize_zh: 周邊血白血球明顯增多，可見大量未成熟顆粒球（前骨髓細胞、骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞）與胞質顆粒減少、核分葉異常的發育不良嗜中性球，但嗜鹼性球不明顯，符合非典型慢性骨髓性白血病（aCML, BCR::ABL1 陰性）。
features: Marked leukocytosis with a left-shifted granulocytic series including promyelocytes, myelocytes and metamyelocytes
Dysgranulopoiesis: hypogranular neutrophils with pale cytoplasm and abnormal, hyposegmented or irregularly clumped nuclei
Larger immature myeloid cells with oval nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm; blasts not clearly increased in this field
No conspicuous basophilia or monocytosis
Scattered small dense nucleated cells (possible nucleated red cells or lymphocytes) and background red cell stacking
28477.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis composed of neutrophils and numerous circulating immature granulocytes, including promyelocytes, myelocytes and metamyelocytes. Many neutrophils are dysplastic, with hypogranular cytoplasm and abnormal nuclear segmentation and chromatin clumping; basophils and monocytes are not prominent and blasts are not obviously increased in this field. Findings are suggestive of atypical chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-negative (myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with neutrophilia), pending exclusion of BCR::ABL1 and evaluation for SETBP1/ASXL1 mutations.

ddx.vs: CML shows non-dysplastic granulocytes with basophilia and myelocyte/neutrophil peaks and is confirmed by BCR::ABL1.
CNL shows mature, non-dysplastic neutrophils with <10% immature granulocytes and typically CSF3R T618I.
CMML has absolute monocytosis ≥0.5 × 10^9/L and ≥10% monocytes, which is not a feature here.
Leukemoid reactions show toxic granulation with a normal-appearing, non-dysplastic left shift and resolve with the underlying cause.

exam.answer_en: Atypical CML, BCR::ABL1-negative (MDS/MPN with neutrophilia) — leukocytosis with left shift and dysplastic hypogranular neutrophils, no basophilia
pearls_zh: 考法：指著顆粒減少、核分葉異常的嗜中性球，問「這些發育不良代表什麼？」→ dysgranulopoiesis，是區分 aCML 與 CML、CNL 的關鍵。
WHO 5th 更名為 MDS/MPN with neutrophilia，ICC 2022 仍稱 aCML；兩者皆要求未成熟顆粒球 ≥10%、嗜鹼性球 <2%、單核球 <10%。
分子：常見 SETBP1、ASXL1、ETNK1 突變；CSF3R 突變較少見，必須排除 BCR::ABL1 與 PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1 重組。
預後不佳，適合者應考慮 allogeneic HSCT。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 BCR::ABL1 陽性 CML；CML 顆粒球無發育不良、有嗜鹼性球增多且具 myelocyte peak，靠發育不良、無 basophilia 及 BCR::ABL1 檢測區分。

quiz.q: 此血片左移且嗜中性球顆粒減少、分葉異常，但無嗜鹼性球增多；排除 BCR::ABL1 後最可能診斷為何？
quiz.a: Atypical CML（WHO 5th：MDS/MPN with neutrophilia）

24957.recognize_zh: 切片中瀰漫片狀的漿細胞（核偏心、車輪狀染色質、部分有核仁或雙核），細胞之間夾著長條狀、均質粉紅色的桿狀結晶，另有較小的針狀結晶位於細胞胞質內，符合伴隨結晶沉積的漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, clock-face chromatin and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm
Occasional binucleate plasma cells, visible nucleoli and a mitotic figure
Large extracellular elongated rectangular, homogeneous eosinophilic crystals lying between tumor cells
Smaller needle/spindle-shaped eosinophilic crystals within plasma cell cytoplasm (panel B)
Scattered small hexagonal eosinophilic structures and a few interspersed stromal cells
24957.describe_en: Biopsy section shows a diffuse sheet-like infiltrate of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse clock-face chromatin, occasional nucleoli, binucleate forms and mitoses. Large, elongated rod-shaped homogeneous eosinophilic crystals are present extracellularly between tumor cells, and smaller needle-like crystals are seen within the cytoplasm of some plasma cells. No crystal-laden histiocyte aggregates are evident on this image. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with extracellular and intracellular immunoglobulin crystal deposition; CD138 and kappa/lambda staining of the tumor and crystals, and evaluation of renal function for light chain crystalline nephropathy, are recommended.

ddx.vs: In CSH the crystals are packed within CD68+/CD163+ histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm rather than lying free between and within CD138+ plasma cells.
Charcot-Leyden crystals are slender bipyramidal crystals associated with eosinophils and are galectin-10 positive, not immunoglobulin light chain.
These have abundant fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm in histiocytes rather than discrete rigid rod-shaped crystals.

24573.recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液細胞離心抹片中聚集一群大型異常單核細胞，核呈折疊、腎形或分葉狀，染色質細緻、可見核仁，細胞質灰藍並帶細小嗜天青顆粒，呈現骨髓單核球性芽細胞的特徵，符合 AML（急性骨髓單核球性白血病）於 CSF 復發。
features: Cluster of large atypical mononuclear cells with moderate to high N:C ratio
Nuclei folded, indented, reniform or lobulated (monocytoid)
Fine, open chromatin with visible nucleoli
Moderate gray-blue cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules in several cells
No Auer rods identified; clean proteinaceous background without inflammatory cells
24573.describe_en: Cytocentrifuged cerebrospinal fluid shows a cellular specimen composed of a cluster of large atypical mononuclear cells. The cells have folded to lobulated monocytoid nuclei with fine chromatin and distinct nucleoli, and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules. Mature lymphocytes and neutrophils are not a notable component, and Auer rods are not identified. Findings are consistent with central nervous system involvement by acute myeloid leukemia with myelomonocytic/monocytic differentiation; flow cytometry of the fluid is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Reactive monocytes are fewer, have condensed chromatin without nucleoli and often vacuolated cytoplasm, rather than a cohesive population of immature cells with nucleoli.

ddx.dx: Traumatic tap with peripheral blood contamination
ddx.vs: Contamination brings red cells and a mixed PB leukocyte population, not a monomorphous population of blasts.

ddx.dx: CNS involvement by lymphoma or ALL
ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts or lymphoma cells lack azurophilic granules and monocytoid folded nuclei and show lymphoid immunophenotype by flow cytometry.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with larger size, vacuolated cytoplasm and molding, and are keratin-positive rather than myelomonocytic.

1981.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中成熟中的紅血球母細胞很少，卻可見少數大型、核大而染色質細緻、細胞質嗜鹼性的早期細胞（疑似巨大原紅血球），背景有細長的鐮刀型紅血球與纖維蛋白絲；鐮刀型貧血患者出現紅系造血中斷，指向微小病毒 B19 引起的再生不良危象。
features: Paucity of maturing erythroid precursors (polychromatic/orthochromatic normoblasts)
Occasional large immature cells with large oval nuclei, fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm, suggestive of giant pronormoblasts
Mixed background of lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells and granulocytes
Elongated pale sickle-shaped red cells in the background
Pink fibrin strands and smudged cells (hemodilute, partially clotted aspirate)
1981.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hemodilute with fibrin strands and smudged cells. There is a striking paucity of maturing normoblasts, while occasional large immature cells with large nuclei, fine chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm are present, compatible with early/giant pronormoblasts. The remaining cells include lymphocytes, plasma cells and granulocytes, and sickled red cells are seen in the background. Viral inclusions cannot be confirmed at this resolution. In a patient with sickle cell disease, findings are consistent with erythroid maturation arrest due to aplastic crisis, most likely parvovirus B19; confirmation by B19 PCR and reticulocytopenia is required.

ddx.vs: Leukemia shows sheets of blasts or proerythroblasts, whereas aplastic crisis has only scattered giant pronormoblasts and recovers within 1-2 weeks.

ddx.dx: Acquired pure red cell aplasia (thymoma, autoimmune)
ddx.vs: Chronic PRCA shows absent erythroid precursors without giant pronormoblasts and without evidence of acute B19 infection.

ddx.dx: Megaloblastic crisis (folate deficiency) in hemolytic anemia
ddx.vs: Folate deficiency shows abundant megaloblastic erythroid precursors and giant metamyelocytes rather than erythroid depletion.
Sequestration shows a brisk reticulocytosis with active marrow erythropoiesis, not erythroid aplasia.

19389.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中央有一顆淋巴球，核呈深色且表面有多道縱向摺痕與溝紋的腦迴狀（cerebriform）外觀、細胞質極少，這就是 Sézary 細胞，符合 Sézary 症候群。
features: Small-to-medium lymphoid cell slightly larger than a red cell, with very high N:C ratio
Nucleus with multiple deep grooves and folds giving a cerebriform (convoluted) appearance
Dense, hyperchromatic chromatin without visible nucleoli
Scant, barely perceptible rim of cytoplasm without granules
Second small lymphocyte with condensed chromatin at the lower edge; background red cells and platelets largely unremarkable
19389.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating lymphoid cells, including a small-to-medium cell with a hyperchromatic nucleus bearing multiple deep grooves and folds, imparting a cerebriform contour, with scant agranular cytoplasm and no visible nucleoli. A second small lymphocyte is present at the field edge, and red cells and platelets show no significant abnormality. Findings are consistent with a Sézary cell and are suggestive of Sézary syndrome in the appropriate clinical setting of erythroderma; confirmation requires flow cytometry showing an expanded CD4-positive population with loss of CD7 and/or CD26 (absolute Sézary count at least 1000/µL) and a clonal TCR gene rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Occasional reactive or benign lymphocytes can show a single cleft, but a large circulating population of CD4+CD7−/CD26− cells with a clonal TCR is absent.
ATLL cells have polylobated flower-shaped nuclei rather than cerebriform grooves, are CD25-positive, and are associated with HTLV-1.
T-PLL cells usually have a visible nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs with marked lymphocytosis and TCL1A rearrangement, rather than cerebriform nuclei with erythroderma.

ddx.dx: Leukemic follicular lymphoma or mantle cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These B-cell neoplasms may show cleaved nuclei but express CD19/CD20 with light chain restriction rather than a CD4+ T-cell phenotype.

exam.answer_en: Sézary syndrome — circulating Sézary cell with hyperchromatic cerebriform (deeply grooved) nucleus and scant cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指核有多道摺痕的淋巴球，問「這是什麼細胞、如何確診」；答案 Sézary cell，確診需 flow 與 TCR 克隆性，不能只靠形態。
ISCL/EORTC 血液標準：Sézary count ≥1000/µL，或 CD4/CD8 ≥10、CD4+CD7− ≥40%、CD4+CD26− ≥30% 等，並有血中 clonal TCR 重排；臨床三聯：紅皮症、淋巴結腫大、血中腫瘤細胞。
表型：成熟 CD4+ T 細胞，常失去 CD7、CD26，CD2/CD3/CD5 可部分丟失；KIR3DL2（CD158k）常陽性。CCR4 高表現，mogamulizumab 為標靶治療之一。
與 mycosis fungoides 同屬皮膚 T 細胞淋巴瘤譜系，但 Sézary syndrome 為白血病型，預後較差。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 ATLL 的 flower cells 混淆：ATLL 核呈花瓣狀多葉、CD25 強陽性且 HTLV-1 陽性、常有高血鈣；反應性淋巴球也可有少量核摺痕，數量少且無克隆性。

quiz.q: 圖中央核呈腦迴狀、深溝紋的淋巴球叫什麼？flow cytometry 上最典型丟失的兩個 T 細胞標記為何？
quiz.a: Sézary cell；CD7 與 CD26。

17853.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量母細胞，細胞質灰藍且常有空泡；視野下方一顆大型組織球細胞質泡沫狀、內含被吞噬的細胞核與碎片，左上母細胞旁亦見紅血球貼附/吞入，顯示在急性骨髓性白血病背景下出現噬血現象（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Sheets of medium-to-large blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and occasional nucleoli
Blast cytoplasm grey-blue, several with prominent clear vacuoles
Large histiocyte at lower center with foamy vacuolated cytoplasm containing ingested nuclear material/cells
Some cells show engulfed or closely apposed erythrocytes, suggesting phagocytosis
Background erythrocytes with mild anisopoikilocytosis
17853.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular field dominated by medium-to-large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin and grey-blue cytoplasm, many containing clear vacuoles. A large histiocyte at the lower center has abundant foamy vacuolated cytoplasm containing phagocytosed nuclear material, and several cells appear to engulf erythrocytes. Definitive lineage assignment and any specific genetic subtype cannot be determined from this image alone. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia accompanied by hemophagocytosis, compatible with a leukemia-associated hemophagocytic syndrome in the appropriate clinical setting.

ddx.vs: In t(8;16) AML the erythrophagocytosis is typically performed by the monocytic blasts themselves, which are often granulated; confirmation requires cytogenetics.
Secondary HLH from infection shows benign-appearing histiocytes phagocytosing blood cells without an excess of blasts.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with sharply punched-out vacuoles and a starry-sky macrophage pattern, and are mature B-cell by flow (CD19+, sIg+, MYC rearranged).
Monoblasts have abundant, often vacuolated cytoplasm and may phagocytose, but are nonspecific esterase-positive and CD64/CD14-positive, which is needed to separate them from other AML.

15165.recognize_zh: 多格組圖呈現 POEMS 症候群的臨床面向：腹部 CT 腹水與器官腫大、胸部 X 光橫膈抬高且肺功能隨治療改善、PET/CT 骨頭硬化性病灶、足部紅紫色變化、軀幹多發血管瘤（箭頭）以及外觀多血、腹部膨大，而非單一細胞形態學。
features: A: axial abdominal CT with ascites and enlarged abdominal organs
B-C: chest radiographs with reduced lung volumes and elevated hemidiaphragms (2002) improving by 2005, paralleled by improved TLC, PImax, FEV1 and DLCO
D-E: FDG-PET/CT and CT showing a focal osseous lesion in the right shoulder girdle region, consistent with a sclerotic plasmacytoma
F: violaceous discoloration of the feet and toes (acrocyanosis)
G-H: multiple small red-purple papules on the trunk (arrows) consistent with hemangiomas, followed over time
I: plethora, skin hyperpigmentation and abdominal distension; non-morphologic clinical/radiologic composite
15165.describe_en: Composite clinical and radiologic figure illustrating POEMS syndrome rather than a cytologic specimen. Abdominal CT (A) shows ascites with organomegaly, and serial chest radiographs (B, C) show restrictive physiology with elevated hemidiaphragms and low lung volumes that improve over time, as documented by the accompanying pulmonary function values. PET/CT and CT (D, E) demonstrate a focal FDG-avid bone lesion in the shoulder girdle consistent with a sclerotic bone lesion/plasmacytoma. Clinical photographs show acrocyanosis of the feet (F), multiple truncal hemangiomas (G, H, arrows), and plethora, hyperpigmentation and abdominal distension (I). Together these features illustrate the extravascular volume overload, sclerotic bone lesions and skin changes characteristic of POEMS syndrome, which requires polyneuropathy and a monoclonal (usually lambda) plasma cell disorder for diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Myeloma causes lytic lesions, anemia, hypercalcemia and renal failure with heavy marrow plasmacytosis, whereas POEMS has sclerotic lesions, low marrow plasma cell burden, polyneuropathy and high VEGF.
AL amyloidosis causes neuropathy and organomegaly but lacks sclerotic bone lesions, hemangiomas and polycythemia, and tissue biopsy is Congo red-positive.
Castleman disease shares effusions and lymphadenopathy and can coexist with POEMS, but without polyneuropathy and a clonal plasma cell disorder it does not meet POEMS criteria.

captions: A: CT abdomen with ascites and organomegaly; B-C: chest radiographs with improving pulmonary function; D-E: PET/CT and CT of sclerotic bone lesion; F: acrocyanosis of feet; G-H: truncal hemangiomas (arrows); I: plethora, hyperpigmentation and abdominal distension

13501.recognize_zh: 低中倍 H&E 下骨小樑明顯增厚、形狀不規則且互相連接，占據大部分切面（骨硬化），骨小樑間的空間則被含紡錘狀細胞的纖維組織與擴張血管取代，幾乎看不到正常造血，符合原發性骨髓纖維化纖維化期伴骨硬化。
features: Markedly thickened, irregular and anastomosing bony trabeculae occupying much of the section (osteosclerosis)
Trabeculae with haphazard lamellae and new bone formation around vascular canals
Intertrabecular spaces filled by loose fibrous stroma with spindle cell nuclei in a streaming pattern
Scattered dilated sinusoids and small vessels with red cells; small fat vacuoles
Marked depletion of normal hematopoietic cells
13501.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow trephine section shows marked osteosclerosis, with thickened, irregular and anastomosing bony trabeculae showing new bone formation. The intertrabecular spaces are replaced by fibrous stroma with streaming spindle-shaped nuclei and scattered dilated sinusoids, with near-complete loss of normal hematopoiesis. Findings are consistent with the fibrotic stage of primary myelofibrosis with osteosclerosis (MF-3); reticulin and trichrome stains, assessment of residual megakaryocytes and JAK2, CALR or MPL mutation testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: Hyperparathyroidism shows osteoclastic tunneling resorption with peritrabecular fibrosis, whereas this field shows new bone apposition with diffuse intertrabecular fibrosis.
Sclerotic metastases contain cohesive carcinoma cells within the stroma that are keratin positive.
Paget disease shows mosaic cement lines with prominent osteoclasts and osteoblasts, typically without marrow-wide hematopoietic failure.
Mastocytosis may cause osteosclerosis but shows spindle mast cell aggregates positive for tryptase and CD25.

exam.answer_en: Primary myelofibrosis, fibrotic stage with osteosclerosis — thickened anastomosing trabeculae and fibrous stroma replacing hematopoiesis
pearls_zh: 考法：H&E 低倍問「骨小樑有什麼變化」→ 增厚、不規則、互相連接的骨硬化（osteosclerosis）；造血組織幾乎被纖維取代。
骨硬化屬於 WHO/EUMNET osteosclerosis grading 的一部分，通常伴隨 MF-3 纖維化；影像學可見骨密度增加。
臨床：全血球減少、巨脾、髓外造血（肝、脾，偶見胸腔或脊椎旁）；抽吸 dry tap 時應以 core biopsy 加上 touch imprint 評估 blasts。
加速或轉化：周邊血或骨髓 blasts 10–19% 屬 accelerated phase，≥ 20% 為 blast phase，預後極差；治療後切片需同時評估 blasts 與纖維化。
exam.pitfall_zh: 骨硬化與纖維化易被當成 Paget disease 或腎性骨病變；Paget 以骨重塑為主（mosaic cement lines）、骨髓造血仍在，PMF 則有異型巨核細胞與 driver mutation。

quiz.q: 這張 H&E 中骨小樑增厚且互相連接的變化稱為什麼？骨髓抽吸常見什麼結果？
quiz.a: Osteosclerosis（骨硬化）；dry tap

3517.recognize_zh: 中央一顆大小正常、未脹大的紅血球邊緣貼著一個細小環狀體，含兩到三個染色質點，屬位於紅血球邊緣的環狀滋養體（accolé form），提示瘧疾，尤其是惡性瘧（P. falciparum）。
features: Normal-sized red cell containing a small delicate ring-form trophozoite at the cell margin (accolé or appliqué position)
Ring with more than one chromatin dot
Infected red cell not enlarged and without Schüffner dots
A second red cell (top) with a small irregular dark chromatin body, possibly an additional early parasite
Adjacent free platelet for comparison; background red cells with fine refractile dots of uncertain significance (likely stain precipitate)
3517.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic red cells, one of which contains a small ring-form trophozoite positioned at the red cell margin with multiple chromatin dots. The infected cell is not enlarged and shows no Schüffner stippling; a second red cell contains a small dark chromatin body that may represent another early ring. Mature trophozoites, schizonts and gametocytes are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium infection and suggestive of P. falciparum; thick and thin smears with parasitemia quantification and species confirmation (antigen test or PCR) are recommended.

ddx.vs: Infected red cells are enlarged with Schüffner dots and show larger amoeboid trophozoites and schizonts, unlike the small marginal ring in an unenlarged cell.
Babesia forms pleomorphic rings, sometimes extracellular or in tetrads (Maltese cross), without pigment or gametocytes, and typically lacks the accolé position.
