An overlying platelet shows granular texture and a surrounding halo rather than a blue ring of cytoplasm with discrete red chromatin dots.
Howell-Jolly bodies are single dense round dots and Pappenheimer bodies are small peripheral granule clusters, neither with a ring of cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Malaria, suggestive of Plasmodium falciparum — small marginal (accolé) ring trophozoite with multiple chromatin dots in a non-enlarged red cell
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指貼在紅血球邊緣的小環狀體，問種別；支持 P. falciparum 的線索：受感染紅血球不脹大、無 Schüffner stippling、accolé form、雙染色質點、單一紅血球多重感染、香蕉形 gametocyte。
周邊血通常只見 ring 與 gametocyte；若見大量成熟 trophozoite 或 schizont 反而少見於 falciparum（成熟期黏附於微血管內皮），出現時提示重症。
檢查：thick smear 偵測敏感度高，thin smear 用於辨種與計算 parasitemia；HRP2 快篩在 pfhrp2/3 基因缺失株可能偽陰性。
臨床：falciparum 可快速惡化為 severe malaria（意識改變、嚴重貧血、低血糖、腎衰竭、高 parasitemia），重症首選 IV artesunate；台灣病例多為境外移入，屬法定傳染病需通報。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Babesia（亦為小環狀、紅血球不脹大）：Babesia 無瘧色素、無 schizont 與 gametocyte，可見四聯體 Maltese cross；也要排除血小板疊在紅血球上（無環狀細胞質與染色質點）。

quiz.q: 圖中紅血球邊緣的小環狀寄生蟲型態稱為什麼？最符合哪一種瘧原蟲？
quiz.a: Accolé（appliqué）ring form；Plasmodium falciparum

3965.recognize_zh: 這是白血球鹼性磷酸酶（LAP）細胞化學染色的周邊血抹片：兩顆分節嗜中性球核被對比染成紅色，細胞質只有淡淡的瀰漫藍色、看不到粗大的陽性沉澱顆粒，屬低分級（約 0–1+）；計分時要數 100 顆中性球逐一分級加總。
features: Peripheral blood smear processed for leukocyte alkaline phosphatase cytochemistry with red nuclear counterstain
Two segmented neutrophils with red-stained lobulated nuclei
Neutrophil cytoplasm shows only faint diffuse bluish staining without coarse discrete precipitate granules, corresponding to a low reaction grade (about 0 to 1+)
Unstained, pale yellow-tan red cells in the background
Exact grading is limited by image resolution; the score requires assessment of 100 consecutive neutrophils
3965.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear stained for leukocyte alkaline phosphatase shows two segmented neutrophils with red-counterstained nuclei. The cytoplasm of both cells shows only faint diffuse staining without coarse precipitate granules, corresponding to a low reaction grade of approximately 0 to 1+. The LAP score is obtained by grading 100 consecutive neutrophils from 0 to 4+ and summing the grades (reference range roughly 20 to 100, laboratory dependent). A predominance of cells like these would give a low score, as seen in chronic myeloid leukemia or PNH, whereas a leukemoid reaction or polycythemia vera gives a high score.

ddx.vs: CML neutrophils are predominantly 0 to 1+ giving a low total score, which should be confirmed by BCR::ABL1 testing because the LAP score is now largely supplementary.

ddx.dx: Leukemoid reaction or infection (high LAP score)
ddx.vs: Reactive neutrophilia shows many neutrophils with dense 3+ to 4+ granular precipitate filling the cytoplasm and a high total score.
PNH also gives a low LAP score but is distinguished by hemolysis and loss of GPI-anchored proteins (CD55/CD59, FLAER) on flow cytometry.
PV typically shows an elevated LAP score together with erythrocytosis and a JAK2 mutation.

3965.stain: LAP cytochemistry, nuclear fast red counterstain

exam.answer_en: Leukocyte alkaline phosphatase stain — segmented neutrophils with faint diffuse cytoplasmic reaction only (grade ~0–1+), i.e. a low-scoring pattern
pearls_zh: 考法：給 LAP 染色圖問「這顆中性球評幾分、整體分數高或低代表什麼」；核被 nuclear fast red 對比染紅，不算陽性，要看胞質沉澱顆粒的多寡與粗細。
低 LAP score：CML（慢性期）、PNH、hypophosphatasia；高 LAP score：leukemoid reaction/感染、polycythemia vera、懷孕、類固醇使用。
技術要點：酵素不穩定，需用新鮮血抹片（通常採血後短時間內製片），延遲或抗凝劑不當會造成假性偏低；每家實驗室需自訂參考區間並附正常對照。
現況：CML 診斷已由 BCR::ABL1（FISH/RT-PCR）取代 LAP score，但仍是經典考題，常與 leukemoid reaction 對照出題。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常把紅色的核對比染色誤當成陽性反應而高估分數；分級只看胞質中酵素沉澱顆粒，此圖僅淡淡瀰漫染色、無粗顆粒，應評為 0–1+。

quiz.q: 若 100 顆中性球多數如圖所示，LAP score 會偏高或偏低？可見於哪兩種疾病？
quiz.a: 偏低；CML（慢性期）與 PNH

1405.recognize_zh: 這是一張 G 帶染色體核型圖而非形態學影像；可見第 19 號染色體似有四條、第 22 號似有三條，屬於高二倍體異常，數目變化（如 +19、+21、+22）常見於急性巨核母細胞白血病。
features: G-banded karyogram arranged by chromosome pairs 1-22 plus sex chromosomes
Chromosome 19 group appears to contain four homologs (apparent tetrasomy 19)
Chromosome 22 group appears to contain three homologs (apparent trisomy 22)
Sex chromosomes appear to be one X and one small Y-like chromosome
Low image resolution precludes band-level assessment of structural rearrangements
1405.describe_en: This figure is a G-banded karyogram rather than a morphologic image. It appears to show a hyperdiploid clone with extra copies of chromosome 19 (four homologs) and chromosome 22 (three homologs), with XY sex chromosomes; the low resolution does not permit reliable identification of subtle structural abnormalities. Numerical gains such as +19, +21 and +22 are recurrent in acute megakaryoblastic leukemia, and the karyotype should be interpreted together with morphology, immunophenotype (CD41/CD61) and molecular studies.

1277.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中多顆中型淋巴球，核圓或卵圓、偶有凹陷，染色質中度凝集，胞質少量但明顯深藍，部分細胞邊緣有小泡狀突起；這群大小一致、胞質嗜鹼性的成熟樣淋巴球增多，是 T-PLL 在高倍下的典型樣貌。
features: Increased medium-sized lymphoid cells, somewhat larger than a small mature lymphocyte
Round to oval nuclei, occasionally indented, with moderately condensed chromatin
Small nucleoli visible in some cells
Scant to moderate intensely basophilic agranular cytoplasm, with small cytoplasmic blebs in a few cells
No smudge cells in this field; red cells unremarkable
1277.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an increased population of medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval, occasionally indented nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, small nucleoli in a subset, and scant to moderate intensely basophilic agranular cytoplasm, some with small cytoplasmic blebs. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable in this field. The cells have a mature chromatin pattern rather than blastic features. Findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia, pending flow cytometry (CD2, CD3, CD5, CD7 positive; TdT and CD1a negative) and demonstration of TCL1A or MTCP1 rearrangement.

ddx.dx: B-cell prolymphocytic leukemia / splenic lymphoma with prominent nucleoli
ddx.vs: B-prolymphocytes typically have a single large prominent nucleolus and paler cytoplasm, and are B-cell marker positive.
Lymphoblasts have finely dispersed blastic chromatin and TdT/CD1a expression, whereas these cells show condensed chromatin and a mature phenotype.
CLL cells are smaller with coarsely clumped chromatin and pale scant cytoplasm, with a CD5+/CD23+ B-cell phenotype.

exam.answer_en: T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia — uniform medium-sized lymphocytes with intensely basophilic agranular cytoplasm and cytoplasmic blebs
pearls_zh: 考法：考官要你描述形態重點：大小一致、胞質少但深藍、邊緣有 blebs、核仁小；並問與 CLL 的差別（CLL 核染色質塊狀如足球、胞質淡、常有 smudge cells）。
T-PLL 有 small-cell variant（核仁不明顯）與 cerebriform variant，形態可與 CLL 或 Sézary 重疊，因此必須以 flow 確認 T 細胞表型。
Flow 關鍵：CD2+、sCD3+、CD5+、CD7 強陽性，TdT−、CD1a−；腫瘤細胞高表現 CD52，是 alemtuzumab 治療的標靶。
T-PLL International Study Group 診斷主要條件包括外周血 T-PLL 表型細胞 >5×10^9/L、T 細胞單株性，以及 TCL1A/MTCP1 重排或 TCL1 表現。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 B-PLL 或 CLL：兩者為 B 細胞（CD19、CD20+），CLL 另有 CD5+CD23+、胞質淡；T-PLL 胞質深藍有 blebs 且為 CD3+ T 細胞，必須靠 flow 區分。

quiz.q: T-PLL 腫瘤細胞高度表現哪個抗原，成為第一線單株抗體治療的標靶？
quiz.a: CD52（alemtuzumab）

1213.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中淋巴球數量明顯增加，多為小到中型、核圓、細胞質少到中等，部分細胞質偏淡藍且較多；提示成熟 B 細胞淋巴增生，但此倍率看不清絨毛狀突起，需高倍與流式細胞儀才能判定為脾邊緣區淋巴瘤。
features: Increased numbers of lymphoid cells for a low-power field
Small to medium-sized lymphocytes with round nuclei and condensed chromatin
Scant to moderate pale blue cytoplasm; villous projections not resolvable at this magnification
Occasional neutrophil; no smudge cells or blasts evident
Normocytic red cells with scattered platelets
1213.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low magnification shows an increased number of lymphoid cells relative to other leukocytes. The lymphocytes are small to medium-sized with round nuclei, condensed chromatin and scant to moderate pale blue cytoplasm; cytoplasmic villi cannot be assessed at this magnification. Occasional neutrophils are present, and smudge cells and blasts are not evident. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable. The findings indicate a lymphocytosis of mature-appearing cells, compatible with splenic marginal zone lymphoma in leukemic phase when supported by high-power morphology (villous lymphocytes) and immunophenotyping.

ddx.vs: CLL shows uniform small lymphocytes with coarse chromatin and numerous smudge cells, and is CD5+/CD23+.
HCL typically presents with pancytopenia and monocytopenia rather than lymphocytosis, and cells have abundant hairy cytoplasm and are CD103+/CD25+.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma in leukemic phase
ddx.vs: MCL cells often have irregular nuclear contours and are CD5+ with cyclin D1 expression and t(11;14).
Reactive lymphocytosis is polymorphous with larger reactive cells showing basophilic cytoplasm hugging red cells, and is polyclonal on flow cytometry.

1085.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中可見多顆細胞質豐富、嗜酸性、核為單一圓形且較小的大細胞，符合CML常見的小型低分葉巨核細胞（dwarf megakaryocytes），周圍為流線狀的梭形細胞基質；單憑此圖無法確立CML，需搭配BCR-ABL1。
features: Clusters of large cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and a single round, hypolobated nucleus
Nuclei with vesicular chromatin and a small visible nucleolus, favoring small hypolobated megakaryocytes
Streaming, dark spindle-shaped nuclei between the large cells suggesting fibrosis and/or crush
Adjacent hemorrhagic area with scattered hematopoietic cells
Granulocytic hyperplasia is not well assessable in this field
1085.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy section shows a fragment containing clustered large cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and single, round, hypolobated nuclei, in keeping with small hypolobated megakaryocytes. The intervening stroma contains streaming, hyperchromatic spindle nuclei suggestive of fibrosis with some crush artifact, and an adjacent area is hemorrhagic. Overall marrow cellularity and myeloid maturation cannot be assessed in this field. In the appropriate context, the megakaryocytic morphology is compatible with chronic myeloid leukemia; confirmation of BCR-ABL1 is required.

ddx.vs: PMF megakaryocytes are atypical with cloud-like, hyperchromatic, bulbous nuclei and form dense clusters, rather than small monolobated forms; BCR-ABL1 is negative.
MDS micromegakaryocytes are usually smaller with dysplasia in other lineages and a hypocellular-to-normocellular marrow without the granulocytic hyperplasia of CML.
Metastatic cells form cohesive sheets with pleomorphic nuclei and are keratin- or melanocytic marker-positive, whereas megakaryocytes express CD61/CD42b.

1149.recognize_zh: 淋巴結壞死區的免疫組織化學染色，散在許多細胞核呈深棕色強陽性、部分核形拉長或變形，代表病毒感染細胞，符合單純疱疹病毒（HSV）淋巴結炎。
features: Strong brown nuclear (and some cytoplasmic) staining in numerous scattered cells
Positive nuclei are enlarged, rounded to elongated and irregular
Positive cells concentrated in a pale, necrotic-appearing zone
Faint diffuse brown background staining within necrotic debris
Adjacent viable area with small negative hematoxylin-stained lymphocytes
1149.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain on a lymph node section shows a necrotic zone containing numerous scattered cells with strong nuclear, and focally cytoplasmic, brown positivity, many with enlarged and irregular nuclei. There is faint granular staining of the necrotic background, and small unstained lymphocytes are present at the periphery. The antibody is not labeled on the image, but in context the pattern represents viral antigen in infected cells. Findings are consistent with herpes simplex virus lymphadenitis.

ddx.vs: CMV-infected cells are markedly enlarged with single owl-eye intranuclear and granular cytoplasmic inclusions and stain with CMV rather than HSV antibodies.
Kikuchi shows karyorrhectic necrosis with crescentic histiocytes and plasmacytoid dendritic cells, lacks neutrophils, and is negative for viral antigen.
VZV produces identical Cowdry A inclusions and multinucleation, so separation requires virus-specific IHC or PCR.

1021.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一群大型、細胞質豐富且核仁明顯的非造血細胞，細胞內外有大量黑綠色粗大色素顆粒（melanin），符合轉移性黑色素瘤侵犯骨髓。
features: Cluster of large, loosely cohesive non-hematopoietic cells with abundant pale to basophilic cytoplasm
Large round to oval nuclei with open chromatin and visible nucleoli
Coarse black to greenish-black cytoplasmic pigment granules (melanin), with some pigment extracellular
Some tumor cells with vacuolated cytoplasm
Adjacent blood background with scattered normal hematopoietic cells
1021.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of large, loosely cohesive atypical cells with abundant cytoplasm, large nuclei, and prominent nucleoli. Many of these cells contain coarse black to greenish-black cytoplasmic pigment, and pigment is also present extracellularly. Normal hematopoietic cells are seen in the adjacent blood background. Findings are consistent with metastatic malignant melanoma involving the bone marrow; immunohistochemistry (SOX10, S100, HMB-45, Melan-A) on the core biopsy is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Macrophages contain blue-green to golden granular hemosiderin that is Prussian blue positive and have small bland nuclei rather than large nucleolated nuclei.
Carcinoma clusters are more tightly cohesive, lack melanin, and are keratin positive/SOX10 negative.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma or myeloma
ddx.vs: Hematolymphoid malignancies lack pigment and express CD30/ALK or CD138, not melanocytic markers.

4157.recognize_zh: 淋巴結中瀰漫的單形性小到中型淋巴球全部不著色，只有零星散在的細胞呈棕色膜狀或樹突狀染色；陰性的腫瘤細胞與散在陽性的背景細胞形成對比，標記未標示，需配合 CD20、CD5、cyclin D1 判讀套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of monotonous small-to-medium lymphoid cells that are negative
Scattered individual positive cells with membranous to dendritic brown staining
No zonal or follicular distribution of the positive cells in this field
Neoplastic nuclei slightly irregular with scant cytoplasm (hematoxylin counterstain)
Positive cells account for a minor subset (<10%)
4157.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (DAB; marker not specified) on a lymph node involved by a diffuse monotonous small-to-medium lymphoid proliferation shows that the neoplastic cells are negative. Scattered individual background cells show membranous to dendritic positivity without a zonal pattern. This pattern is most compatible with a marker of the non-neoplastic compartment (for example reactive T cells or histiocytes) in mantle cell lymphoma. Diagnostic confirmation rests on CD20, CD5 and cyclin D1/SOX11 staining.

ddx.vs: SLL shows proliferation centers with larger prolymphocytes/paraimmunoblasts and is CD23+, cyclin D1-negative.
MZL cells have more cytoplasm (monocytoid) and are CD5-negative and cyclin D1-negative.
FL is CD10+/BCL6+ with centrocytes and centroblasts and lacks cyclin D1.

3837.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中巨核細胞數量增加，除正常分葉者外，可見數個核濃縮、深染成團且細胞質嗜酸性的巨核細胞（mummified megakaryocytes），符合免疫性血小板減少症的巨核細胞變化。
features: Increased megakaryocytes of variable size scattered in a cellular marrow
Several megakaryocytes with condensed, hyperchromatic, smudged 'mummified' nuclei (left and upper right)
Other megakaryocytes with normal lobulated nuclei and abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Megakaryocytes dispersed singly without tight clusters
Background trilineage hematopoiesis with erythroid and myeloid precursors
3837.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a cellular marrow with increased megakaryocytes of variable size. Several megakaryocytes have condensed, hyperchromatic, pyknotic-appearing nuclei with eosinophilic cytoplasm ('mummified' forms), while others show normal lobulated nuclei. Megakaryocytes are dispersed without tight clustering or marked atypia, and erythroid and granulocytic lineages are present. In the appropriate clinical setting of thrombocytopenia, findings are consistent with peripheral platelet destruction such as immune thrombocytopenia.

ddx.vs: MDS shows micromegakaryocytes and megakaryocytes with separated nuclear lobes, usually with dysplasia in other lineages and cytogenetic abnormalities.
PMF megakaryocytes are atypical with cloud-like hyperchromatic nuclei in tight clusters, accompanied by reticulin fibrosis and JAK2/CALR/MPL mutations.

ddx.dx: Apoptotic megakaryocytes after chemotherapy or toxic injury
ddx.vs: Toxic injury usually shows a hypocellular marrow with decreased megakaryocytes, rather than increased megakaryocytes with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis.
Metastatic cells form cohesive clusters with keratin positivity, whereas mummified megakaryocytes are single and CD61/CD42b positive.

3773.recognize_zh: 高倍下散在的大型細胞核大、空泡狀染色質、核仁明顯，周圍是小淋巴球與細胞質淡粉紅的上皮樣組織球，大細胞零散不成片，是 T 細胞／組織球豐富型大 B 細胞淋巴瘤的典型組成。
features: Scattered large atypical cells with vesicular, oval to irregular nuclei and prominent central nucleoli
Large cells have moderate pale cytoplasm and occur singly without forming sheets
Abundant background of epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic, ill-defined cytoplasm
Numerous small mature lymphocytes with dark round nuclei
Occasional apoptotic bodies/pyknotic cells; eosinophils not conspicuous
3773.describe_en: High-power view of a lymph node section shows scattered large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, dispersed singly within an abundant background of epithelioid histiocytes and small lymphocytes. The large cells do not form clusters or sheets, and eosinophils and plasma cells are not prominent. Occasional apoptotic bodies are present. Findings are consistent with T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma; confirmation requires CD20/PAX5 positivity in the large cells with CD30/CD15 negativity and a CD3+ T-cell background lacking small B cells.

ddx.vs: NLPHL LP cells lie within nodules of small B cells with FDC meshworks, whereas THRLBCL background contains few small B cells.
Mixed cellularity CHL has CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells with eosinophils and plasma cells in the background.
Reactive granulomas have epithelioid histiocytes without large atypical cells bearing prominent nucleoli.

exam.answer_en: T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma (high power) — isolated large cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli among epithelioid histiocytes and small lymphocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍題會要你區分大型腫瘤細胞與上皮樣組織球：前者核大、空泡狀、核仁明顯，後者核淡、細胞質粉紅、邊界不清。
與 nodular lymphocyte-predominant 病變的鑑別是必考：NLPHL（ICC 2022 改稱 nodular lymphocyte predominant B-cell lymphoma）有 CD21/CD23 FDC meshwork 與小 B 細胞結節，THRLBCL 沒有。
NLPHL 可出現 THRLBCL-like 型態（Fan pattern F）；若同一病人先有 NLPHL，瀰漫區域需小心判讀，這兩者在生物學上有重疊。
背景 T 細胞以 CD8+ 細胞毒性 T 細胞為主並富含組織球；此組成與較高 PD-L1 表現相關，但治療仍以 R-CHOP 為標準。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 granulomatous lymphadenitis；肉芽腫性淋巴結炎只有上皮樣組織球與小淋巴球，沒有散在帶明顯核仁的大型異型細胞，需以 CD20 確認。

quiz.q: 要區分本病與 NLPHL，應做哪類 IHC 看背景結構？
quiz.a: CD21/CD23（FDC meshwork）及 CD20 看小 B 細胞結節

3581.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫組織化學染色中，脂肪為主的骨髓內有一團緻密、棕色陽性的紡錘形細胞聚集，另有散在沿脂肪細胞邊緣的陽性細胞；緻密的紡錘形肥大細胞聚集（≥15 顆）即為系統性肥大細胞症的主要診斷準則。
features: Compact interstitial aggregate of strongly positive (brown) spindle-shaped cells
Additional smaller positive clusters and single cells lining adipocytes
Background of predominantly fatty marrow with residual negative hematopoietic cells
Positive cells show granular cytoplasmic staining pattern
Antigen not labeled; pattern fits a mast cell marker such as tryptase or CD117
3581.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a largely fatty marrow with a compact interstitial aggregate of strongly staining, spindle-shaped cells, accompanied by smaller clusters and scattered positive cells along adipocyte borders. Surrounding hematopoietic cells are negative. The antigen is not labeled, but the pattern is typical of a mast cell marker such as tryptase or CD117. Findings are consistent with multifocal dense mast cell infiltrates of systemic mastocytosis; CD25/CD2 and KIT D816V testing and serum tryptase support the diagnosis and classification.

ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are scattered, round, and interstitial without compact aggregates of 15 or more spindle cells and are CD25-negative.

ddx.dx: Myeloid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRA rearrangement
ddx.vs: May show spindle mast cells but with marked eosinophilia and FIP1L1::PDGFRA, typically lacking KIT D816V.
Fibroblasts and histiocytes are tryptase-negative, with histiocytes CD68/CD163-positive.

exam.answer_en: Systemic mastocytosis, bone marrow IHC — multifocal dense aggregates of spindle-shaped mast cells (tryptase/CD117-positive)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指棕色緻密的紡錘形細胞團，問這代表哪條診斷準則；答 WHO 主要準則：骨髓或皮膚外器官中 ≥15 顆肥大細胞的多灶緻密聚集。
WHO 5th 次要準則：>25% 肥大細胞為紡錘形/異型、KIT D816 突變、表現 CD25/CD2/CD30、serum tryptase >20 ng/mL（伴骨髓性腫瘤時不適用）。
Tryptase 與 CD117 用來找出肥大細胞，CD25 則證明其異常；成人 SM 大多數帶 KIT D816V，建議用高敏感度 PCR 檢測。
Indolent SM 無 C-findings 且 B-findings <2；治療以症狀控制為主，症狀嚴重者可考慮 avapritinib。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把散在的單顆陽性肥大細胞（反應性增生）當成 SM；診斷要看到緻密聚集或異常 CD25 表現，單純散在分布、圓形的 tryptase+ 細胞不足以診斷。

quiz.q: 這種緻密紡錘形 tryptase/CD117 陽性細胞聚集，在 WHO 準則中需每團至少多少顆肥大細胞才符合主要準則？
quiz.a: ≥15 顆肥大細胞的多灶緻密聚集。

3645.recognize_zh: 低倍下整個骨髓顆粒被密密麻麻的造血細胞塞滿，只剩少數小脂肪空泡，其間散布多顆較大的巨核細胞，細胞量明顯超過一般顆粒中約一半脂肪的比例，屬於高細胞性骨髓抹片。
features: Low-power view of a large marrow particle densely packed with hematopoietic cells
Sparse, small fat vacuoles occupying only a minor fraction of the particle
Scattered megakaryocytes visible as larger dark cells within the particle
Thick cellular trails extending from the particle
Individual cell lineage and maturation cannot be assessed at this magnification
3645.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large, densely cellular particle and thick cellular trails with markedly reduced fat. Megakaryocytes are readily identified within the particle. Individual lineage composition and maturation cannot be evaluated at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a hypercellular bone marrow aspirate; cellularity should be confirmed on the trephine biopsy and correlated with age, and higher-power examination is needed to determine the cause (reactive hyperplasia, myeloproliferative neoplasm or leukemic infiltrate).

ddx.vs: Also produces packed particles, but high-power examination shows a monotonous population of blasts replacing normal trilineage maturation.
Shows panmyelosis or granulocytic hyperplasia with characteristic megakaryocyte morphology and driver mutations, requiring high-power review and molecular testing.
A thick area of peripheral blood or crushed cells can look cellular at low power, but true particles show marrow-type cells, megakaryocytes and fat on focusing.

3453.recognize_zh: 箭頭指向紅血球之間淡藍灰色、無結構的細胞外沉積物（冷凝球蛋白），旁邊的紅血球被擠壓或部分遮蓋而看似盔形或碎片狀，但其實是假性裂紅血球（pseudoschistocytes），並非真正的溶血碎片。
features: Pale blue-gray to lavender amorphous extracellular deposits between red cells (arrows)
Adjacent red cells partly overlapped or indented, mimicking helmet cells and fragments
Deposits have no internal structure, granules or nuclei (not platelets or cells)
Background red cells mostly normocytic with some crenated forms and overlap
No true numerous schistocytes or microspherocytes elsewhere in the field
3453.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells with focal overlap and crenation. Scattered between the red cells are pale blue-gray, amorphous, acellular deposits (arrows) that partially cover or indent adjacent erythrocytes, creating apparent helmet cells and fragments. True schistocytes are not seen elsewhere, and the deposits lack the granular texture of platelets. Findings are consistent with precipitated cryoglobulin producing pseudoschistocytes; warming the sample to 37 °C should dissolve the deposits and can correct spurious automated counts.

ddx.vs: Real fragments are small, dense, sharply angulated red cells with no associated amorphous material and are accompanied by thrombocytopenia and hemolysis markers.
Platelet aggregates are purple and granular with distinct individual platelets, unlike the structureless pale deposits here.
Stain deposit is dark purple, refractile and crystalline or granular and lies on top of cells randomly, rather than pale amorphous material that disappears on warming.

3197.recognize_zh: 低倍免疫染色下，淋巴結濾泡（藍色圓形區域）為陰性，而其間擴張的淋巴竇內充滿成群棕色陽性的大型組織球，呈竇內分布；配合 Rosai-Dorfman 病脈絡，此為 S100 等組織球標記凸顯竇內病變（標記名稱未標示）。
features: Low-power lymph node immunostain
Positive (brown) large cells distributed within dilated sinuses, including subcapsular sinus
Lymphoid follicles and paracortical small lymphocytes negative
Sinusoidal/interfollicular network pattern of staining
Antibody not specified; pattern compatible with S100 in Rosai-Dorfman disease
3197.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain of the lymph node shows positive large cells filling and distending the subcapsular and medullary sinuses in a network pattern, while lymphoid follicles and small lymphocytes are negative. The positive cells are large with abundant cytoplasm, consistent with sinus histiocytes. The antibody is not specified; in the context of sinus histiocytosis with massive lymphadenopathy, this sinusoidal distribution of positive histiocytes is compatible with S100 staining. Findings support Rosai-Dorfman disease.

ddx.dx: Langerhans cell histiocytosis with sinus involvement
ddx.vs: LCH also involves sinuses and is S100 positive, but its cells are CD1a/langerin positive with grooved nuclei and lack emperipolesis.
Melanoma is S100 positive but also SOX10/melan-A positive with atypical cytology and no engulfed lymphocytes.
Reactive sinus histiocytes are CD68/CD163 positive but S100 negative and do not massively distend sinuses.

3389.recognize_zh: 高倍率骨髓抽吸抹片中，大部分細胞是帶有豐富紫紅色顆粒的前骨髓球與骨髓球，並可見後骨髓球、桿狀及分節中性球，夾雜少數深色小圓核的紅血球母細胞；顆粒球系各階段都在且數量占優勢，就是顆粒球增生。
features: Predominance of granulocytic precursors, especially promyelocytes and myelocytes
Promyelocytes with round to oval nuclei, perinuclear hof and abundant azurophilic granules
Myelocytes and metamyelocytes with coarse secondary granules and indented nuclei
Band and segmented neutrophils present, indicating orderly maturation
Scattered small erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
No Auer rods, bundles of Auer rods or increased blasts in this field
3389.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a predominance of granulocytic cells, with numerous promyelocytes and myelocytes containing abundant azurophilic and secondary granules, accompanied by metamyelocytes, band forms and segmented neutrophils. Scattered erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei are interspersed. Maturation appears orderly, and Auer rods, faggot cells and increased blasts are not identified in this field. Findings are consistent with granulocytic (myeloid) hyperplasia with a left-shifted but maturing pattern; correlation with the M:E ratio, clinical history (infection, G-CSF therapy, marrow recovery) and exclusion of CML are recommended.

ddx.vs: APL shows a monotonous population of abnormal hypergranular promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and Auer rod bundles, without maturation to neutrophils.
CML also shows granulocytic hyperplasia but with basophilia, eosinophilia, small hypolobated megakaryocytes and BCR::ABL1.
Growth factor effect produces a promyelocyte/myelocyte-rich marrow with coarse granules and vacuoles; history of G-CSF use distinguishes it.
AML with maturation has 20% or more myeloblasts, often with Auer rods and dysplasia.

3005.recognize_zh: 表皮基底層與棘層內可見多個核深染、帶透明暈（halo）的淋巴球單個散入表皮，沿基底層排列，但表皮海綿狀水腫不明顯，真皮乳頭層有淋巴球浸潤，這是蕈狀肉芽腫的表皮趨向性（epidermotropism）。
features: Single lymphocytes infiltrating the basal and lower spinous layers of the epidermis
Intraepidermal lymphocytes with hyperchromatic, slightly irregular nuclei and perinuclear clear halos
Lymphocytes aligned along the basal layer
Epidermotropism out of proportion to minimal spongiosis
Papillary dermis with edema/fibrosis and a lymphoid infiltrate containing some larger atypical cells
3005.describe_en: Skin biopsy at medium-high power shows lymphocytes infiltrating the epidermis singly, mainly along the basal layer and in the lower spinous layer. The intraepidermal lymphocytes have hyperchromatic, mildly irregular nuclei surrounded by clear halos, and spongiosis is minimal relative to the number of lymphocytes. The papillary dermis contains a lymphoid infiltrate with scattered larger atypical cells. Findings demonstrate epidermotropism of haloed atypical lymphocytes and are consistent with mycosis fungoides, pending clinicopathologic correlation and immunophenotyping.

ddx.vs: Exocytosis of lymphocytes in dermatitis is accompanied by prominent spongiosis and the lymphocytes lack halos and nuclear atypia.
Interface dermatitis shows vacuolar basal damage and necrotic keratinocytes, whereas MF lymphocytes line the basal layer with little keratinocyte injury.
Pityriasis lichenoides has a wedge-shaped infiltrate, necrotic keratinocytes, and extravasated RBCs with parakeratosis, rather than haloed atypical basilar lymphocytes.

exam.answer_en: Mycosis fungoides — epidermotropism of haloed hyperchromatic lymphocytes lining the basal layer, disproportionate to minimal spongiosis
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指基底層帶透明暈的淋巴球，要你說出 MF 早期三個組織線索：haloed lymphocytes、沿基底層排列（basilar alignment）、epidermotropism 與 spongiosis 不成比例。
表皮內淋巴球比真皮內淋巴球更大、更不典型，也是支持 MF 的組織學特徵。
IHC 常見 CD4+、CD7 缺失；表皮內淋巴球的 CD7 缺失比真皮明顯時更有意義。TCR clonality 在皮膚與血液同一克隆更支持診斷。
早期 MF 臨床為軀幹與臀部等非日曬部位的 patch，常被長期當作濕疹治療；多次切片常是必要的。
早期病灶暫停局部類固醇後再切片，可提高診斷率。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 spongiotic dermatitis 的淋巴球外滲（exocytosis）；皮膚炎的淋巴球伴明顯海綿狀水腫且無透明暈與異型性，MF 則 spongiosis 很少。

quiz.q: 圖中沿表皮基底層排列、帶透明暈的淋巴球浸入表皮，此現象稱為什麼？與皮膚炎最關鍵的區分點為何？
quiz.a: Epidermotropism；spongiosis 很少，與淋巴球數量不成比例

2941.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片高度細胞性，充滿核摺疊、灰藍細胞質的單核球系原始細胞與前單核球，其間散佈含橘紅顆粒的嗜酸性球及其前驅細胞，是 AML M4Eo 的典型組合。
features: Hypercellular smear dominated by blasts and promonocytes with fine chromatin and indented/folded nuclei
Moderate gray-blue cytoplasm, some with fine granules and occasional vacuoles
Increased eosinophils and eosinophil precursors with orange-red granules, some immature with purplish granules
Scattered maturing neutrophils and a few lymphocytes; erythroid precursors sparse
2941.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is markedly cellular and composed predominantly of blasts and promonocytes with delicate chromatin, folded or indented nuclei and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm. There is a conspicuous admixture of eosinophils and eosinophil precursors at various stages of maturation, some with larger purplish granules. Residual granulocytic and erythroid elements are reduced. Findings are consistent with acute myelomonocytic leukemia with abnormal eosinophils (therapy-related, per history); correlation with inv(16)/t(16;16) or CBFB::MYH11 testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: M5 lacks the prominent eosinophil component and shows near-exclusive monocytic differentiation.
t(8;21) blasts show salmon-colored perinuclear hof, long Auer rods and granulocytic rather than monocytic differentiation, although eosinophil precursors may also increase.
Eosinophilia is mature and dominant with blasts <20% and without a monocytic blast population.

exam.answer_en: Therapy-related acute myelomonocytic leukemia with abnormal eosinophils (M4Eo) — blasts/promonocytes with increased eosinophil precursors bearing purplish granules
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍看整體「blasts + promonocytes + 大量 eosinophil 前驅」組合，考官常問診斷與要送的分子檢查；答 AML with CBFB::MYH11，送 inv(16)/t(16;16) FISH 或 RT-PCR。
WHO 5th 中 AML with CBFB::MYH11 不需 blast ≥20%（ICC 2022 則要求 ≥10%）；此處 promonocyte 視同 blast equivalent 計入。
臨床連結：先前化療史（尤其 topoisomerase II inhibitor）→ WHO 5th 以 post cytotoxic therapy 為 qualifier；需詢問原發腫瘤治療與間隔時間。
CBF AML 標準治療含高劑量 cytarabine 鞏固；gemtuzumab ozogamicin 對 CBF AML 有益；RT-PCR 追蹤 CBFB::MYH11 transcript 作 MRD。
Abnormal eosinophil 並非 M4Eo 專有：mature eosinophil 增加也見於其他 AML 或 PDGFR/FGFR1 myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia，需靠遺傳分型。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 CMML 或反應性 eosinophilia：本圖 blasts＋promonocytes 占多數且 eosinophil 前驅帶異常紫色顆粒；promonocyte 核摺但染色質細緻，需與成熟 monocyte（染色質較粗、灰色細胞質）區分。

quiz.q: 本片 blast 計數時，摺疊核、細緻染色質、灰藍細胞質的細胞應算作什麼？
quiz.a: Promonocyte，算作 blast equivalent

2813.recognize_zh: 一小群顆粒球系細胞同時包含一顆嗜鹼性細胞質的大型母細胞、骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞、帶狀及分葉核中性球，呈現左移的完整成熟譜系；母細胞比例與嗜鹼性球數目需全片計數才能判定加速期。
features: Cluster of granulocytic cells spanning blast to segmented neutrophil
One large blast with fine chromatin and a rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Several myelocytes/promyelocytes with round to oval nuclei and grayish granular cytoplasm
Metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils; no obvious dysplasia
Sparse red cells in the background, suggesting a buffy coat or cytocentrifuge preparation
2813.describe_en: The smear shows a cluster of granulocytic cells representing the full maturation spectrum, including one large blast with fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils. Obvious dysgranulopoiesis is not seen, and basophils are not clearly identified in this cluster. Accelerated phase criteria (blasts 10-19% or basophils >=20% in blood or marrow, or additional clonal abnormalities) cannot be assessed from a single field. The findings are compatible with CML showing a left-shifted granulocytic proliferation.

ddx.vs: Chronic phase has <10% blasts and <20% basophils; separation from accelerated phase depends on counts, not individual cell morphology.
Blast phase requires >=20% blasts in blood or marrow or an extramedullary blast proliferation.
Reactive left shift shows toxic granulation and is BCR::ABL1-negative without basophilia.

2493.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片幾乎全是大型、圓核、染色質細顆粒狀且胞質深藍色並帶有小空泡的原紅血球（pronormoblasts），而顆粒球系細胞很少，提示純紅血球白血病（pure erythroid leukemia）。
features: Predominance of large, round cells with high N:C ratio
Round nuclei with finely stippled to granular chromatin and occasional small nucleoli
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm forming a rim, some with small cytoplasmic vacuoles
Occasional binucleate/irregular erythroid forms and scattered small erythroid precursors
Granulocytic elements sparse (rare segmented neutrophils)
2493.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular population dominated by large immature cells with round nuclei, finely stippled chromatin, small nucleoli and a rim of intensely basophilic, occasionally vacuolated cytoplasm, morphologically consistent with proerythroblasts. Scattered later erythroid precursors are present, while granulocytic precursors are markedly reduced. Findings are suggestive of pure erythroid leukemia; confirmation requires a differential count showing >80% erythroid precursors with >=30% proerythroblasts and immunophenotyping (E-cadherin, CD71, glycophorin) with exclusion of other causes.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic marrow shows orderly erythroid maturation with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and giant bands/metamyelocytes rather than sheets of proerythroblasts, and corrects with B12/folate.
Parvovirus shows scattered giant pronormoblasts with glassy intranuclear inclusions in an otherwise erythroid-depleted marrow rather than a monotonous erythroid proliferation.
Megakaryoblasts can have basophilic blebbed cytoplasm but are CD41/CD61 positive and E-cadherin/glycophorin negative.
Burkitt blasts have vacuolated deep-blue cytoplasm but coarser chromatin with multiple nucleoli and a B-cell immunophenotype.

exam.answer_en: Pure erythroid leukemia (suggested) — sheets of proerythroblasts with deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm and sparse granulocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指胞質深藍帶空泡的大型母細胞，問是哪一系；答 proerythroblast，並說出 pure erythroid leukemia 的診斷門檻。
WHO 5th（AML with erythroid differentiation）：erythroid precursors ≥ 80%，其中 proerythroblasts ≥ 30%；需先排除 megaloblastic anemia 等反應性原因。
IHC／flow：E-cadherin、CD71、CD117 陽性，glycophorin A 在早期細胞可弱或陰性；MPO 陰性，PAS 可呈塊狀／globular 陽性。
遺傳：高比例 TP53 突變（常 biallelic）與 complex karyotype，預後極差；ICC 2022 將具 TP53 突變者歸入 AML with mutated TP53。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 megaloblastic anemia 混淆：後者紅系仍有序成熟、見核質發育不同步與巨大 metamyelocytes，補充 B12／folate 可改善；應先驗 B12、folate。

quiz.q: 圖中胞質深藍帶空泡的大型細胞屬於哪一系？可用哪個 IHC 標記協助確認早期紅系分化？
quiz.a: 紅系（proerythroblasts）；E-cadherin（亦可 CD71）

2301.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中三顆大型細胞，有豐富灰藍色、充滿細小嗜天青顆粒與小空泡的細胞質，核圓至卵圓形、染色質細緻，是單核母細胞/前單核球的樣子。
features: Three large cells with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm
Fine azurophilic granules and small vacuoles throughout the cytoplasm, with irregular borders
Round to oval nuclei with delicate, finely granular chromatin
Moderate N:C ratio; no Auer rods
Background red cells without significant abnormality
2301.describe_en: Smear shows three large cells with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules and small vacuoles, with irregular cytoplasmic borders. Nuclei are round to oval with delicate, finely granular chromatin. No Auer rods are identified and the red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with monoblasts/promonocytes of acute monocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Mature monocytes have folded nuclei with condensed, clumped chromatin and gray cytoplasm, rather than the delicate chromatin seen here.
CMML shows persistent monocytosis of mostly mature forms with blasts plus promonocytes below 20%.
APL cells have bilobed nuclei, strong MPO positivity and PML::RARA, whereas monoblasts are NSE positive.

2109.recognize_zh: 中央嗜中性球的 S 形分葉核右下方，胞質邊緣可見一個小而清楚的淡藍色斑塊（Döhle body），胞質有輕度增多的紫色顆粒，符合嗜中性球的毒性變化。
features: Segmented neutrophil with S-shaped nucleus and clumped chromatin
Distinct small pale blue patch at the lower-right cytoplasmic edge (Döhle body)
Mildly increased fine purple cytoplasmic granulation
Background red cells with a few target-like central pallor forms and refractile artifact
Scattered normal platelets
2109.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at oil immersion shows a segmented neutrophil with an S-shaped nucleus, mildly increased cytoplasmic granulation, and a distinct small pale blue patch at the lower-right cytoplasmic periphery, consistent with a Döhle body. Red cells show occasional refractile drying artifact. Findings are consistent with reactive neutrophil toxic change.

ddx.vs: MYH9 inclusions are seen in nearly all neutrophils with giant platelets, whereas Döhle bodies are variable and reactive.
A platelet has granular purple center and lies partly outside the cell border, unlike the homogeneous blue intracytoplasmic Döhle body.
Anaplasma morulae are stippled dark purple clusters of organisms rather than pale blue homogeneous patches.

exam.answer_en: Döhle body — distinct pale blue patch at the cytoplasmic edge of a segmented neutrophil with mild toxic granulation
pearls_zh: 考法：單一、邊界清楚的 Döhle body，考官指該斑並問「在哪、是什麼、代表什麼？」答周邊胞質、殘留 RER、反應性毒性變化。
血液寄生/感染鑑別：Anaplasma（granulocytic anaplasmosis）morula 為嗜中性球內深紫色點狀團塊，與淡藍均質的 Döhle body 不同。
Döhle body 見於感染、燒傷、懷孕、細胞激素治療，也可在 May-Hegglin 的鑑別題中出現：後者包涵體在所有顆粒球皆可見。
MYH9-related disorder 確認：嗜中性球 NMMHC-IIA 免疫螢光呈異常聚集，或 MYH9 基因檢測；臨床可伴腎病、聽力喪失、白內障。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為重疊血小板或 Anaplasma morula：血小板顆粒狀紫色且常越出細胞邊界；morula 為深紫點狀菌團；Döhle body 為均質淡藍、位於胞質內緣。

quiz.q: 圖中 S 形分葉核嗜中性球右下緣的淡藍色小斑塊是什麼？和 Anaplasma morula 如何區分？
quiz.a: Döhle body；Döhle body 均質淡藍，morula 為深紫點狀菌團

2045.recognize_zh: 低倍下周邊血液抹片中散布大量小而深染的淋巴球，數量遠超過其他白血球，大小僅略大於紅血球、細胞質極少，符合 CLL 的絕對淋巴球增多（absolute lymphocytosis）。
features: Marked increase in small lymphocytes at low power
Lymphocytes only slightly larger than red cells with scant cytoplasm
Dense, darkly staining round nuclei
Monotonous population without appreciable granulocytes in field
Occasional smudge-like disrupted cell (lower left)
Red cells normochromic with no significant poikilocytosis at this magnification
2045.describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a marked lymphocytosis composed of a monotonous population of small lymphocytes with dense round nuclei and scant cytoplasm. Granulocytes are not appreciated in this field, and an occasional smudge-like cell is present. Red cells are unremarkable at this magnification. Nuclear chromatin detail cannot be assessed at this power. Findings are suggestive of chronic lymphocytic leukemia, to be confirmed by flow cytometry showing a clonal B-cell population of at least 5 x 10^9/L.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes are pleomorphic with abundant cytoplasm or, in pertussis, cleaved nuclei in children, and lack a clonal CD5+/CD23+ B-cell population.
Leukemic MCL cells are often more irregular and pleomorphic and are CD23 negative with cyclin D1 positivity, which requires flow/IHC to exclude.
MBL is morphologically identical but has a clonal B-cell count below 5 x 10^9/L without lymphadenopathy, organomegaly or cytopenias.
SMZL lymphocytes have polar villous cytoplasmic projections and are usually CD5 and CD23 negative.

exam.answer_en: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia (suggestive) — marked absolute lymphocytosis of monotonous small mature lymphocytes with smudge cells
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍抹片問「白血球以哪種細胞為主？下一步做什麼？」答：小型成熟淋巴球增多；flow cytometry 證實單株 B 細胞。
診斷門檻：周邊血單株 B 細胞 ≥5×10⁹/L 持續存在；低於此值且無淋巴結腫大、器官腫大或血球低下者為 monoclonal B-cell lymphocytosis。
Flow 表型：CD19+、CD5+、CD23+、CD200+，CD20 與 surface Ig 弱表現且輕鏈限制；Matutes score 用來輔助與其他 B 細胞腫瘤區分。
預後／治療選擇前必查：del(17p)／TP53 突變與 IGHV 突變狀態；分期用 Rai 或 Binet，無症狀早期可觀察。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 leukemic mantle cell lymphoma：MCL 細胞核較不規則，CD5+ 但 CD23 陰性、CD200 陰性、cyclin D1 陽性；形態重疊時一定要靠 flow 與 cyclin D1。

quiz.q: 此抹片若 flow 顯示 CD5+ B 細胞，還需要哪兩個標記陽性支持 CLL 而非 MCL？
quiz.a: CD23 與 CD200 陽性（且 cyclin D1 陰性）

1917.recognize_zh: 多顆未成熟細胞胞質內充滿粗大、深紫黑色的嗜鹼性顆粒，顆粒甚至覆蓋細胞核；另有核呈卵圓、染色質較細的細胞帶少量顆粒，與左側正常分葉中性球對比，符合急性嗜鹼性白血病。
features: Multiple medium-sized cells with coarse, dark purple-black basophilic granules overlying and obscuring the nucleus
Immature cell (upper center) with oval nucleus, relatively fine chromatin, and fewer scattered granules
Granule density varies from sparse to packed, with some cells showing peripheral vacuole-like clearing
Segmented neutrophil at left with fine pink granules for comparison
Red cells with rouleaux-like stacking
1917.describe_en: Smear shows numerous medium-sized immature cells with round to oval nuclei and variably abundant coarse, dark purple-black basophilic granules that often overlie the nucleus; some cells have finer chromatin and only sparse granules, indicating immaturity. A normal segmented neutrophil is present for comparison, and red cells show rouleaux-like stacking. Findings are consistent with acute basophilic leukemia; confirmation requires blast enumeration, metachromatic toluidine blue positivity, flow cytometry (CD123, CD203c, CD11b, lack of CD117 and HLA-DR), and exclusion of CML in blast phase and BCR::ABL1 or t(6;9) AML.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia in blast phase with basophilia
ddx.vs: CML blast phase shows marked mature basophilia with left-shifted granulocytes and splenomegaly and is BCR::ABL1-positive.
Mast cells have oval eccentric nuclei with abundant cytoplasm and granules that do not obscure the nucleus, and are CD117/tryptase-positive with KIT D816V.
APL promyelocytes have red-purple azurophilic granules and Auer rod bundles with strong MPO positivity and PML::RARA.
This AML type is often accompanied by basophilia and multilineage dysplasia and is defined by the translocation rather than basophilic blasts alone.

1853.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的細胞質內布滿粗大、深紫黑色的顆粒，是帶有嗜鹼性染色顆粒的異常嗜酸性前驅細胞（abnormal eosinophil），周圍伴隨許多芽細胞與單核球系細胞，為 AML 伴 inv(16)/CBFB::MYH11 的典型線索。
features: Arrowed round eosinophil precursor packed with coarse, dark purple-black (basophilic-staining) granules
Surrounding intermediate to large blasts with round to folded nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate cytoplasm
Some cells with irregular, monocytoid nuclear contours
Additional granulated cells with mixed purple granules in the field
Hypercellular smear with erythrocytes in the background
1853.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows sheets of immature myelomonocytic cells with round to folded nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate cytoplasm. Scattered eosinophil precursors contain abnormally large, dark purple-black granules (arrow), a characteristic dysplastic eosinophil appearance. Findings are highly suggestive of AML with inv(16)(p13.1q22) or t(16;16)(p13.1;q22); CBFB::MYH11, to be confirmed by cytogenetics, FISH or RT-PCR.

ddx.vs: Basophil granules are water-soluble, overlie the nucleus and are metachromatic, whereas abnormal eosinophils show a mixture of basophilic and eosinophilic granules and are chloroacetate esterase positive.
May have increased eosinophils but these lack the abnormal large basophilic granules and the monocytic component is inconspicuous.
Shows a full spectrum of granulocytic maturation with basophilia and eosinophilia but no sheets of blasts, and carries BCR::ABL1.

ddx.dx: Myeloid neoplasm with eosinophilia and tyrosine kinase gene fusion
ddx.vs: Eosinophils are mature and increased in number rather than dysplastic precursors, and PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2 rearrangements are present.

exam.answer_en: AML with inv(16)/CBFB::MYH11 — arrowed eosinophil precursor packed with abnormally large dark purple-black granules among myelomonocytic blasts
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指箭頭問「這顆細胞叫什麼？對應哪個 FAB 亞型與分子異常？」答 abnormal eosinophil；FAB M4Eo；inv(16)(p13.1q22)/t(16;16)，CBFB::MYH11。
CBFB 與 RUNX1 共同組成 core-binding factor；inv(16) 與 t(8;21)（RUNX1::RUNX1T1）合稱 CBF-AML，預後相對良好。
必做檢查：核型 + FISH/RT-PCR（inv(16) 核型易漏），並檢測 KIT 突變；融合轉錄本定量用於 MRD 追蹤。
WHO 5th 此型不設母細胞比例門檻；ICC 2022 要求 ≥10% 母細胞。
嗜伊紅球異常只存在於部分病例且數量不一，找不到也不能排除，確診仍依分子檢測。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為嗜鹼性球或肥大細胞前驅；嗜鹼性顆粒 metachromatic、水溶且覆於核上，異常嗜伊紅球則深紫與嗜伊紅顆粒並存，CAE 陽性。

quiz.q: 箭頭細胞的出現最應聯想到哪一個融合基因？用什麼方法確認？
quiz.a: CBFB::MYH11（inv(16)/t(16;16)）；FISH 或 RT-PCR（核型可能漏判）。

1661.recognize_zh: 中倍骨髓抹片細胞量極高，幾乎全是大小一致的小至中型母細胞，核圓、細胞質極少，偶見小空泡；正常造血只剩少數帶顆粒的顆粒球，這種單調的「小藍細胞」大量浸潤符合急性淋巴性白血病。
features: Hypercellular aspirate with a monotonous population of small-to-medium blasts
Very high N:C ratio with round nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Homogeneous chromatin; occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles
Few residual granulated myeloid cells scattered among the blasts
Background red cells and a fat space
1661.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular and shows extensive replacement by a monotonous population of small-to-medium blasts with very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round nuclei and scant cytoplasm, a few with small vacuoles. Only occasional residual granulated myeloid cells are present, and Auer rods are not seen. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; B- versus T-lineage and risk-defining genetics require flow cytometry, cytogenetics and molecular studies.

ddx.vs: Blasts are usually larger with more cytoplasm and express myeloid antigens (CD13, CD33, CD117) without lymphoid-lineage markers.
Hematogones show a maturational spectrum of CD10/CD20/CD34 expression on flow cytometry rather than a monotonous aberrant blast population.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of small cell lymphoma (e.g., CLL)
ddx.vs: CLL cells have condensed block-like chromatin, smudge cells and a mature CD5+/CD23+ phenotype, not blastic chromatin.

60925.recognize_zh: 背景有大小不一的巨大卵圓紅血球、淚滴細胞與破碎紅血球，符合巨母紅血球性貧血；中央偏上一顆紫色（多染性）紅血球內只隱約可見一條淡淡弧線，Cabot ring 在此解析度下不易確認。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis with macro-ovalocytes, teardrop cells and small red cell fragments
Two red-cell-sized purple-staining cells with finely stippled cytoplasm and no nucleus, consistent with polychromatophilic/stippled red cells
A faint curvilinear line is barely discernible within the upper central purple cell, possibly a Cabot ring; not definitive at this resolution
Occasional red cells with irregular or elongated central pallor
Low leukocyte and platelet content in the field; one small platelet near upper left center
60925.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with macro-ovalocytes, teardrop cells and small fragmented red cells. Two red cells with diffuse purple staining and fine stippling are present; within the upper central cell a faint curvilinear inclusion is barely perceptible, which may represent a Cabot ring, although a well-formed ring or figure-eight loop cannot be confidently resolved at this image resolution. Platelets are sparse and no leukocytes are present in the field. The red cell changes are suggestive of megaloblastic anemia, in keeping with the stated vitamin B12 deficiency; the Cabot ring itself is only equivocally demonstrated.

ddx.vs: Plasmodium rings are small, thicker blue cytoplasmic rings with a distinct red-purple chromatin dot, not a thin threadlike loop spanning the cell.
Stippling appears as discrete punctate blue dots dispersed through the cell rather than a continuous thin ring or figure-eight.
A Howell-Jolly body is a single dense round dark purple dot, not a curvilinear strand.

exam.answer_en: Megaloblastic anemia picture (macro-ovalocytes, teardrops, fragments); faint arc in a polychromatic RBC suggests but does not confirm a Cabot ring
pearls_zh: 考法：Cabot ring 為紅血球內環形或 8 字形紅紫色細線，被認為是 mitotic spindle 殘留；此圖解析度有限，答題時宜註明 possible。
Cabot ring 可見於 megaloblastic anemia、lead poisoning、嚴重溶血與 dyserythropoiesis；本身不具特異性，需結合背景形態。
Megaloblastic 背景 workup：B12、folate，必要時 methylmalonic acid 與 homocysteine；同時找 hypersegmented neutrophils。
治療前需排除 B12 缺乏：只補 folate 可改善貧血，卻可能讓 B12 缺乏的神經學病變惡化。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 malaria ring form；瘧原蟲環狀體有明顯藍色胞質與紅色染色質點，Cabot ring 為無點的細線環。

quiz.q: 紅血球內無染色質點的細線環稱為什麼？與瘧原蟲 ring form 如何區分？
quiz.a: Cabot ring；ring form 有染色質點（chromatin dot）

125.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中纖維化的骨髓腔內有成群、呈放射狀（花瓣狀，rosette）排列的無色透明、折光性棒狀結晶，周圍有多核異物型巨細胞（foreign body giant cell）包圍，偏光下呈明亮雙折射，這些是草酸鈣結晶（oxalosis）的線索。
features: Clusters of colorless to pale grey, refractile, rod- and plate-shaped crystals arranged in radiating rosette (floret-like) aggregates within marrow spaces
Crystal aggregates rimmed by multinucleated foreign-body-type giant cells and histiocytes
Marrow spaces replaced by loose fibrocellular stroma with spindle cells; hematopoiesis largely absent in the field
Irregularly thickened bony trabeculae around the fibrotic spaces
Reticulin stain: markedly increased, dense reticulin fiber network surrounding the crystal deposits
Polarized light: crystals are strongly birefringent in radiating sheaf-like aggregates
125.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows irregularly thickened bony trabeculae enclosing marrow spaces replaced by fibrocellular stroma, with only a small residual focus of hematopoietic cells. Within the fibrotic marrow are multiple aggregates of colorless, refractile, rod- and plate-shaped crystals arranged in radiating rosettes, surrounded by a foreign-body giant cell and histiocytic reaction. A reticulin stain demonstrates markedly increased reticulin fibrosis around the deposits, and the crystals are strongly birefringent under polarized light. Findings are consistent with marrow oxalosis (calcium oxalate crystal deposition) with secondary myelofibrosis, in keeping with primary hyperoxaluria in the appropriate clinical setting.

ddx.vs: PMF shows reticulin/collagen fibrosis with atypical clustered megakaryocytes but no birefringent crystal deposits or foreign-body giant cell reaction.
Renal osteodystrophy produces peritrabecular fibrosis with increased osteoclastic resorption and osteoid, but lacks rosettes of polarizable oxalate crystals within the marrow.

ddx.dx: Gaucher disease or other storage histiocytosis
ddx.vs: Storage disorders replace marrow with sheets of histiocytes with fibrillary ('crinkled paper') cytoplasm rather than extracellular refractile crystals with giant cells.

Immunoglobulin crystals are intracytoplasmic, eosinophilic and non-birefringent within histiocytes associated with a plasma cell or B-cell neoplasm, unlike the large extracellular birefringent oxalate rosettes.

captions: H&E, low-medium power: thickened trabeculae with fibrotic marrow containing rosettes of refractile crystals
H&E, high power: radiating colorless crystals surrounded by multinucleated foreign-body giant cells
Reticulin stain: markedly increased reticulin fibers around crystal-filled spaces
Polarized light: brightly birefringent radiating crystal aggregates (arrow)

61.recognize_zh: 兒童扁桃腺中可見大而擴張、背靠背的濾泡樣結節，由單一形態的中至大型類中心母細胞（centroblast-like）組成，缺乏星空樣（starry-sky）巨噬細胞；結節內核型 IHC 強陽性（符合 MUM1/IRF4 型態），FISH IRF4 break-apart 顯示分離訊號，支持 IRF4 重排大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Large, expansile, closely packed follicle-like nodules separated by fibrous bands and attenuated rims of small lymphocytes
Monotonous medium-to-large centroblast-like cells with round to oval vesicular nuclei, open chromatin and small nucleoli
Frequent mitoses without prominent tingible-body macrophages (no starry-sky pattern), no serpiginous follicle shapes
Neoplastic nodules show strong membranous B-cell marker staining and strong diffuse nuclear staining in the large cells (MUM1/IRF4 pattern)
CD21/CD23-type follicular dendritic cell meshworks retained within nodules
IRF4 break-apart FISH shows split red and green signals in tumor nuclei
61.describe_en: Sections of tonsil show effacement by large, back-to-back, expansile follicle-like nodules separated by fibrous septa and compressed rims of small lymphocytes. The nodules are composed of a monotonous population of medium-to-large centroblast-like cells with vesicular chromatin, small nucleoli and brisk mitotic activity; a starry-sky pattern and serpiginous follicles are not seen. Immunostains show strong membranous positivity for a pan-B-cell marker, strong diffuse nuclear staining in the neoplastic cells consistent with MUM1/IRF4, and preserved follicular dendritic cell meshworks; individual stains in the panel are unlabeled. FISH with an IRF4 break-apart probe demonstrates separated signals indicating IRF4 rearrangement. Findings are consistent with large B-cell lymphoma with IRF4 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: PTFL shows serpiginous follicles with a starry-sky pattern, blastoid/centrocytic cells, weak or absent MUM1 and lacks IRF4 rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Follicular lymphoma, grade 3B (follicular large B-cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Adult-type FL is usually MUM1-negative or weak, often BCL2+ with t(14;18) and lacks IRF4 break-apart.
Reactive germinal centers show polarization, tingible-body macrophages, intact mantle zones, mixed centrocytes/centroblasts and MUM1 only in scattered cells.
Burkitt shows diffuse sheets of medium-sized cells with starry-sky pattern, Ki-67 near 100%, CD10+/BCL2- and MYC rearrangement rather than IRF4.

61.stain: H&E; IHC (unlabeled panel); FISH: IRF4 break-apart
captions: H&E low power: large expansile nodules separated by fibrous bands
H&E: nodule of monotonous large cells rimmed by small lymphocytes
H&E medium power: sheets of centroblast-like cells without starry-sky pattern
H&E high power: vesicular nuclei, small nucleoli, mitoses
IHC (40x/400x): strong membranous pan-B-cell marker pattern in nodules
IHC (40x/400x): membranous/cytoplasmic positivity in neoplastic cells (marker unlabeled)
IHC (40x/400x): strong nuclear staining of large cells, MUM1/IRF4 pattern
IHC (40x/400x): nuclear staining throughout nodules (marker unlabeled, BCL6/PAX5 pattern)
IHC (40x/400x): variable membranous/cytoplasmic staining of nodules (marker unlabeled)
IHC 100x: follicular dendritic cell meshwork (CD21/CD23 pattern)
FISH IRF4 break-apart: split red and green signals (arrows)

1789.recognize_zh: 箭頭指的是一顆大型組織細胞，細胞質淡藍灰色、充滿條紋狀如「皺摺紙巾」（crumpled tissue paper）的纖維狀紋理，核小而偏位；這就是高雪氏症（Gaucher disease）的高雪細胞。
features: Large histiocyte (arrow) many times the size of surrounding myeloid cells
Abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm with fibrillary, striated 'crumpled tissue paper' texture
Small, eccentric round nucleus with condensed chromatin
No discrete vacuoles or foamy bubbles in the cytoplasm
Background of normal maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors, and lymphocytes
1789.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large histiocyte (arrow) with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm displaying a fibrillary, striated 'crumpled tissue paper' appearance and a small eccentric nucleus. The surrounding hematopoietic cells show normal granulocytic and erythroid maturation. Similar pseudo-Gaucher cells occur in conditions with high cell turnover, so the finding should be confirmed by glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay or GBA1 genotyping. Findings are consistent with Gaucher disease.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (CML, myeloma, thalassemia, mycobacterial infection)
ddx.vs: Morphologically similar striated histiocytes, but glucocerebrosidase activity is normal and an underlying disorder is present; mycobacteria are AFB positive.
Foam cells have finely vacuolated, bubbly cytoplasm and sea-blue histiocytes rather than fibrillary striations.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain blue-green granular ceroid pigment instead of striated pale cytoplasm.
Megakaryocytes have a large lobulated nucleus and granular pink cytoplasm, not a small eccentric nucleus with striations.

exam.answer_en: Gaucher disease — Gaucher cell with abundant fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm and small eccentric nucleus
pearls_zh: 考法：指大型組織球問名稱，並與 Niemann-Pick foam cell 及 sea-blue histiocyte 比較。
GBA1 突變致 glucocerebrosidase 缺乏；確診以白血球酵素活性與基因分型，不需依賴骨髓檢查。
Gaucher cell PAS 陽性、TRAP（tartrate-resistant acid phosphatase）陽性。
臨床：脾腫大、血小板低、骨痛與 Erlenmeyer flask deformity；type 1 無神經侵犯，可用 enzyme replacement 或 substrate reduction（eliglustat）。
Gaucher disease 病人 MGUS、多發性骨髓瘤與 Parkinson disease 風險增加。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 pseudo-Gaucher cells（CML、myeloma、thalassemia、分枝桿菌感染）或 Niemann-Pick foam cells；後者胞質為泡沫狀空泡而非纖維條紋。

quiz.q: 此細胞缺乏哪一種酵素？
quiz.a: Glucocerebrosidase（GBA1）
